author.name: Zhouwei Zhai, Mengxiang Chen, Anmeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SIA framework for building knowledge-grounded and secure e-commerce search LLMs by synthesizing knowledge from graphs and behavioral logs, then injecting via parameter-efficient methods with safety alignment.

entry.title: Towards Fair and Robust Volumetric CT Classification via KL-Regularised Group Distributionally Robust Optimisation

author.name: Samuel Johnny, Blessed Guda, Frank Ebeledike, Goodness Obasi, Moise Busogi

entry.summary: Addresses both distribution shift and demographic fairness in volumetric CT classification using KL-regularised Group DRO with MobileViT-XXS encoder and SliceTransformer aggregator for COVID-19 and lung pathology tasks.

entry.title: Volumetrically Consistent Implicit Atlas Learning via Neural Diffeomorphic Flow for Placenta MRI

author.name: Athena Taymourtash, S. Mazdak Abulnaga, Esra Abaci Turk, P. Ellen Grant, Polina Golland

entry.summary: Introduces a volumetrically consistent implicit model coupling signed distance functions with neural diffeomorphic flow for placenta MRI atlas learning, enforcing interior deformations rather than just surface correspondences.

entry.title: Exclusivity-Guided Mask Learning for Semi-Supervised Crowd Instance Segmentation and Counting

author.name: Jiyang Huang, Hongru Cheng, Wei Lin, Jia Wan, Antoni B. Chan

entry.summary: Proposes XMask for semi-supervised crowd instance segmentation using exclusivity-guided mask learning with an Exclusion-Constrained Dual-Prompt SAM to generate mask supervision from point annotations.

entry.title: Persistent Story World Simulation with Continuous Character Customization

author.name: Jinlu Zhang, Qiyun Wang, Baoxiang Du, Jiayi Ji, Jing He, Rongsheng Zhang, Tangjie Lv, Xiaoshuai Sun, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: EverTale presents a story world simulator with continuous character customization using an All-in-One-World Character Integrator via unified LoRA and an MLLM-as-Judge Character Quality Gate for fidelity verification.

entry.title: DermaFlux: Synthetic Skin Lesion Generation with Rectified Flows for Enhanced Image Classification

author.name: Stathis Galanakis, Alexandros Koliousis, Stefanos Zafeiriou

entry.summary: DermaFlux uses rectified flow-based generation fine-tuned with LoRA on Flux.1 to synthesize clinically grounded skin lesion images from text descriptions, improving classification of underrepresented lesion types.

entry.title: Fast-HaMeR: Boosting Hand Mesh Reconstruction using Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Hunain Ahmed Jillani, Ahmed Tawfik Aboukhadra, Ahmed Elhayek, Jameel Malik, Nadia Robertini, Didier Stricker

entry.summary: Fast-HaMeR uses knowledge distillation with lightweight neural networks to accelerate 3D hand reconstruction, making the HaMeR model faster and lighter while maintaining comparable accuracy for real-time VR/AR applications.

entry.title: SuCor: Susceptibility Distortion Correction via Parameter-Free and Self-Regularized Optimal Transport

author.name: Sreekar Chigurupati, Eleftherios Garyfallidis

entry.summary: SuCor corrects susceptibility-induced geometric distortions in EPI brain imaging using optimal transport, modeling the distortion field as Wasserstein-2 barycentric displacements with automatic regularization.

entry.title: SAMSEM -- A Generic and Scalable Approach for IC Metal Line Segmentation

author.name: Christian Gehrmann, Jonas Ricker, Simon Damm, Deruo Cheng, Julian Speith, Yiqiong Shi, Asja Fischer, Christof Paar

entry.summary: SAMSEM adapts Meta's SAM2 for segmenting metal lines on SEM images of integrated circuits, addressing the challenge of cross-IC generalization for hardware security verification.

entry.title: Robust Dynamic Object Detection in Cluttered Indoor Scenes via Learned Spatiotemporal Cues

author.name: Juan Rached, Yixuan Jia, Kota Kondo, Jonathan P. How

entry.summary: Presents a LiDAR-only framework for dynamic object detection in cluttered indoor environments that fuses temporal occupancy-grid motion segmentation with a learned bird's-eye-view dynamic prior.

entry.title: PA-LVIO: Real-Time LiDAR-Visual-Inertial Odometry and Mapping with Pose-Only Bundle Adjustment

author.name: Hailiang Tang, Tisheng Zhang, Liqiang Wang, Xin Ding, Man Yuan, Xiaoji Niu

entry.summary: PA-LVIO presents a pose-only bundle adjustment approach for real-time LiDAR-visual-inertial odometry with IMU-centric online spatial-temporal calibration for pixel-wise LiDAR-camera alignment.

entry.title: GenZ-LIO: Generalizable LiDAR-Inertial Odometry Beyond Indoor--Outdoor Boundaries

author.name: Daehan Lee, Hyungtae Lim, Seongjun Kim, Soonbin Rho, Changhyeon Lee, Sanghyun Park, Junwoo Hong, Eunseon Choi, Hyunyoung Jo, Soohee Han

entry.summary: GenZ-LIO proposes a generalizable LiDAR-inertial odometry framework that handles transitions between indoor and outdoor environments using PID-inspired adaptive mechanisms.

entry.title: Form Follows Function: Recursive Stem Model

author.name: Navid Hakimi

entry.summary: Introduces Recursive Stem Model (RSM) that improves recursive reasoning by detaching hidden-state history during training and applying loss only at the final step, creating a depth-agnostic transition operator. Builds on TRM-style backbone while reducing training overhead from deep supervision.

entry.title: Persona-Conditioned Risk Behavior in Large Language Models: A Simulated Gambling Study with GPT-4.1

author.name: Sankalp Dubedy

entry.summary: Studies how GPT-4.1 exhibits risk-taking behavior when assigned different socioeconomic personas in a simulated gambling environment. Finds the model reproduces key behavioral patterns like the sunk-cost effect and loss aversion across persona conditions.

entry.title: POaaS: Minimal-Edit Prompt Optimization as a Service to Lift Accuracy and Cut Hallucinations on On-Device sLLMs

author.name: Jungwoo Shim, Dae Won Kim, Sun Wook Kim, Soo Young Kim, Myungcheol Lee, Jae-geun Cha, Hyunhwa Choi

entry.summary: Proposes POaaS, a minimal-edit prompt optimization layer for on-device small language models that routes queries to lightweight specialists (Cleaner, Paraphraser, Fact-Adder) under strict drift and length constraints. Addresses prompt quality issues for resource-constrained sLLMs.

entry.title: Prompt Programming for Cultural Bias and Alignment of Large Language Models

author.name: Maksim Eren, Eric Michalak, Brian Cook, Johnny Seales Jr

entry.summary: Explores prompt programming techniques for reducing cultural bias in LLMs, extending previous work on culture-specific prompting to open-source models and automated prompt generation. Aims to improve alignment with target population value profiles.

entry.title: A federated learning framework with knowledge graph and temporal transformer for early sepsis prediction in multi-center ICUs

author.name: Yue Chang, Guangsen Lin, Jyun Jie Chuang, Shunqi Liu, Xinkui Li, Yaozheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes a federated learning framework integrating knowledge graphs and temporal transformers with meta-learning for early sepsis prediction across multiple ICUs, preserving patient privacy while enabling collaborative model training.

entry.title: Morphemes Without Borders: Evaluating Root-Pattern Morphology in Arabic Tokenizers and LLMs

author.name: Yara Alakeel, Chatrine Qwaider, Hanan Aldarmaki, Sawsan Alqahtani

entry.summary: Investigates how LLMs and tokenizers handle Arabic root-pattern (non-concatenative) morphology, evaluating whether they capture genuine morphological structure or rely on surface memorization, using a new test set across seven Arabic-centric and multilingual LLMs.

entry.title: Parallelised Differentiable Straightest Geodesics for 3D Meshes

author.name: Hippolyte Verninas, Caner Korkmaz, Stefanos Zafeiriou, Tolga Birdal, Simone Foti

entry.summary: Provides a parallel GPU implementation and differentiable computation of straightest geodesics on 3D meshes, enabling backpropagation through geometric operations for learning on Riemannian surfaces.

entry.title: Interact3D: Compositional 3D Generation of Interactive Objects

author.name: Hui Shan, Keyang Luo, Ming Li, Sizhe Zheng, Yanwei Fu, Zhen Chen, Xiangru Huang

entry.summary: Presents Interact3D, a framework for generating physically plausible 3D compositional objects from single images, handling occlusions and preserving object-object spatial relationships through a two-stage composition pipeline.

entry.title: Open-Source Reproduction and Explainability Analysis of Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation

author.name: Surya Vardhan Yalavarthi

entry.summary: Presents an open-source reproduction of Corrective RAG (CRAG) replacing proprietary components with open alternatives, and contributes the first explainability analysis of CRAG's retrieval evaluator using SHAP.

entry.title: A Scoping Review of AI-Driven Digital Interventions in Mental Health Care: Mapping Applications Across Screening, Support, Monitoring, Prevention, and Clinical Education

author.name: Yang Ni, Fanli Jia

entry.summary: Scoping review mapping AI-driven mental health interventions across screening, treatment support, monitoring, prevention, and clinical education, synthesizing 36 empirical studies on LLMs, ML models, and conversational agents.

entry.title: $D^3$-RSMDE: 40$\times$ Faster and High-Fidelity Remote Sensing Monocular Depth Estimation

author.name: Ruizhi Wang, Weihan Li, Zunlei Feng, Haofei Zhang, Mingli Song, Jiayu Wang, Jie Song, Li Sun

entry.summary: Proposes D³-RSMDE, an efficient framework for remote sensing monocular depth estimation combining ViT-based rapid depth map generation with diffusion model refinement, achieving 40x speedup.

entry.title: Bridging the High-Frequency Data Gap: A Millisecond-Resolution Network Dataset for Advancing Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Subina Khanal, Seshu Tirupathi, Merim Dzaferagic, Marco Ruffini, Torben Bach Pedersen

entry.summary: Introduces a millisecond-resolution 5G wireless network dataset for time series foundation models, addressing the gap in high-frequency training data and introducing the wireless network domain.

entry.title: Manifold-Matching Autoencoders

author.name: Laurent Cheret, Vincent L\'etourneau, Isar Nejadgholi, Chris Drummond, Hussein Al Osman, Maia Fraser

entry.summary: Proposes Manifold-Matching Autoencoders (MMAE), aligning pairwise latent distances to input data distances via MSE, finding this outperforms similar methods on nearest-neighbor and persistent homology preservation metrics.

entry.title: Real-Time Decoding of Movement Onset and Offset for Brain-Controlled Rehabilitation Exoskeleton

author.name: Kanishka Mitra, Satyam Kumar, Frigyes Samuel Racz, Deland Liu, Ashish D. Deshpande, Jos\'e del R. Mill\'an

entry.summary: Demonstrates online dual-state motor imagery control of an upper-limb exoskeleton via EEG, enabling both initiation and termination of robot-assisted movements for neuroplasticity-targeted rehabilitation.

entry.title: Game-Theory-Assisted Reinforcement Learning for Border Defense: Early Termination based on Analytical Solutions

author.name: Goutam Das, Michael Dorothy, Kyle Volle, Daigo Shishika

entry.summary: Combines game-theoretic insights with reinforcement learning for a border defense game, using Apollonius Circle equilibrium solutions to enable early termination and improve RL training efficiency.

entry.title: Adaptive regularization parameter selection for high-dimensional inverse problems: A Bayesian approach with Tucker low-rank constraints

author.name: Qing-Mei Yang, Da-Qing Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a variational Bayesian method integrating Tucker decomposition for high-dimensional inverse problems, with per-mode precision parameters enabling adaptive anisotropic regularization.

entry.title: GeMA: Learning Latent Manifold Frontiers for Benchmarking Complex Systems

author.name: Jia Ming Li, Anupriya, Daniel J. Graham

entry.summary: Proposes GeMA (Geometric Manifold Analysis), a VAE-based framework for benchmarking complex systems that learns latent manifold frontiers, replacing classical DEA/SFA with a more flexible geometric approach.

entry.title: RaDAR: Relation-aware Diffusion-Asymmetric Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation

author.name: Yixuan Huang, Jiawei Chen, Shengfan Zhang, Zongsheng Cao

entry.summary: Proposes RaDAR, a graph contrastive learning framework for recommendations that combines a graph generative model for global structure capture with a relation-aware denoising model for noisy edge refinement.

entry.title: Communication-Aware Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Decentralized Cooperative UAV Deployment

author.name: Enguang Fan, Yifan Chen, Zihan Shan, Matthew Caesar, Jae Kim

entry.summary: Presents a graph-based multi-agent RL framework for decentralized cooperative UAV deployment with centralized training/decentralized execution, using agent-entity attention and neighbor self-attention over distance-limited communication graphs.

entry.title: Encoding Predictability and Legibility for Style-Conditioned Diffusion Policy

author.name: Adrien Jacquet Cr\'etides, Mouad Abrini, Hamed Rahimi, Mohamed Chetouani

entry.summary: Proposes Style-Conditioned Diffusion Policy for human-robot collaboration that balances between legible (expressive) and efficient robot motion based on environmental ambiguity.

entry.title: Bridging the Simulation-to-Reality Gap in Electron Microscope Calibration via VAE-EM Estimation

author.name: Jilles S. van Hulst (Maurice), W. P. M. H. (Maurice), Heemels, Duarte J. Antunes

entry.summary: Uses variational autoencoders trained on simulated data to learn low-dimensional representations for scanning transmission electron microscope calibration, bridging the simulation-to-reality gap through EM estimation.

entry.title: Conflict-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition

author.name: Salah Eddine Bekhouche, Hichem Telli, Azeddine Benlamoudi, Salah Eddine Herrouz, Abdelmalik Taleb-Ahmed, Abdenour Hadid

entry.summary: ConflictAwareAH detects ambivalence and hesitancy by computing pairwise cross-modal conflict features between video, audio, and text modalities, using disagreements between channels as diagnostic signals.

entry.title: Structured prototype regularization for synthetic-to-real driving scene parsing

author.name: Jiahe Fan, Xiao Ma, Sergey Vityazev, George Giakos, Shaolong Shu, Rui Fan

entry.summary: Proposes structured prototype regularization for synthetic-to-real domain adaptation in driving scene parsing, modeling semantic relations among classes that global feature alignment methods miss.

entry.title: Boosting Quantitive and Spatial Awareness for Zero-Shot Object Counting

author.name: Da Zhang, Bingyu Li, Feiyu Wang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Junyu Gao

entry.summary: QICA addresses zero-shot object counting with a synergistic prompting strategy that adapts vision and language encoders through numerical-aware prompts and spatial cast aggregation for improved quantity and spatial awareness.

entry.title: Point-to-Mask: From Arbitrary Point Annotations to Mask-Level Infrared Small Target Detection

author.name: Weihua Gao, Wenlong Niu, Jie Tang, Man Yang, Jiafeng Zhang, Xiaodong Peng

entry.summary: Point-to-Mask bridges point annotations and mask-level detection for infrared small targets through physics-driven adaptive mask generation and a radius-aware regression network using spatiotemporal cues.

entry.title: PKINet-v2: Towards Powerful and Efficient Poly-Kernel Remote Sensing Object Detection

author.name: Xinhao Cai, Liulei Li, Gensheng Pei, Zeren Sun, Yazhou Yao, Wenguan Wang

entry.summary: PKINet-v2 extends PKINet for remote sensing object detection by combining anisotropic strip kernels and isotropic large kernels to handle both geometric diversity (slender objects) and scale diversity in aerial images.

entry.title: Near-light Photometric Stereo with Symmetric Lights

author.name: Lilika Makabe, Heng Guo, Hiroaki Santo, Fumio Okura, Yasuyuki Matsushita

entry.summary: Proposes a linear closed-form solution for near-light photometric stereo using symmetric light source arrangements, eliminating the need for non-convex optimization and initialization while reducing calibration requirements.

entry.title: BUSSARD: Normalizing Flows for Bijective Universal Scene-Specific Anomalous Relationship Detection

author.name: Melissa Schween, Mathis Kruse, Bodo Rosenhahn

entry.summary: BUSSARD uses normalizing flows for detecting anomalous relationships in scene graphs, embedding object-relation-object triplets with language models and performing likelihood-based anomaly detection.

entry.title: An assessment of data-centric methods for label noise identification in remote sensing data sets

author.name: Felix Kr\"ober, Genc Hoxha, Ribana Roscher

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates three data-centric methods for identifying label noise in remote sensing datasets under different noise types and levels (10-70%), addressing an understudied problem in remote sensing.

entry.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Assisted Automated Operator Portfolio for Constrained Multi-objective Optimization

author.name: Shuai Shao, Ye Tian, Shangshang Yang, Xingyi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes deep RL-assisted automated operator portfolio selection for constrained multi-objective optimization, learning to recommend multiple operators rather than a single best operator per generation.

entry.title: Early-Terminable Energy-Safe Iterative Coupling for Parallel Simulation of Port-Hamiltonian Systems

author.name: Qi Wei, Jianfeng Tao, Hongyu Nie, Wangtao Tan

entry.summary: Proposes an energy-safe iterative coupling method for parallel simulation of port-Hamiltonian systems using Douglas-Rachford splitting in wave coordinates, preventing spurious energy injection.

entry.title: Coverage First Next Best View for Inspection of Cluttered Pipe Networks Using Mobile Manipulators

author.name: Joshua Raymond Bettles, Jiaxu Wu, Bruno Vilhena Adorno, Joaquin Carrasco, Atsushi Yamashita

entry.summary: Proposes a coverage-first next-best-view planning approach for robotic inspection of cluttered pipe networks using mobile manipulators, reformulating coverage planning as information gain.

entry.title: Beyond Cybathlon: On-demand Quadrupedal Assistance for People with Limited Mobility

author.name: Carmen Scheidemann, Andrei Cramariuc, Changan Chen, Jia-Ruei Chiu, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: Presents a quadrupedal robot system for assisting people with limited mobility, using shared autonomy that combines semi-autonomous task execution with human teleoperation. Unlike wheelchair-mounted arms, the robot operates independently and assists on demand.

entry.title: Research note on window shifting training

author.name: Kei Nishimura-Gasparian

entry.summary: Research note exploring how adding prompt prefixes during SFT affects model behavior: prefixes pushing toward a behavior during training paradoxically make the model exhibit it less, and vice versa. The 'window shifting' effect yields mixed results for improving fine-tuning outcomes.

entry.title: CraniMem: Cranial Inspired Gated and Bounded Memory for Agentic Systems

author.name: Pearl Mody, Mihir Panchal, Rishit Kar, Kiran Bhowmick, Ruhina Karani

entry.summary: Presents CraniMem, a neurocognitively-inspired gated memory system for LLM agents with goal-conditioned gating, bounded episodic buffer, and a structured long-term knowledge graph. Features scheduled consolidation that replays high-utility traces while pruning low-utility ones.

entry.title: HMAR: Hierarchical Modality-Aware Expert and Dynamic Routing Medical Image Retrieval Architecture

author.name: Aojie Yuan

entry.summary: HMAR proposes a hierarchical MoE-based medical image retrieval framework with dual experts for global and local feature matching, addressing limitations of uniform feature encoding in clinical retrieval.

entry.title: BrickSim: A Physics-Based Simulator for Manipulating Interlocking Brick Assemblies

author.name: Haowei Wen, Ruixuan Liu, Weiyi Piao, Siyu Li, Changliu Liu

entry.summary: Presents BrickSim, the first real-time physics-based simulator for interlocking brick (e.g., LEGO) assemblies that captures snap-fit mechanics. Uses a force-based model solved via convex QP, enabling simulation of assembly, disassembly, and structural collapse.

entry.title: Neural-Symbolic Logic Query Answering in Non-Euclidean Space

author.name: Lihui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes HYQNET, a neural-symbolic model that uses hyperbolic space for first-order logic query answering on knowledge graphs. It decomposes queries into relation projections and logical operations over fuzzy sets with a hyperbolic GNN for knowledge graph completion. Addresses the gap in capturing hierarchical structure of logical queries.

entry.title: Theoretical Foundations of Latent Posterior Factors: Formal Guarantees for Multi-Evidence Reasoning

author.name: Aliyu Agboola Alege

entry.summary: Companion theoretical paper to the LPF framework, providing formal guarantees including consistency, calibration bounds, and convergence results for multi-evidence reasoning via Latent Posterior Factors.

entry.title: Argumentative Human-AI Decision-Making: Toward AI Agents That Reason With Us, Not For Us

author.name: Stylianos Loukas Vasileiou, Antonio Rago, Francesca Toni, William Yeoh

entry.summary: Proposes that computational argumentation and LLMs should converge to enable Argumentative Human-AI Decision-Making, where agents engage in dialectical processes with contestable and revisable decisions rather than just justifying outputs.

entry.title: NeSy-Route: A Neuro-Symbolic Benchmark for Constrained Route Planning in Remote Sensing

author.name: Ming Yang, Zhi Zhou, Shi-Yu Tian, Kun-Yang Yu, Lan-Zhe Guo, Yu-Feng Li

entry.summary: Introduces NeSy-Route, a neuro-symbolic benchmark for constrained route planning in remote sensing. Features an automated data-generation framework for creating planning tasks at scale with accurate evaluation protocols.

entry.title: Domain-Independent Dynamic Programming with Constraint Propagation

author.name: Imko Marijnissen, J. Christopher Beck, Emir Demirovi\'c, Ryo Kuroiwa

entry.summary: Integrates constraint propagation from CP into domain-independent dynamic programming, enabling DP solvers to prune states and transitions using constraint propagation. Evaluated on three combinatorial optimization problems.

entry.title: XLinear: Frequency-Enhanced MLP with CrossFilter for Robust Long-Range Forecasting

author.name: Xiang Ao

entry.summary: Proposes XLinear, an MLP-based time series forecaster that uses frequency-domain operations (Enhanced Frequency Attention) and CrossFilter blocks to capture long-range dependencies while maintaining robustness to noise.

entry.title: Automated Self-Testing as a Quality Gate: Evidence-Driven Release Management for LLM Applications

author.name: Alexandre Cristov\~ao Maiorano

entry.summary: Presents an automated self-testing framework for LLM applications that implements quality gates with evidence-based release decisions (PROMOTE/HOLD/ROLLBACK), validated through 38 evaluation runs across 20+ internal releases.

entry.title: Mastering the Minority: An Uncertainty-guided Multi-Expert Framework for Challenging-tailed Sequence Learning

author.name: Ye Wang, Zixuan Wu, Lifeng Shen, Jiang Xie, Xiaoling Wang, Hong Yu, Guoyin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes UME framework for handling imbalanced sequential data using uncertainty-based multi-expert fusion with Ensemble LoRA, Dempster-Shafer theory for expert specialization, and conflict resolution mechanisms.

entry.title: Evaluating Causal Discovery Algorithms for Path-Specific Fairness and Utility in Healthcare

author.name: Nitish Nagesh, Elahe Khatibi, Thomas Hughes, Mahdi Bagheri, Pratik Gajane, Amir M. Rahmani

entry.summary: Evaluates causal discovery algorithms for path-specific fairness in healthcare, collaborating with domain experts to construct proxy ground-truth causal graphs for Alzheimer's and heart failure data.

entry.title: Something from Nothing: Data Augmentation for Robust Severity Level Estimation of Dysarthric Speech

author.name: Jaesung Bae, Xiuwen Zheng, Minje Kim, Chang D. Yoo, Mark Hasegawa-Johnson

entry.summary: Proposes a three-stage framework for dysarthric speech quality assessment using pseudo-labeling, contrastive pretraining on unlabeled data, and fine-tuning, evaluated across five unseen datasets spanning multiple languages.

entry.title: FlatLands: Generative Floormap Completion From a Single Egocentric View

author.name: Subhransu S. Bhattacharjee, Dylan Campbell, Rahul Shome

entry.summary: Introduces FlatLands, a dataset and benchmark for generating complete bird's-eye-view floor maps from a single egocentric image, containing 270K observations from 17K real indoor scenes. Compares training-free, deterministic, ensemble, and generative approaches for this task.

entry.title: RecBundle: A Next-Generation Geometric Paradigm for Explainable Recommender Systems

author.name: Hui Wang, Tianzhu Hu, Mingming Li, Xi Zhou, Chun Gan, Jiao Dai, Jizhong Han, Songlin Hu, Tao Guo

entry.summary: Introduces RecBundle, a recommender system framework using fiber bundles from differential geometry to separate topologically grounded user associations from semantically driven historical interactions, addressing information cocoon problems.

entry.title: GATS: Gaussian Aware Temporal Scaling Transformer for Invariant 4D Spatio-Temporal Point Cloud Representation

author.name: Jiayi Tian, Jiaze Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GATS, a dual invariant framework for 4D point cloud video understanding that addresses temporal scale bias and distributional uncertainty through Gaussian-aware temporal scaling and uncertainty-guided convolution.

entry.title: MemX: A Local-First Long-Term Memory System for AI Assistants

author.name: Lizheng Sun

entry.summary: Presents MemX, a local-first long-term memory system for AI assistants built in Rust with hybrid vector/keyword retrieval, RRF fusion, and confidence-based rejection, achieving 91.3% Hit@1 on Chinese-language benchmarks.

entry.title: Robust Generative Audio Quality Assessment: Disentangling Quality from Spurious Correlations

author.name: Kuan-Tang Huang, Chien-Chun Wang, Cheng-Yeh Yang, Hung-Shin Lee, Hsin-Min Wang, Berlin Chen

entry.summary: Addresses robustness of AI-generated audio quality assessment by using domain adversarial training to disentangle true quality from spurious correlations like dataset-specific signatures, investigating both metadata-driven and data-driven domain definitions.

entry.title: PlotTwist: A Creative Plot Generation Framework with Small Language Models

author.name: Abhinav Thorat, Ravi Kolla, Jyotin Goel, Niranjan Pedanekar

entry.summary: Presents PlotTwist, a framework enabling small language models (≤5B parameters) to generate creative narrative plots through structured decomposition and preference alignment.

entry.title: DanceHA: A Multi-Agent Framework for Document-Level Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Lei Wang, Min Huang, Eduard Dragut

entry.summary: Introduces DanceHA, a multi-agent framework for document-level aspect-based sentiment analysis with divide-and-conquer strategy and human-AI collaboration for annotation, releasing the Inf-ABSIA dataset.

entry.title: IOSVLM: A 3D Vision-Language Model for Unified Dental Diagnosis from Intraoral Scans

author.name: Huimin Xiong, Zijie Meng, Tianxiang Hu, Chenyi Zhou, Yang Feng, Zuozhu Liu

entry.summary: Presents IOSVLM, a 3D vision-language model for dental diagnosis from intraoral scans, using point cloud representations and addressing challenges of heterogeneous scan forms and multi-disease co-occurrence.

entry.title: Discovery of interaction and diffusion kernels in particle-to-mean-field multi-agent systems

author.name: Giacomo Albi, Alessandro Alla, Elisa Calzola

entry.summary: Proposes a data-driven framework to learn interaction kernels in stochastic multi-agent systems from trajectory data using sparse regression without prior knowledge of interaction structure.

entry.title: A Depth-Aware Comparative Study of Euclidean and Hyperbolic Graph Neural Networks on Bitcoin Transaction Systems

author.name: Ankit Ghimire, Saydul Akbar Murad, Nick Rahimi

entry.summary: Compares Euclidean and hyperbolic graph neural networks on Bitcoin transaction networks with depth-aware analysis, examining how receptive field depth interacts with embedding geometry for fraud detection.

entry.title: Trajectory-Optimized Time Reparameterization for Learning-Compatible Reduced-Order Modeling of Stiff Dynamical Systems

author.name: Joe Standridge, Daniel Livescu, Paul Cizmas

entry.summary: Studies time reparameterization as a stiffness-mitigation mechanism for neural ODE reduced-order models, enabling stable explicit integration for stiff dynamical systems.

entry.title: Bayesian Inference of Psychometric Variables From Brain and Behavior in Implicit Association Tests

author.name: Christian A. Kothe, Sean Mullen, Michael V. Bronstein, Grant Hanada, Marcelo Cicconet, Aaron N. McInnes, Tim Mullen, Marc Aafjes, Scott R. Sponheim, Alik S. Widge

entry.summary: Proposes a sparse hierarchical Bayesian model for inferring mental health psychometric variables from neural and behavioral data in Implicit Association Tests, aiming to surpass the gold-standard D-score method's limited AUC. Combines multi-modal data for prediction in small-cohort regimes.

entry.title: An Efficient Global Optimization Algorithm with Adaptive Estimates of the Local Lipschitz Constants

author.name: Danny D'Agostino

entry.summary: Presents HALO, a deterministic global optimization algorithm using adaptive local Lipschitz constant estimates to guide search. Hyperparameter-free and includes variable importance for interpretability.

entry.title: ReFORM: Review-aggregated Profile Generation via LLM with Multi-Factor Attention for Restaurant Recommendation

author.name: Moonsoo Park, Seulbeen Je, Donghyeon Park

entry.summary: Proposes ReFORM for restaurant recommendation that uses LLMs to generate factor-specific profiles from reviews (taste, service, ambiance) and combines them via multi-factor attention with graph convolution networks.

entry.title: Arabic Morphosyntactic Tagging and Dependency Parsing with Large Language Models

author.name: Mohamed Adel, Bashar Alhafni, Nizar Habash

entry.summary: Evaluates instruction-tuned LLMs on Arabic morphosyntactic tagging and dependency parsing, finding that prompt design and demonstration selection strongly affect performance. Proprietary models approach supervised baselines for feature-level tagging with retrieval-based in-context learning.

entry.title: STARK: Spatio-Temporal Attention for Representation of Keypoints for Continuous Sign Language Recognition

author.name: Suvajit Patra, Soumitra Samanta

entry.summary: Proposes STARK, a unified spatio-temporal attention network for continuous sign language recognition that models both spatial keypoint interactions and temporal dynamics efficiently, reducing parameters compared to existing approaches.

entry.title: EvoIQA - Explaining Image Distortions with Evolved White-Box Logic

author.name: Ruchika Gupta, Illya Bakurov, Nathan Haut, Wolfgang Banzhaf

entry.summary: EvoIQA uses genetic programming to evolve human-readable mathematical formulas for image quality assessment, bridging the gap between rigid hand-crafted metrics and black-box deep learning approaches.

entry.title: EPOFusion: Exposure aware Progressive Optimization Method for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion

author.name: Zhiwei Wang, Yayu Zheng, Defeng He, Li Zhao, Xiaoqin Zhang, Yuxing Li, Edmund Y. Lam

entry.summary: EPOFusion addresses overexposure in infrared-visible image fusion with an exposure-aware guidance module and iterative decoder with multiscale context fusion for progressive enhancement.

entry.title: KidsNanny: A Two-Stage Multimodal Content Moderation Pipeline Integrating Visual Classification, Object Detection, OCR, and Contextual Reasoning for Child Safety

author.name: Viraj Panchal, Tanmay Talsaniya, Parag Patel, Meet Patel

entry.summary: KidsNanny implements a two-stage content moderation pipeline for child safety combining a fast ViT+object detector visual screening (11.7ms) with OCR and a 7B language model for contextual reasoning (120ms total).

entry.title: Synergizing Deep Learning and Biological Heuristics for Extreme Long-Tail White Blood Cell Classification

author.name: Trong-Duc Nguyen, Hoang-Long Nguyen, Huy-Hieu Pham

entry.summary: A hybrid framework for rare white blood cell classification combining Pix2Pix artifact removal, Swin Transformer with MedSigLIP embeddings, and biologically-inspired morphological constraints to handle extreme class imbalance.

entry.title: FG-SGL: Fine-Grained Semantic Guidance Learning via Motion Process Decomposition for Micro-Gesture Recognition

author.name: Jinsheng Wei, Zhaodi Xu, Guanming Lu, Haoyu Chen, Jingjie Yan

entry.summary: FG-SGL framework for micro-gesture recognition integrates fine-grained semantic guidance from motion process decomposition with category-level semantics to guide vision-language models in perceiving subtle local motions.

entry.title: Micro-AU CLIP: Fine-Grained Contrastive Learning from Local Independence to Global Dependency for Micro-Expression Action Unit Detection

author.name: Jinsheng Wei, Fengzhou Guo, Yante Li, Haoyu Chen, Guanming Lu, Guoying Zhao

entry.summary: Micro-AU CLIP detects micro-expression action units by decomposing the process into local semantic alignment (capturing individual AU regions) and global dependency modeling (capturing AU co-occurrence patterns).

entry.title: 3D Fourier-based Global Feature Extraction for Hyperspectral Image Classification

author.name: Muhammad Ahmad

entry.summary: HGFNet combines 3D CNNs with GFNet-style Fourier frequency-domain filtering for hyperspectral image classification, addressing the scalability limitations of transformers while capturing full spatial-spectral dependencies.

entry.title: TinyGLASS: Real-Time Self-Supervised In-Sensor Anomaly Detection

author.name: Pietro Bonazzi, Rafael Sutter, Luigi Capogrosso, Mischa Buob, Michele Magno

entry.summary: TinyGLASS adapts the GLASS anomaly detection framework for deployment on the Sony IMX500 edge vision sensor by replacing WideResNet-50 with ResNet-18 and adding deployment optimizations. This enables real-time self-supervised industrial anomaly detection on resource-constrained hardware.

entry.title: TCATSeg: A Tooth Center-Wise Attention Network for 3D Dental Model Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Qiang He, Wentian Qu, Jiajia Dai, Changsong Lei, Shaofeng Wang, Feifei Zuo, Yajie Wang, Yaqian Liang, Xiaoming Deng, Cuixia Ma, Yong-Jin Liu, Hongan Wang

entry.summary: TCATSeg proposes a tooth center-wise attention network for 3D dental model segmentation that combines local geometric features with global semantic context through sparse superpoints, plus a new 400-model dental dataset.

entry.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning-driven Edge Offloading for Latency-constrained XR pipelines

author.name: Sourya Saha (City University of New York), Saptarshi Debroy (City University of New York)

entry.summary: Presents a deep RL-driven edge offloading framework for latency-constrained XR pipelines that jointly considers execution placement, workload quality, latency, and battery lifetime.

entry.title: Industrial cuVSLAM Benchmark & Integration

author.name: Charbel Abi Hana, Kameel Amareen, Mohamad Mostafa, Dmitry Slepichev, Hesam Rabeti, Zheng Wang, Mihir Acharya, Anthony Rizk

entry.summary: Benchmarks visual odometry and VSLAM systems for mobile robot navigation in industrial/logistical environments, finding a hybrid cuVSLAM front-end with custom SLAM back-end achieves best results.

entry.title: Faulty Coffees: Barriers to Adoption of an In-the-wild Robo-Barista

author.name: Bruce W. Wilson, David A. Robb, Mei Yii Lim, Helen Hastie, Matthew Peter Aylett, Theodoros Georgiou

entry.summary: Studies barriers to adoption of a Robo-Barista deployed in an over-50's housing complex, finding low repeat interaction due to technical breakdowns, accessibility barriers, and social dynamics.

entry.title: LIMBERO: A Limbed Climbing Exploration Robot Toward Traveling on Rocky Cliffs

author.name: Kentaro Uno, Masazumi Imai, Kazuki Takada, Teruhiro Kataonami, Yudai Matsuura, Antonin Ringeval-Meusnier, Keita Nagaoka, Mikio Eguchi, Ryo Nishibe, Kazuya Yoshida

entry.summary: Presents LIMBERO, a 10kg quadrupedal climbing robot with spine-type grippers achieving >150N grasping force for steep terrain locomotion in lunar/planetary exploration.

entry.title: Learning Whole-Body Control for a Salamander Robot

author.name: Mengze Tian, Qiyuan Fu, Chuanfang Ning, Javier Jia Jie Pey, Auke Ijspeert

entry.summary: Applies reinforcement learning to train whole-body controllers for a salamander-inspired amphibious robot, achieving sim-to-real transfer for highly articulated locomotion. This is one of the first demonstrations of learning-based controllers in amphibious environments for such robots.

entry.title: Enhancing Linguistic Generalization of VLA: Fine-Tuning OpenVLA via Synthetic Instruction Augmentation

author.name: Dongik Shin

entry.summary: Proposes fine-tuning OpenVLA (Vision-Language-Action model) with LLM-generated synthetic instruction variants to improve linguistic generalization. Uses LoRA for parameter-efficient adaptation on Bridge Dataset V2.

entry.title: From Natural Language to Executable Option Strategies via Large Language Models

author.name: Haochen Luo, Zhengzhao Lai, Junjie Xu, Yifan Li, Tang Pok Hin, Yuan Zhang, Chen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Option Query Language (OQL), a domain-specific intermediate representation for translating natural-language trading intents into executable option strategies. LLMs serve as semantic parsers to OQL, which is then deterministically executed.

entry.title: Quantum Key Distribution Secured Federated Learning for Channel Estimation and Radar Spectrum Sensing in 6G Networks

author.name: Ferhat Ozgur Catak, Murat Kuzlu, Jungwon Seo, Umit Cali

entry.summary: Presents a federated learning framework secured by quantum key distribution for wireless channel estimation and radar spectrum sensing in next-generation networks, using BB84-style protocol for secure model update aggregation.

entry.title: Spectral Property-Driven Data Augmentation for Hyperspectral Single-Source Domain Generalization

author.name: Taiqin Chen, Yifeng Wang, Xiaochen Feng, Zhilin Zhu, Hao Sha, Yingjian Li, Yongbing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes spectral property-driven data augmentation for hyperspectral image single-source domain generalization, balancing realism and diversity in augmented samples.

entry.title: Dual Stream Independence Decoupling for True Emotion Recognition under Masked Expressions

author.name: Jinsheng Wei, Xiguang Zhang, Zheng Shi, Guanming Lu

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-stream independence decoupling framework for recognizing true emotions concealed behind masked expressions, introducing an apex-frame-based paradigm instead of onset-frame analysis.

entry.title: Gaze-Aware Task Progression Detection Framework for Human-Robot Interaction Using RGB Cameras

author.name: Linlin Cheng, Koen Hindriks, Artem V. Belopolsky

entry.summary: Presents a calibration-free gaze-aware task progression detection framework for HRI using only a robot's built-in monocular RGB camera with state-of-the-art gaze estimation.

entry.title: Context-Length Robustness in Question Answering Models: A Comparative Empirical Study

author.name: Trishita Dhara, Siddhesh Sheth

entry.summary: Empirical study of context-length robustness in LLMs for question answering, using SQuAD and HotpotQA. Systematically increases irrelevant context while preserving answer-bearing signal to isolate the effect of context length from task difficulty.

entry.title: From Workflow Automation to Capability Closure: A Formal Framework for Safe and Revenue-Aware Customer Service AI

author.name: Cosimo Spera, Garima Agrawal, Riccardo De Maria

entry.summary: Applies the non-compositionality of safety result to customer service AI, showing how networks of specialized AI agents can create emergent safety gaps through conjunctive dependencies. Companion paper to the formal safety non-compositionality proof.

entry.title: Follow the Clues, Frame the Truth: Hybrid-evidential Deductive Reasoning in Open-Vocabulary Multimodal Emotion Recognition

author.name: Yu Liu, Lei Zhang, Haoxun Li, Hanlei Shi, Yuxuan Ding, Leyuan Qu, Taihao Li

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid-evidential deductive reasoning framework for open-vocabulary multimodal emotion recognition, addressing the bottleneck of premature commitment to dominant data priors in MLLMs by synthesizing multiple evidence-grounded rationales.

entry.title: Learning to Present: Inverse Specification Rewards for Agentic Slide Generation

author.name: Karthik Ragunath Ananda Kumar, Subrahmanyam Arunachalam

entry.summary: Proposes an RL environment where LLM agents learn to generate HTML slide presentations through tool use, with a novel 'inverse specification reward' that measures how well generated slides convey their intended purpose by having an LLM try to recover the original specification.

entry.title: Evidential Domain Adaptation for Remaining Useful Life Prediction with Incomplete Degradation

author.name: Yubo Hou, Mohamed Ragab, Yucheng Wang, Min Wu, Abdulla Alseiari, Chee-Keong Kwoh, Xiaoli Li, Zhenghua Chen

entry.summary: Addresses remaining useful life prediction under incomplete degradation trajectories using evidential domain adaptation, tackling the extrapolation challenge when target domain lacks late degradation stages.

entry.title: Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Medical AI

author.name: Tin Hoang

entry.summary: Investigates privacy-preserving federated learning for Alzheimer's classification using 3D MRI data, introducing site-aware data partitioning and adaptive local differential privacy mechanisms.

entry.title: Diffusion Models for Joint Audio-Video Generation

author.name: Alejandro Paredes La Torre

entry.summary: Explores joint audio-video generation using diffusion models, releasing two paired audio-video datasets (13h gaming, 64h concerts) and training MM-Diffusion architecture, also investigating joint latent spaces.

entry.title: Age Predictors Through the Lens of Generalization, Bias Mitigation, and Interpretability: Reflections on Causal Implications

author.name: Debdas Paul, Elisa Ferrari, Irene Gravili, Alessandro Cellerino

entry.summary: Studies out-of-distribution generalization in chronological age predictors, connecting bias mitigation, causal confounders, and fairness through adversarial representation learning, demonstrated on mouse transcriptomic data.

entry.title: CD-FKD: Cross-Domain Feature Knowledge Distillation for Robust Single-Domain Generalization in Object Detection

author.name: Junseok Lee, Sungho Shin, Seongju Lee, Kyoobin Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Cross-Domain Feature Knowledge Distillation (CD-FKD) for single-domain generalization in object detection, using diversified data and global/instance-wise feature distillation.

entry.title: Data-driven generalized perimeter control: Z\"urich case study

author.name: Alessio Rimoldi, Carlo Cenedese, Alberto Padoan, Florian D\"orfler, John Lygeros

entry.summary: Proposes data-driven traffic control using behavioral systems theory and data-enabled predictive control for dynamic traffic light management, validated on a high-fidelity Zürich simulation.

entry.title: Long-Horizon Traffic Forecasting via Incident-Aware Conformal Spatio-Temporal Transformers

author.name: Mayur Patil, Qadeer Ahmed, Shawn Midlam-Mohler, Stephanie Marik, Allen Sheldon, Rajeev Chhajer, Nithin Santhanam

entry.summary: Applies spatio-temporal transformers with adaptive conformal prediction for multi-horizon traffic forecasting using Ohio DOT data, incorporating incident-aware adjacency matrices and uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Advancing Visual Reliability: Color-Accurate Underwater Image Enhancement for Real-Time Underwater Missions

author.name: Yiqiang Zhou, Yifan Chen, Zhe Sun, Jijun Lu, Ye Zheng, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Presents a real-time underwater image enhancement framework with accurate color restoration using adaptive weighted channel compensation and lightweight architecture suitable for deployment on underwater devices.

entry.title: Cross-modal learning for plankton recognition

author.name: Joona Kareinen, Veikka Immonen, Tuomas Eerola, Lumi Haraguchi, Lasse Lensu, Kaisa Kraft, Sanna Suikkanen, Heikki K\"alvi\"ainen

entry.summary: Explores self-supervised cross-modal coordination using image and optical measurement data (scatter/fluorescence) for plankton recognition, leveraging unlabeled multi-modal data to reduce dependency on labeled training sets.

entry.title: On the Transfer of Collinearity to Computer Vision

author.name: Frederik Beuth, Danny Kowerko

entry.summary: Explores transferring the human visual perception principle of collinearity (amplification of spatially aligned edges) to computer vision applications, developing a prototype model and testing across four use cases.

entry.title: vAccSOL: Efficient and Transparent AI Vision Offloading for Mobile Robots

author.name: Adam Zahir, Michele Gucciardom Falk Selker, Anastasios Nanos, Kostis Papazafeiropoulos, Carlos J. Bernardos, Nicolas Weber, Roberto Gonzalez

entry.summary: vAccSOL presents a framework for efficient and transparent AI vision workload execution across heterogeneous robotic and edge platforms, combining a neural network compiler with accelerator integration.

entry.title: Dexterous grasp data augmentation based on grasp synthesis with fingertip workspace cloud and contact-aware sampling

author.name: Liqi Wu, Haoyu Jia, Kento Kawaharazuka, Hirokazu Ishida, Kei Okada

entry.summary: Proposes a teleoperation-based framework for collecting grasp demonstrations, augmented by FSG, a fingertip-contact-aware sampling-based grasp generator. Aims to address the data bottleneck in training dexterous grasping across diverse hand structures.

entry.title: I made a job-level AI capability estimator by asking "Where is AI doing similar work today?"

author.name: Alex A

entry.summary: Describes a tool built on the Anthropic Economic Index that estimates AI capability across occupations using semantic similarity of task descriptions and cross-occupation capability transfer. Uses vector embeddings to find analogous tasks where AI is already being used.

entry.title: The Comprehension-Gated Agent Economy: A Robustness-First Architecture for AI Economic Agency

author.name: Rahul Baxi

entry.summary: Introduces CGAE, a formal architecture for gating AI agents' economic permissions based on verified comprehension functions derived from adversarial robustness audits, rather than capability benchmarks. Operates over three robustness dimensions: constraint compliance, epistemic integrity, and behavioral alignment.

entry.title: Prose2Policy (P2P): A Practical LLM Pipeline for Translating Natural-Language Access Policies into Executable Rego

author.name: Vatsal Gupta, Darshan Sreenivasamurthy

entry.summary: Presents Prose2Policy (P2P), an LLM-based pipeline that translates natural-language access control policies into executable Rego code for Open Policy Agent. Achieves 95.3% compile rate with automated testing.

entry.title: Prompt Engineering for Scale Development in Generative Psychometrics

author.name: Lara Lee Russell-Lasalandra, Hudson Golino

entry.summary: Monte Carlo simulation study examining how prompt engineering strategies affect LLM-generated personality assessment items within the AI-GENIE framework. Finds adaptive prompting produces highest quality items, with prompt design substantially influencing both pre- and post-reduction item quality.

entry.title: Proactive Rejection and Grounded Execution: A Dual-Stage Intent Analysis Paradigm for Safe and Efficient AIoT Smart Homes

author.name: Xinxin Jin, Zhengwei Ni, Zhengguo Sheng, Victor C. M. Leung

entry.summary: Proposes a Dual-Stage Intent-Aware Framework for safe and efficient LLM-based IoT smart home control. Stage 1 acts as a semantic firewall filtering infeasible commands (entity hallucinations), while Stage 2 handles physical execution.

entry.title: Learning to Predict, Discover, and Reason in High-Dimensional Discrete Event Sequences

author.name: Hugo Math

entry.summary: Applies NLP-inspired techniques to automotive diagnostic trouble code (DTC) sequences, treating the tens-of-thousands of unique DTCs as a vocabulary for prediction, discovery, and reasoning about vehicle health.

entry.title: Designing for Disagreement: Front-End Guardrails for Assistance Allocation in LLM-Enabled Robots

author.name: Carmen Ng

entry.summary: Proposes bounded calibration with contestability, a front-end guardrail pattern for LLM-enabled robots making assistance allocation decisions. Constrains prioritization to governance-approved modes with legible reasoning and contest pathways.

entry.title: Finder: A Multimodal AI-Powered Search Framework for Pharmaceutical Data Retrieval

author.name: Suyash Mishra, Srikanth Patil, Satyanarayan Pati, Sagar Sahu, Baddu Narendra

entry.summary: Presents Finder, an AI-powered multimodal search framework for pharmaceutical data retrieval using hybrid vector search across text, images, audio, and video. Has processed over 291K documents across 98 languages.

entry.title: Quantum Amplitude Estimation for Catastrophe Insurance Tail-Risk Pricing: Empirical Convergence and NISQ Noise Analysis

author.name: Alexis Kirke

entry.summary: Validates quantum amplitude estimation for catastrophe insurance tail-risk pricing via simulation, demonstrating quadratic speedup over classical Monte Carlo for resolving upper-tail loss distribution percentiles.

entry.title: Collaborative Temporal Feature Generation via Critic-Free Reinforcement Learning for Cross-User Sensor-Based Activity Recognition

author.name: Xiaozhou Ye, Feng Jiang, Zihan Wang, Xiulai Wang, Yutao Zhang, Kevin I-Kai Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CTFG, a framework using reinforcement learning and Transformer-based autoregressive generation for cross-user human activity recognition from wearable sensors, addressing domain generalization without target-domain annotations.

entry.title: RepoReviewer: A Local-First Multi-Agent Architecture for Repository-Level Code Review

author.name: Peng Zhang

entry.summary: Presents RepoReviewer, a local-first multi-agent system for automated GitHub repository-level code review, decomposing review into acquisition, context synthesis, file analysis, prioritization, and summary generation.

entry.title: Human/AI Collective Intelligence for Deliberative Democracy: A Human-Centred Design Approach

author.name: Anna De Liddo, Lucas Anastasiou, Simon Buckingham Shum

entry.summary: Proposes a human-centred design approach for AI-augmented deliberative democracy, using co-design methodology to identify challenges and derive technical implications for collective intelligence systems.

entry.title: An Interpretable Machine Learning Framework for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Drug Response Analysis

author.name: Ann Rachel, Pranav M Pawar, Mithun Mukharjee, Raja M, Tojo Mathew

entry.summary: Develops interpretable ML framework for non-small cell lung cancer drug response analysis using multi-omics data for personalized treatment plans based on genetic profiles.

entry.title: Explainable machine learning workflows for radio astronomical data processing

author.name: S. Yatawatta, A. Ahmadi, B. Asabere, M. Iacobelli, N. Peters, M. Veldhuis

entry.summary: Proposes combining fuzzy rule-based inference with deep learning for explainable ML workflows in radio astronomy data processing, specifically for calibration tasks.

entry.title: Toward Experimentation-as-a-Service in 5G/6G: The Plaza6G Prototype for AI-Assisted Trials

author.name: Sergio Barrachina-Mu\~noz, Marc Carrascosa-Zamacois, Horacio Bleda, Umair Riaz, Yasir Maqsood, Xavier Calle, Selva V\'ia, Miquel Payar\'o, Josep Mangues-Bafalluy

entry.summary: Presents Plaza6G, an Experiment-as-a-Service platform integrating cloud compute with 5G/6G infrastructure, enhanced with an LLM-based assistant using RAG for experiment design in natural language.

entry.title: Prior-Informed Neural Network Initialization: A Spectral Approach for Function Parameterizing Architectures

author.name: David Orlando Salazar Torres, Diyar Altinses, Andreas Schwung

entry.summary: Proposes prior-informed neural network initialization using FFT-derived spectral structure for function parameterization architectures like Bag-of-Functions.

entry.title: Improving Generative Adversarial Network Generalization for Facial Expression Synthesis

author.name: Arbish Akram, Nazar Khan, Arif Mahmood

entry.summary: Presents RegGAN for facial expression synthesis that learns intermediate representations via ridge regression to improve generalization beyond training distribution, then refines with adversarial training.

entry.title: PyPhonPlan: Simulating phonetic planning with dynamic neural fields and task dynamics

author.name: Sam Kirkham

entry.summary: Introduces PyPhonPlan, a Python toolkit for implementing dynamical models of phonetic planning using coupled dynamic neural fields and task dynamics, with production/perception loop simulations.

entry.title: Semi-supervised Latent Disentangled Diffusion Model for Textile Pattern Generation

author.name: Chenggong Hu, Yi Wang, Mengqi Xue, Haofei Zhang, Jie Song, Li Sun

entry.summary: SLDDM-TPG proposes a semi-supervised latent disentangled diffusion model for textile pattern generation from clothing images, separating pattern features from non-rigid texture distortions.

entry.title: When Rolling Gets Weird: A Curved-Link Tensegrity Robot for Non-Intuitive Behavior

author.name: Lauren Ervin, Harish Bezawada, Vishesh Vikas

entry.summary: Presents a semi-circular curved-link tensegrity robot that balances efficient rolling locomotion with controlled stability for space exploration terrain navigation.

entry.title: Scalable Inspection Planning via Flow-based Mixed Integer Linear Programming

author.name: Adir Morgan, Kiril Solovey, Oren Salzman

entry.summary: Proposes a flow-based MILP formulation for scalable robot inspection planning that simultaneously handles point-of-interest coverage and path connectivity. Demonstrates orders-of-magnitude improvements in scalability over existing approaches.

entry.title: Featurized Occupation Measures for Structured Global Search in Numerical Optimal Control

author.name: Qi Wei, Jianfeng Tao, Haoyang Tan, Hongyu Nie

entry.summary: Introduces Featurized Occupation Measures (FOM), a finite-dimensional framework that bridges trajectory optimization and global HJB-type certification in optimal control. Proves asymptotic consistency and demonstrates numerical feasibility on benchmark problems.

entry.title: Population Annealing as a Discrete-Time Schr\"odinger Bridge

author.name: Masayuki Ohzeki

entry.summary: Reinterprets Population Annealing through the lens of the Schrödinger Bridge problem, showing the reweighting step can be derived from analytically solving the Schrödinger system and identifying thermodynamic work as the optimal control potential.

entry.title: There is No One There: A simple experiment to convince yourself that LLMs probably are not conscious

author.name: Peter Kuhn

entry.summary: Proposes a simple experiment to test LLM consciousness: probing whether LLMs maintain consistent internal representational spaces when discussing their mental states. Argues the results suggest LLM self-reports don't refer to coherent inner experience.

entry.title: Resilience Meets Autonomy: Governing Embodied AI in Critical Infrastructure

author.name: Puneet Sharma, Christer Henrik Pursiainen

entry.summary: Argues that embodied AI resilience in critical infrastructure depends on bounded autonomy within a hybrid governance architecture. Maps four oversight modes to critical infrastructure sectors based on task complexity and risk. Draws on EU AI Act and ISO standards.

entry.title: A Context Alignment Pre-processor for Enhancing the Coherence of Human-LLM Dialog

author.name: Ding Wei

entry.summary: Proposes a Context Alignment Pre-processor (C.A.P.) module that sits between user input and LLM response generation to handle contextual misalignment in dialogue, addressing cases where users omit premises, simplify references, or shift context.

entry.title: Exploring different approaches to customize language models for domain-specific text-to-code generation

author.name: Lu\'is Freire, Fernanda A. Andal\'o, Nicki Skafte Detlefsen

entry.summary: Investigates how smaller open-source language models can be adapted for domain-specific code generation using synthetic datasets across Python, Scikit-learn, and OpenCV domains. Compares RAG, fine-tuning, and other adaptation methods.

entry.title: SAC-NeRF: Adaptive Ray Sampling for Neural Radiance Fields via Soft Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chenyu Ge

entry.summary: Applies Soft Actor-Critic reinforcement learning to learn adaptive ray sampling policies for NeRF, formulating sampling as an MDP to improve computational efficiency of volume rendering.

entry.title: Interpretative Interfaces: Designing for AI-Mediated Reading Practices and the Knowledge Commons

author.name: Gabrielle Benabdallah

entry.summary: Argues for a shift from XAI explainability to interpretative engagement, where scientists can directly manipulate and probe how LLMs process texts rather than passively receiving explanations of system behavior.

entry.title: The Internet of Physical AI Agents: Interoperability, Longevity, and the Cost of Getting It Wrong

author.name: Roberto Morabito, Mallik Tatipamula

entry.summary: Discusses the evolution toward an Internet of Physical AI Agents that can perceive, reason, and act in real-time, identifying challenges around interoperability, longevity, and security that need to be addressed.

entry.title: Structure-Aware Multimodal LLM Framework for Trustworthy Near-Field Beam Prediction

author.name: Mengyuan Li, Qianfan Lu, Jiachen Tian, Hongjun Hu, Yu Han, Xiao Li, Chao-kai Wen, Shi Jin

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-driven multimodal framework for near-field beam prediction in XL-MIMO systems, fusing GPS, RGB, LiDAR, and text prompts to address the challenges of near-field spherical wavefront propagation.

entry.title: CoMAI: A Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Robust and Equitable Interview Evaluation

author.name: Gengxin Sun, Ruihao Yu, Liangyi Yin, Yunqi Yang, Bin Zhang, Zhiwei Xu

entry.summary: Presents CoMAI, a multi-agent interview evaluation framework with specialized agents for question generation, security, scoring, and summarization, coordinated through a finite-state machine architecture.

entry.title: RASLF: Representation-Aware State Space Model for Light Field Super-Resolution

author.name: Zeqiang Wei, Kai Jin, Kuan Song, Xiuzhuang Zhou, Wenlong Chen, Min Xu

entry.summary: Proposes RASLF, a state-space model framework for light field super-resolution that models structural correlations across multiple light field representations with progressive geometric refinement.

entry.title: LenghuSky-8: An 8-Year All-Sky Cloud Dataset with Star-Aware Masks and Alt-Az Calibration for Segmentation and Nowcasting

author.name: Yicheng Rui, Xiao-Wei Duan, Licai Deng, Fan Yang, Zhengming Dang, Zhengjun Du, Junhao Peng, Wenhao Chu, Umut Mahmut, Kexin Li, Yiyun Wu, Fabo Feng

entry.summary: Presents LenghuSky-8, an 8-year all-sky imaging dataset from an astronomical site with 429K frames, star-aware cloud masks, and per-pixel calibration, along with cloud segmentation using DINOv3 features.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Counteracts Delayed CSI in Multi-Satellite Systems

author.name: Marios Aristodemou, Yasaman Omid, Sangarapillai Lambotharan, Mahsa Derakhshan, Lajos Hanzo

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm for downlink satellite communication to maximize sum-rate while coping with delayed/outdated channel state information.

entry.title: DST-Net: A Dual-Stream Transformer with Illumination-Independent Feature Guidance and Multi-Scale Spatial Convolution for Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Yicui Shi, Yuhan Chen, Xiangfei Huang, Zhenguo Wang, Wenxuan Yu, Ying Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-stream transformer for low-light image enhancement combining illumination-independent feature guidance with multi-scale spatial convolutions.

entry.title: Data-driven forced response analysis with min-max representations of nonlinear restoring forces

author.name: Akira Saito, Hiromu Fujita

entry.summary: Proposes a data-driven method for identifying nonlinear restoring forces in mechanical systems using piecewise linear springs as activation functions in a neural network framework.

entry.title: Robust Language Identification for Romansh Varieties

author.name: Charlotte Model, Sina Ahmadi, Jannis Vamvas

entry.summary: Develops an SVM-based language identification system for Romansh idioms (regional varieties), achieving 97% in-domain accuracy on a newly curated benchmark.

entry.title: Is Semi-Automatic Transcription Useful in Corpus Creation? Preliminary Considerations on the KIParla Corpus

author.name: Martina Simonotti, Ludovica Pannitto, Eleonora Zucchini, Silvia Ballar\`e, Caterina Mauri

entry.summary: Analyzes implementing ASR into the transcription workflow of a spoken Italian corpus, finding that ASR-assisted workflows increase speed but don't consistently improve accuracy, with effects depending on conversation type and annotator experience.

entry.title: Spectral Hierarchy of the Cosmic Web

author.name: Francisco-Shu Kitaura, Francesco Sinigaglia

entry.summary: Introduces a spectral hierarchy of cosmic-web classifications using scale-weighting kernels applied to density fields before eigenvalue-based classification, unifying several existing web definitions.

entry.title: Compact Optical Single-axis Joint Torque Sensor Using Redundant Photo-Reflectors and Quadratic-Programming Calibration

author.name: Hyun-Bin Kim, Byeong-Il Ham, Kyung-Soo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a compact optical torque sensor using redundant photo-reflectors with quadratic-programming calibration for collaborative robot joint-level torque control.

entry.title: ASCENT: Transformer-Based Aircraft Trajectory Prediction in Non-Towered Terminal Airspace

author.name: Alexander Prutsch, David Schinagl, Horst Possegger

entry.summary: Introduces ASCENT, a lightweight transformer-based model for multi-modal 3D aircraft trajectory prediction in non-towered airspace, integrating domain-aware 3D normalization. Outperforms prior baselines on TrajAir and TartanAviation datasets.

entry.title: Bayesian-guided inverse design of hyperelastic microstructures: Application to stochastic metamaterials

author.name: Hooman Danesh, Henning Wessels

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian-guided inverse design framework for finding microstructures that achieve target macroscopic stress responses, using statistical feature engineering and efficient Bayesian optimization to minimize expensive oracle queries.

entry.title: Routing and Control for Marine Oil-Spill Cleanup with a Boom-Towing Vessel Fleet

author.name: Snir Carmeli, Adir Morgan, Kiril Solovey

entry.summary: Presents a multi-robot coordination framework for oil-spill cleanup using autonomous surface vehicle duos with towed booms. Addresses the gap between single-slick approaches and realistic multi-spill incidents requiring fleet-level coordination.

entry.title: Quantum-Secure-By-Construction (QSC): A Paradigm Shift For Post-Quantum Agentic Intelligence

author.name: Arit Kumar Bishwas, Mousumi Sen, Albert Nieto-Morales, Joel Jacob Varghese

entry.summary: Introduces the Quantum-Secure-By-Construction (QSC) paradigm that treats quantum-secure communication as a core architectural property of agentic AI systems rather than a later upgrade. Combines post-quantum cryptography, quantum random number generation, and quantum key distribution.

entry.title: Interpretable Context Methodology: Folder Structure as Agentic Architecture

author.name: Jake Van Clief, David McDermott

entry.summary: Proposes Model Workspace Protocol (MWP), replacing framework-level agent orchestration with filesystem structure: numbered folders as stages, markdown files as prompts, local scripts for mechanical work. A minimalist approach for sequential AI workflows.

entry.title: What if Pinocchio Were a Reinforcement Learning Agent: A Normative End-to-End Pipeline

author.name: Beno\^it Alcaraz

entry.summary: Thesis presenting PINO, a hybrid model where RL agents are supervised by argumentation-based normative advisors, enabling norm-compliant and context-aware agent behavior. Builds on AJAR, Jiminy, and NGRL architectures.

entry.title: OrthoAI v2: From Single-Agent Segmentation to Dual-Agent Treatment Planning for Clear Aligners

author.name: Lansiaux Edouard, Leman Margaux

entry.summary: Presents OrthoAI v2, an open-source pipeline for AI-assisted orthodontic treatment planning with clear aligners, extending a prior system with dual-agent architecture for segmentation and landmark detection.

entry.title: PhasorFlow: A Python Library for Unit Circle Based Computing

author.name: Dibakar Sigdel, Namuna Panday

entry.summary: Presents PhasorFlow, a Python library implementing computation on the unit circle using complex phasors, with a 22-gate library and applications to classification tasks.

entry.title: Homogeneous and Heterogeneous Consistency progressive Re-ranking for Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification

author.name: Yiming Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a progressive re-ranking method for visible-infrared person re-identification with heterogeneous and homogeneous consistency modules to address cross-modal matching challenges.

entry.title: Surrogate-Assisted Genetic Programming with Rank-Based Phenotypic Characterisation for Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling

author.name: Yuan Tian, Yi Mei, Mengjie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a surrogate-assisted genetic programming approach for dynamic multi-mode project scheduling with a novel rank-based phenotypic characterisation scheme to reduce simulation-based evaluation costs.

entry.title: A Human-Centred Architecture for Large Language Models-Cognitive Assistants in Manufacturing within Quality Management Systems

author.name: Marcos Galdino, Johanna Grahl, Tobias Hamann, Anas Abdelrazeq, Ingrid Isenhardt

entry.summary: Proposes a human-centred architecture for integrating LLM-based cognitive assistants into manufacturing quality management systems, validated through iterative expert focus groups.

entry.title: FSMC-Pose: Frequency and Spatial Fusion with Multiscale Self-calibration for Cattle Mounting Pose Estimation

author.name: Fangjing Li, Zhihai Wang, Xinxin Ding, Haiyang Liu, Ronghua Gao, Rong Wang, Yao Zhu, Ming Jin

entry.summary: Presents FSMC-Pose, a pose estimation framework for cattle mounting behavior detection using frequency-spatial fusion and multiscale self-calibration. Targets estrus detection in dairy farming.

entry.title: Machine Translation in the Wild: User Reaction to Xiaohongshu's Built-In Translation Feature

entry.title: AI-Generated Figures in Academic Publishing: Policies, Tools, and Practical Guidelines
