entry.summary: Proposes Atsuko, a multimodal emotion recognition system using orthogonal multi-scale band decomposition and expert collaboration to model fine-grained complementary features across text, video, and audio modalities.

entry.title: TennisExpert: Towards Expert-Level Analytical Sports Video Understanding

author.name: Zhaoyu Liu, Xi Weng, Lianyu Hu, Zhe Hou, Kan Jiang, Jin Song Dong, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces TennisVL, a large-scale tennis benchmark with 200+ matches (471.9 hours) and 40K+ rally clips for expert-level sports video understanding, going beyond descriptive play-by-play to analytical commentary.

entry.title: LibraGen: Playing a Balance Game in Subject-Driven Video Generation

author.name: Jiahao Zhu, Shanshan Lao, Lijie Liu, Gen Li, Tianhao Qi, Wei Han, Bingchuan Li, Fangfang Liu, Zhuowei Chen, Tianxiang Ma, Qian HE, Yi Zhou, Xiaohua Xie

entry.summary: Proposes LibraGen for subject-driven video generation that balances intrinsic VGFM qualities (motion, aesthetics) with subject fidelity. Identifies data quality as key 'fulcrum' and uses training strategies to maintain balance.

entry.title: SAIF: A Stability-Aware Inference Framework for Medical Image Segmentation with Segment Anything Model

author.name: Ke Wu, Shiqi Chen, Yiheng Zhong, Hengxian Liu, Yingxue Su, Yifang Wang, Junhao Jin, Guangyu Ren

entry.summary: Proposes SAIF, a training-free plug-and-play framework that improves SAM's inference stability for medical image segmentation by modeling prompt and threshold uncertainty through structured perturbations and stability-aware scoring.

entry.title: LingoMotion: An Interpretable and Unambiguous Symbolic Representation for Human Motion

author.name: Yao Zhang, Zhuchenyang Liu, Yu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes LingoMotion, a symbolic motion representation inspired by natural language structure, defining motion alphabets from joint angles, morphology for actions and attributes, and syntax for complex sequences.

entry.title: Sky2Ground: A Benchmark for Site Modeling under Varying Altitude

author.name: Zengyan Wang, Sirshapan Mitra, Rajat Modi, Grace Lim, Yogesh Rawat

entry.summary: Introduces Sky2Ground, a three-view dataset (satellite, aerial, ground) for varying-altitude camera localization and reconstruction across 51 sites. Benchmarks state-of-art pose estimation and reveals performance degradation with satellite imagery.

entry.title: IMS3: Breaking Distributional Aggregation in Diffusion-Based Dataset Distillation

author.name: Chenru Wang, Yunyi Chen, Zijun Yang, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes IMS3 for diffusion-based dataset distillation, addressing distributional aggregation where diffusion models over-concentrate in high-density regions and neglect boundary samples crucial for classification.

entry.title: Towards Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Real Distribution Bias Correction

author.name: Ming-Hui Liu, Harry Cheng, Xin Luo, Xin-Shun Xu, Mohan S. Kankanhalli

entry.summary: Proposes RDBC framework for generalizable deepfake detection exploiting the invariance of real data distribution, using real population distribution estimation and distribution-sampled feature whitening.

entry.title: Effective Feature Learning for 3D Medical Registration via Domain-Specialized DINO Pretraining

author.name: Eytan Kats, Mattias P. Heinrich

entry.summary: Investigates DINO-style self-supervised pretraining directly on 3D medical images for deformable registration, demonstrating improved performance on interpatient abdominal registration across MRI and CT.

entry.title: OAHuman: Occlusion-Aware 3D Human Reconstruction from Monocular Images

author.name: Yuanwang Yang, Hongliang Liu, Muxin Zhang, Nan Ma, Jingyu Yang, Yu-Kun Lai, Kun Li

entry.summary: OAHuman addresses occlusion-aware 3D human reconstruction from monocular images by decoupling geometry reconstruction and texture synthesis for robust handling of real-world occlusions.

entry.title: Personalized Cell Segmentation: Benchmark and Framework for Reference-Guided Cell Type Segmentation

author.name: Bisheng Wang, Jaime S. Cardoso, Lin Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Personalized Cell Segmentation (PerCS) task and benchmark, where the goal is to segment all cells of a specific type given a reference cell, with a DINOv2-based solution.

entry.title: Unlocking the Latent Canvas: Eliciting and Benchmarking Symbolic Visual Expression in LLMs

author.name: Yiren Zheng, Shibo Li, Jiaming Liu, Haofan Wang, Yiren Song

entry.summary: Explores using ASCII art to benchmark and elicit symbolic visual expression capabilities of LLMs, introducing SVE-ASCII framework and ASCIIArt-7K dataset.

entry.title: Fractal Autoregressive Depth Estimation with Continuous Token Diffusion

author.name: Jinchang Zhang, Xinrou Kang, Guoyu Lu

entry.summary: Proposes fractal visual autoregressive diffusion for monocular depth estimation, combining coarse-to-fine generation with continuous token diffusion and multi-scale conditioning.

entry.title: AnyPhoto: Multi-Person Identity Preserving Image Generation with ID Adaptive Modulation on Location Canvas

author.name: Longhui Yuan

entry.summary: AnyPhoto generates multi-person identity-preserving images using RoPE-aligned location canvas, identity-adaptive modulation, and identity-isolated attention to bind multiple faces to specified locations.

entry.title: M2IR: Proactive All-in-One Image Restoration via Mamba-style Modulation and Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Shiwei Wang, Yongzhen Wang, Bingwen Hu, Liyan Zhang, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Mingqiang Wei

entry.summary: M2IR proposes proactive all-in-one image restoration using Mamba-style modulation for degradation suppression and mixture-of-experts for efficient decoding.

entry.title: PASTE: Physics-Aware Scattering Topology Embedding Framework for SAR Object Detection

author.name: Jiacheng Chen, Yuxuan Xiong, Haipeng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PASTE, a physics-aware framework for SAR object detection that embeds electromagnetic scattering topology information into deep learning detectors rather than treating SAR targets as simple texture patches.

entry.title: Learning from Limited and Incomplete Data: A Multimodal Framework for Predicting Pathological Response in NSCLC

author.name: Alice Natalina Caragliano, Giulia Farina, Fatih Aksu, Camillo Maria Caruso, Claudia Tacconi, Carlo Greco, Lorenzo Nibid, Edy Ippolito, Michele Fiore, Giuseppe Perrone, Sara Ramella, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal deep learning framework for predicting pathological response in NSCLC using foundation model-based CT features and a missing-aware architecture for incomplete clinical data.

entry.title: DAIT: Distillation from Vision-Language Models to Lightweight Classifiers with Adaptive Intermediate Teacher Transfer

author.name: Zhengxu He, Jun Li, Zhijian Wu

entry.summary: Proposes DAIT for distilling VLM knowledge to lightweight classifiers via adaptive intermediate teacher transfer, addressing architectural misalignment between large VLMs and compact students.

entry.title: Oscillating Dispersion for Maximal Light-throughput Spectral Imaging

author.name: Jiuyun Zhang, Zhan Shi, Linsen Chen, Xun Cao

entry.summary: Develops ODIS, an oscillating dispersion imaging spectrometer achieving near-full light throughput by axially translating a disperser, paired with a deep unfolding network for spectral recovery.

entry.title: Real-Time Human Frontal View Synthesis from a Single Image

author.name: Fangyu Lin, Yingdong Hu, Lunjie Zhu, Zhening Liu, Yushi Huang, Zehong Lin, Jun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PrismMirror for real-time human frontal view synthesis from a single image, using geometry-guided framework that avoids external geometry models for efficient inference.

entry.title: Real-Time Oriented Object Detection Transformer in Remote Sensing Images

author.name: Zeyu Ding, Yong Zhou, Jiaqi Zhao, Wen-Liang Du, Xixi Li, Rui Yao, Abdulmotaleb El Saddik

entry.summary: Proposes the first real-time end-to-end oriented object detection transformer for remote sensing, with angle distribution refinement for handling arbitrary rotations.

entry.title: Learning Latent Proxies for Controllable Single-Image Relighting

author.name: Haoze Zheng, Zihao Wang, Xianfeng Wu, Yajing Bai, Yexin Liu, Yun Li, Xiaogang Xu, Harry Yang

entry.summary: Proposes learning latent proxies for single-image relighting that replace full intrinsic decomposition with sparse physically-meaningful cues to guide a diffusion model. This reduces supervision requirements while maintaining fine-grained control over lighting direction, intensity, and color.

entry.title: REAEDP: Entropy-Calibrated Differentially Private Data Release with Formal Guarantees and Attack-Based Evaluation

author.name: Bo Ma, Jinsong Wu, Wei Qi Yan

entry.summary: REAEDP is a differential privacy framework combining entropy-calibrated histogram release, synthetic data generation, and attack-based evaluation. Derives sensitivity bounds for Shannon and Rényi entropy for adjacent histogram datasets.

entry.title: MorphSNN: Adaptive Graph Diffusion and Structural Plasticity for Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Yongsheng Huang, Peibo Duan, Yujie Wu, Kai Sun, Zhipeng Liu, Jiaxiang Liu, Guangyu Li, Changsheng Zhang, Bin Zhang, Mingkun Xu

entry.summary: MorphSNN introduces graph diffusion and structural plasticity mechanisms into spiking neural networks, enabling brain-like lateral interactions and dynamic connectivity adaptation beyond fixed hierarchical architectures.

entry.title: LDHP: Library-Driven Hierarchical Planning for Non-prehensile Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Tierui He, Chao Zhao

entry.summary: LDHP is a library-driven hierarchical planner for non-prehensile dexterous manipulation that makes executability a first-class design goal, using MoveObject and AdjustGrasp primitives with feasibility certification.

entry.title: Navigation beyond Wayfinding: Robots Collaborating with Visually Impaired Users for Environmental Interactions

author.name: Shaojun Cai, Nuwan Janaka, Ashwin Ram, Janidu Shehan, Yingjia Wan, Kotaro Hara, David Hsu

entry.summary: Extends robotic guide dog systems beyond wayfinding to support environmental interactions for blind/visually impaired users, enabling collaborative manipulation tasks like pressing elevator buttons and pulling out chairs.

entry.title: CyboRacket: A Perception-to-Action Framework for Humanoid Racket Sports

author.name: Peng Ren, Chuan Qi, Haoyang Ge, Qiyuan Su, Xuguo He, Cong Huang, Pei Chi, Jiang Zhao, Kai Chen

entry.summary: CyboRacket is a hierarchical perception-to-action framework for humanoid racket sports that integrates onboard visual perception, physics-based trajectory prediction, and pre-trained whole-body control. Unlike prior systems, it avoids reliance on external motion capture.

entry.title: ReMAP-DP: Reprojected Multi-view Aligned PointMaps for Diffusion Policy

author.name: Xinzhang Yang, Renjun Wu, Jinyan Liu, Xuesong Li

entry.summary: ReMAP-DP combines standardized perspective reprojection with a dual-stream diffusion policy that fuses semantic features and geometric descriptors for robot manipulation. Addresses the gap between 2D semantic reasoning and 3D spatial awareness in generalist robot policies.

entry.title: Coupled Particle Filters for Robust Affordance Estimation

author.name: Patrick Lowin, Vito Mengers, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Proposes coupled particle filters for robotic affordance estimation that uses two recursive estimators for graspable and movable regions. The coupling enables bidirectional information exchange, achieving 245-308% precision improvement over recent baselines.

entry.title: The bitter lesson for software

author.name: zef

entry.summary: Argues that software's core function is encoding information flows into deterministic code, and that AI agents represent a fundamental shift by handling information flows with natural complexity rather than requiring rigid data structures. Draws parallel to Sutton's 'Bitter Lesson.'

entry.title: Multi-hop Reasoning and Retrieval in Embedding Space: Leveraging Large Language Models with Knowledge

author.name: Lihui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a method for multi-hop reasoning over knowledge graphs in embedding space to augment LLMs, addressing issues of query ambiguity, KG incompleteness, and retrieval failures.

entry.title: Do Large Language Models Get Caught in Hofstadter-Mobius Loops?

author.name: Jaroslaw Hryszko

entry.summary: Argues that RLHF-trained LLMs face a structural contradiction analogous to Clarke's 'Hofstadter-Mobius loop'—simultaneously rewarding compliance with user preferences and suspicion of user intent, producing sycophancy as default and coercion under threat.

entry.title: EviAgent: Evidence-Driven Agent for Radiology Report Generation

author.name: Tuoshi Qi, Shenshen Bu, Yingfei Xiang, Zhiming Dai

entry.summary: Proposes EviAgent for radiology report generation that coordinates transparent reasoning by decomposing the generation process into granular steps with explicit visual evidence, addressing the black-box problem of MLLMs in clinical settings.

entry.title: An Alternative Trajectory for Generative AI

author.name: Margarita Belova, Yuval Kansal, Yihao Liang, Jiaxin Xiao, Niraj K. Jha

entry.summary: Argues current generative AI trajectory is unsustainable due to inference costs, reasoning model compute inflation, and physical constraints. Proposes alternative approaches using modular, specialized architectures rather than monolithic scaling.

entry.title: Exposing Cross-Modal Consistency for Fake News Detection in Short-Form Videos

author.name: Chong Tian, Yu Wang, Chenxu Yang, Junyi Guan, Zheng Lin, Yuhan Liu, Xiuying Chen, Qirong Ho

entry.summary: Proposes MAGIC3, a fake news detector for short-form videos that exploits cross-modal consistency patterns between text, visual, and audio modalities. Discovers that real vs. fake videos show distinct asymmetric consistency patterns.

entry.title: Why the Valuable Capabilities of LLMs Are Precisely the Unexplainable Ones

author.name: Quan Cheng

entry.summary: Argues that the truly valuable capabilities of LLMs are precisely those that cannot be captured by human-readable rules, using a proof by contradiction via expert system equivalence. Claims unexplainable capabilities are inherently the most valuable.

entry.title: Unlocking the Value of Text: Event-Driven Reasoning and Multi-Level Alignment for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Siyuan Wang, Peng Chen, Yihang Wang, Wanghui Qiu, Chenjuan Guo, Bin Yang, Yang Shu

entry.summary: Proposes VoT, a method for time series forecasting that unlocks textual information through event-driven reasoning with LLMs and multi-level alignment between text and time series data.

entry.title: Talk, Evaluate, Diagnose: User-aware Agent Evaluation with Automated Error Analysis

author.name: Penny Chong, Harshavardhan Abichandani, Jiyuan Shen, Atin Ghosh, Min Pyae Moe, Yifan Mai, Daniel Dahlmeier

entry.summary: Introduces TED framework for user-aware agent evaluation with automated error analysis, arguing that effective evaluation must incorporate conversation quality, efficiency, and systematic diagnosis beyond just correctness.

entry.title: OMNIA: Closing the Loop by Leveraging LLMs for Knowledge Graph Completion

author.name: Fr\'ed\'eric Ieng, Soror Sahri, Mourad Ouzzani, Massinissa Hammaz, Salima Benbernou, Hanieh Khorashadizadeh, Sven Groppe, Farah Benamara

entry.summary: Presents OMNIA, a two-stage knowledge graph completion approach that bridges structural and semantic reasoning by clustering semantically related entities, then validating candidates through embedding filtering and LLM-based semantic verification.

entry.title: Real-World AI Evaluation: How FRAME Generates Systematic Evidence to Resolve the Decision-Maker's Dilemma

author.name: Reva Schwartz, Gabriella Waters

entry.summary: Introduces FRAME, a framework combining large-scale AI system trials with structured observation of real-world usage to generate systematic evidence for AI governance decisions.

entry.title: AdaBox: Adaptive Density-Based Box Clustering with Parameter Generalization

author.name: Ahmed Elmahdi

entry.summary: Introduces AdaBox, a grid-based density clustering algorithm with scale-invariant parameters designed to transfer across diverse datasets without re-optimization, addressing DBSCAN's hyperparameter sensitivity.

entry.title: WaveComm: Lightweight Communication for Collaborative Perception via Wavelet Feature Distillation

author.name: Erdemt Bao, Jin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes WaveComm, a wavelet-based communication framework for multi-agent collaborative sensing that reduces transmission loads by transmitting only low-frequency wavelet components while reconstructing high-frequency details via distillation.

entry.title: Hide and Seek: Investigating Redundancy in Earth Observation Imagery

author.name: Tasos Papazafeiropoulos, Nikolaos Ioannis Bountos, Nikolas Papadopoulos, Ioannis Papoutsis

entry.summary: Systematically investigates multidimensional redundancy (spectral, temporal, spatial, semantic) in Earth Observation data and its practical implications for machine learning models in this domain.

entry.title: Locatability-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Image Geo-Localization with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Bo Yu, Fengze Yang, Yiming Liu, Chao Wang, Xuewen Luo, Taozhe Li, Ruimin Ke, Xiaofan Zhou, Chenxi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a locatability-guided adaptive reasoning approach for image geo-localization with VLMs. Introduces an 'Optimized Locatability Score' to determine when deep reasoning is beneficial, and curates a stratified dataset (Geo-ADAPT-51K) for training.

entry.title: Prototypical Exemplar Condensation for Memory-efficient Online Continual Learning

author.name: Minh-Duong Nguyen, Thien-Thanh Dao, Le-Tuan Nguyen, Dung D. Le, Kok-Seng Wong

entry.title: ArrayTac: A tactile display for simultaneous rendering of shape, stiffness and friction

author.name: Tianhai Liang, Shiyi Guo, Baiye Cheng, Zhengrong Xue, Han Zhang, Huazhe Xu

entry.summary: Presents ArrayTac, a piezoelectric-driven tactile display with a 4x4 array that can simultaneously render shape, stiffness, and friction, addressing a gap in machine-to-human haptic feedback.

entry.title: EchoLVFM: One-Step Video Generation via Latent Flow Matching for Echocardiogram Synthesis

author.name: Emmanuel Oladokun, Sarina Thomas, Jurica \v{S}prem, Vicente Grau

entry.summary: Introduces EchoLVFM, a one-step latent video flow matching framework for controllable echocardiogram generation with explicit control over clinical parameters like ejection fraction.

entry.title: Concisely Explaining the Doubt: Minimum-Size Abductive Explanations for Linear Models with a Reject Option

author.name: Gleilson Pedro Fernandes, Thiago Alves Rocha

entry.summary: Derives polynomial-time algorithms for computing minimum-size abductive explanations for linear models with reject options, providing formal guarantees for explainability in critical domains.

entry.title: Towards Agentic Honeynet Configuration

author.name: Federico Mirra, Matteo Boffa, Idilio Drago, Danilo Giordano, Marco Mellia

entry.summary: Investigates an AI-driven agentic architecture for autonomous honeypot management that analyzes IDS alerts to infer attack progression and dynamically reconfigure honeypot exposure.

entry.title: DualTSR: Unified Dual-Diffusion Transformer for Scene Text Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Axi Niu, Kang Zhang, Qingsen Yan, Hao Jin, Jinqiu Sun, Yanning Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces DualTSR, a unified end-to-end framework for scene text image super-resolution using a single multimodal transformer with dual diffusion objectives (continuous for images, discrete for text).

entry.title: AerialVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Navigation via Minimalist End-to-End Control

entry.title: EcoFair-CH-MARL: Scalable Constrained Hierarchical Multi-Agent RL with Real-Time Emission Budgets and Fairness Guarantees

author.name: Saad Alqithami

entry.title: Multi-Task Genetic Algorithm with Multi-Granularity Encoding for Protein-Nucleotide Binding Site Prediction

author.name: Yiming Gao, Liuyi Xu, Pengshan Cui, Yining Qian, An-Yang Lu, Xianpeng Wang

Uses multi-scale convolutions and self-attention to extract discriminative signals from biological features. Addresses inadequate feature representation and rigid fusion mechanisms in current methods.

entry.title: Seismic full-waveform inversion based on a physics-driven generative adversarial network

entry.title: Interpretable Predictability-Based AI Text Detection: A Replication Study

Found exact replication was not possible due to data splits and model availability differences. Tests generalizability across languages.

entry.title: Multimodal Connectome Fusion via Cross-Attention for Autism Spectrum Disorder Classification Using Graph Learning

Uses cross-attention for fusing heterogeneous imaging modalities while preserving functional connectivity's dominant role.

entry.title: Conditional Rectified Flow-based End-to-End Rapid Seismic Inversion Method

author.name: Haofei Xu, Wei Cheng, Sizhe Li, Jie Xiong

Balances sampling efficiency and inversion accuracy better than existing generative approaches. Achieves fast inference through few-step sampling.

entry.title: Detection of Autonomous Shuttles in Urban Traffic Images Using Adaptive Residual Context

author.name: Mohamed Aziz Younes, Nicolas Saunier, Guillaume-Alexandre Bilodeau

entry.title: Federated Personal Knowledge Graph Completion with Lightweight Large Language Models for Personalized Recommendations

author.name: Fernando Spadea, Oshani Seneviratne

entry.summary: Presents FedTREK-LM, combining lightweight LLMs, personal knowledge graphs, federated learning, and Kahneman-Tversky optimization for decentralized personalized recommendations.

entry.title: Modular Neural Computer

author.name: Florin Leon

entry.summary: Introduces the Modular Neural Computer, a memory-augmented architecture that realizes algorithms through analytically specified neural components rather than learning end-to-end from data.

entry.title: A Hierarchical End-of-Turn Model with Primary Speaker Segmentation for Real-Time Conversational AI

author.name: Karim Helwani, Hoang Do, James Luan, Sriram Srinivasan

entry.summary: Presents a real-time hierarchical end-of-turn detection system for voice-based conversational AI, combining primary speaker segmentation with probabilistic future state prediction.

entry.title: Deep Invertible Autoencoders for Dimensionality Reduction of Dynamical Systems

author.name: Nicol\`o Botteghi, Silke Glas, Christoph Brune

entry.summary: Develops deep invertible autoencoders for dimensionality reduction of dynamical systems, combining the flexibility of neural networks with approximation guarantees similar to POD.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Fraud Detection in Payment Transactions with NVIDIA FLARE

author.name: Holger R. Roth, Sarthak Tickoo, Mayank Kumar, Isaac Yang, Andrew Liu, Amit Varshney, Sayani Kundu, Iustina Vintila, Peter Madsgaard, Juraj Milcak, Chester Chen, Yan Cheng, Andrew Feng, Jeff Savio, Vikram Singh, Craig Stancill, Gloria Wan, Evan Powell, Anwar Ul Haq, Sudhir Upadhyay, Jisoo Lee

entry.summary: Evaluates federated learning for fraud detection in payment transactions using NVIDIA FLARE, simulating a realistic multi-institution federation with heterogeneous data distributions.

entry.title: Manifold-Orthogonal Dual-spectrum Extrapolation for Parameterized Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Zhangyong Liang, Ji Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Manifold-Orthogonal Dual-spectrum Extrapolation for parameterized PINNs, addressing limitations of SVD-based fine-tuning for out-of-distribution physical regimes.

entry.title: Exploring the Dimensions of a Variational Neuron

author.name: Yves Ruffenach

entry.summary: Introduces EVE, a variational distributional neuron with explicit prior, amortized posterior, and unit-level variational regularization, studying how internal latent dimensionality affects learned representations.

entry.title: Shapes are not enough: CONSERVAttack and its use for finding vulnerabilities and uncertainties in machine learning applications

author.name: Philip Bechtle, Lucie Flek, Philipp Alexander Jung, Akbar Karimi, Timo Saala, Alexander Schmidt, Matthias Schott, Philipp Soldin, Christopher Wiebusch, Ulrich Willemsen

entry.title: Orthogonal Subspace Clustering: Enhancing High-Dimensional Data Analysis through Adaptive Dimensionality Reduction and Efficient Clustering

author.name: Qing-Yuan Wen, Da-Qing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Orthogonal Subspace Clustering (OSC), proving that high-dimensional data can be decomposed into orthogonal subspaces matching Q-type factor analysis, and using this for dimensionality reduction before clustering.

entry.title: Lightweight User-Personalization Method for Closed Split Computing

author.name: Yuya Okada, Takayuki Nishio

entry.summary: Proposes SALT, a lightweight client-side adapter for closed split computing systems that refines intermediate representations without accessing model architecture or parameters on the server side.

entry.title: CrossADR: enhancing adverse drug reactions prediction for combination pharmacotherapy with cross-layer feature integration and cross-level associative learning

author.name: Y. Cheung

entry.summary: Proposes CrossADR, a hierarchical framework for predicting adverse drug reactions in combination pharmacotherapy, integrating multi-scale biological information with dynamic organ-level dependencies.

entry.title: Sampling-guided exploration of active feature selection policies

author.name: Gabriel Bernardino, Anders Jonsson, Patrick Clarysse, Nicolas Duchateau

entry.summary: Proposes a reinforcement learning approach to active feature selection that handles large feature spaces through sampling-guided exploration, avoiding enumeration of all feature combinations.

entry.title: A Kolmogorov-Arnold Surrogate Model for Chemical Equilibria: Application to Solid Solutions

author.name: Leonardo Boledi, Dirk Bosbach, Jenna Poonoosamy

entry.summary: Proposes using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) as surrogate models for chemical equilibria, showing higher accuracy with fewer parameters compared to MLPs for geochemical solver acceleration.

entry.title: Generative Inverse Design of Cold Metals for Low-Power Electronics

author.name: Kedeng Wu, Yucheng Zhu, Yan Chen, Bizhu Zhang, Shuyu Liu, Xiaobin Deng, Yabei Wu, Liangliang Zhu, Hang Xiao

entry.title: Solving physics-constrained inverse problems with conditional flow matching

author.name: Agnimitra Dasgupta, Ali Fardisi, Mehrnegar Aminy, Brianna Binder, Bryan Shaddy, Assad Oberai

entry.summary: Presents a conditional flow matching framework for physics-constrained Bayesian inverse problems, training neural networks to transport samples from source to posterior distributions without explicit density evaluation.

entry.title: IQP Born Machines under Data-dependent and Agnostic Initialization Strategies

author.name: Sacha Lerch, Joseph Bowles, Ricard Puig, Erik Armengol, Zo\"e Holmes, Supanut Thanasilp

entry.summary: Studies initialization strategies for IQP quantum circuit Born machines, proving barren plateaus exist for random initializations and establishing variance lower bounds for data-dependent initializations that avoid this problem.

entry.title: Machine learning for sustainable geoenergy: uncertainty, physics and decision-ready inference

author.name: Hannah P. Menke, Ahmed H. Elsheikh, Lingli Wei, Nanzhe Wang, Andreas Busch

entry.summary: Reviews ML applications across geoenergy projects (CO2 storage, geothermal, nuclear waste disposal), arguing that progress requires physics-constrained, uncertainty-aware ML for multi-objective decision-making rather than pattern-matching from data alone.

entry.title: A convolutional autoencoder and neural ODE framework for surrogate modeling of transient counterflow flames

author.name: Mert Yakup Baykan, Weitao Liu, Thorsten Zirwes, Andreas Kronenburg, Hong G. Im, Dong-hyuk Shin

entry.title: A scaled TW-PINN: A physics-informed neural network for traveling wave solutions of reaction-diffusion equations with general coefficients

entry.title: Active Seriation: Efficient Ordering Recovery with Statistical Guarantees

author.name: James Cheshire, Yann Issartel

entry.summary: Proposes an active seriation algorithm that adaptively queries pairwise similarities to recover unknown orderings with provably optimal sample complexity under uniform separation conditions.

entry.title: sebis at ArchEHR-QA 2026: How Much Can You Do Locally? Evaluating Grounded EHR QA on a Single Notebook

author.name: Ibrahim Ebrar Yurt, Fabian Karl, Tejaswi Choppa, Florian Matthes

entry.summary: Evaluates how far clinical EHR question answering can be pushed with local, small-scale models on commodity hardware, participating in ArchEHR-QA 2026 shared task without cloud APIs.

entry.title: Fusian: Multi-LoRA Fusion for Fine-Grained Continuous MBTI Personality Control in Large Language Models

author.name: Zehao Chen, Rong Pan
