entry.title: Local Precise Refinement: A Dual-Gated Mixture-of-Experts for Enhancing Foundation Model Generalization against Spectral Shifts

author.name: Xi Chen, Maojun Zhang, Yu Liu, Shen Yan

entry.summary: Proposes SpectralMoE, a PEFT framework for domain generalization in spectral remote sensing segmentation, using a dual-gated mixture-of-experts for spatially-adaptive refinement of foundation model features to handle spectral shifts.

entry.title: Colony Grounded SAM2: Zero-shot detection and segmentation of bacterial colonies using foundation models

author.name: Daan Korporaal, Patrick de Kruijf, Ralph H. G. M. Litjens, Bas H. M. van der Velden

entry.summary: Proposes Colony Grounded SAM2, a zero-shot pipeline for bacterial colony detection and segmentation using Grounding DINO and SAM2, achieving 93.1% mAP on out-of-distribution datasets without training.

entry.title: NumColor: Precise Numeric Color Control in Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Muhammad Atif Butt, Diego Hernandez, Alexandra Gomez-Villa, Kai Wang, Javier Vazquez-Corral, Joost Van De Weijer

entry.summary: Introduces NumColor, enabling precise numerical color control (hex codes, RGB values) in text-to-image diffusion models through a Color Token Aggregator and a ColorBook with 6,707 learnable embeddings in CIE Lab space.

entry.title: RetimeGS: Continuous-Time Reconstruction of 4D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Xuezhen Wang, Li Ma, Yulin Shen, Zeyu Wang, Pedro V. Sander

entry.summary: Proposes RetimeGS for continuous-time 4D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction, addressing temporal aliasing through optical flow-guided initialization and triple-plane temporal encoding for smooth interpolation.

entry.title: Advancing Cancer Prognosis with Hierarchical Fusion of Genomic, Proteomic and Pathology Imaging Data from a Systems Biology Perspective

author.name: Junjie Zhou, Bao Xue, Meiling Wang, Wei Shao, Daoqiang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes HFGPI, a hierarchical fusion framework for cancer prognosis that models biological progression from genome to proteome to histopathology, incorporating proteomic data as an intermediate layer.

entry.title: Learning through Creation: A Hash-Free Framework for On-the-Fly Category Discovery

author.name: Bohan Zhang, Weidong Tang, Zhixiang Chi, Yi Jin, Zhenbo Li, Yang Wang, Yanan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a hash-free framework for on-the-fly category discovery that explicitly trains models to perform discovery tasks during offline training, addressing optimization misalignment between training and inference.

entry.title: CT-Conditioned Diffusion Prior with Physics-Constrained Sampling for PET Super-Resolution

author.name: Liutao Yang, Zi Wang, Peiyuan Jing, Xiaowen Wang, Javier A. Montoya-Zegarra, Kuangyu Shi, Daoqiang Zhang, Guang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a CT-conditioned diffusion framework for PET super-resolution with physics-constrained sampling that accounts for heterogeneous scanner configurations, using cross-attention for anatomical guidance.

entry.title: Scene Generation at Absolute Scale: Utilizing Semantic and Geometric Guidance From Text for Accurate and Interpretable 3D Indoor Scene Generation

author.name: Stefan Ainetter, Thomas Deixelberger, Edoardo A. Dominici, Philipp Drescher, Konstantinos Vardis, Markus Steinberger

entry.summary: Presents GuidedSceneGen, a text-to-3D indoor scene generation framework maintaining absolute world coordinates throughout generation, using global layout prediction and panoramic diffusion.

entry.title: A Hyperbolic Perspective on Hierarchical Structure in Object-Centric Scene Representations

author.name: Neelu Madan, \`Alex Pujol, Andreas M{\o}gelmose, Sergio Escalera, Kamal Nasrollahi, Graham W. Taylor, Thomas B. Moeslund

entry.summary: Proposes projecting Euclidean slot attention embeddings to hyperbolic space to reveal hierarchical structure in object-centric representations, constructing five-level visual hierarchies from slot masks.

entry.title: BluRef: Unsupervised Image Deblurring with Dense-Matching References

author.name: Bang-Dang Pham, Anh Tran, Cuong Pham, Minh Hoai

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised image deblurring method using unpaired blurred and sharp images with dense matching to create pseudo ground truth. Eliminates the need for paired training data or pre-trained networks.

entry.title: Direct Object-Level Reconstruction via Probabilistic Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Shuai Guo, Ao Guo, Junchao Zhao, Qi Chen, Yuxiang Qi, Zechuan Li, Dong Chen, Tianjia Shao, Mingliang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes efficient single-object 3D reconstruction using 2D Gaussian Splatting with foreground-background probability integration and dynamic pruning of low-probability Gaussians.

entry.title: Texel Splatting: Perspective-Stable 3D Pixel Art

author.name: Dylan Ebert

entry.summary: Texel splatting renders 3D scenes as perspective-stable pixel art by splatting cubemap texels as world-space quads, solving the instability of grid-snapping under perspective projection.

entry.title: Enhancing Hands in 3D Whole-Body Pose Estimation with Conditional Hands Modulator

author.name: Gyeongsik Moon

entry.summary: Hand4Whole++ introduces CHAM, a conditional hands modulator that combines pre-trained whole-body and hand pose estimators to improve hand pose accuracy in 3D whole-body estimation.

entry.title: PHAC: Promptable Human Amodal Completion

author.name: Seung Young Noh, Ju Yong Chang

entry.summary: PHAC enables promptable human amodal completion where users can control completed content via pose or spatial extent conditioning, going beyond simple hallucination of occluded regions.

entry.title: Global Truncated Loss Minimization for Robust and Threshold-Resilient Geometric Estimation

author.name: Tianyu Huang, Liangzu Peng, Xinyue Zhang, Tongfan Guan, Jinhu Dong, Haoang Li, Laurent Kneip, Yun-Hui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes global branch-and-bound minimization of truncated losses for outlier-robust geometric estimation, demonstrating improved threshold resilience over consensus maximization.

entry.title: DamageArbiter: A CLIP-Enhanced Multimodal Arbitration Framework for Hurricane Damage Assessment from Street-View Imagery

author.name: Yifan Yang, Lei Zou, Wenjing Gong, Kani Fu, Zongrong Li, Siqin Wang, Bing Zhou, Heng Cai, Hao Tian

entry.summary: DamageArbiter uses CLIP-based multimodal arbitration to improve hurricane damage assessment from street-view imagery, combining unimodal and multimodal models with disagreement-driven resolution.

entry.title: TopoVST: Toward Topology-fidelitous Vessel Skeleton Tracking

author.name: Yaoyu Liu, Minghui Zhang, Junjun He, Yun Gu

entry.summary: Proposes TopoVST, a topology-faithful vessel skeleton tracker using multi-scale sphere graphs and graph neural networks for joint estimation of tracking directions and vessel radii in medical images.

entry.title: Workflow-Aware Structured Layer Decomposition for Illustration Production

author.name: Tianyu Zhang, Dongchi Li, Keiichi Sawada, Haoran Xie

entry.summary: Proposes a workflow-aware structured layer decomposition framework for anime illustration production, decomposing images into semantically meaningful production layers (line art, flat color, shadow, highlight) inspired by actual anime creation pipelines.

entry.title: PAKAN: Pixel Adaptive Kolmogorov-Arnold Network Modules for Pansharpening

author.name: Haoyu Zhang, Haojing Chen, Zhen Zhong, Liangjian Deng

entry.summary: Proposes Pixel Adaptive KAN framework for pansharpening, designing 2D and 3D adaptive variants of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with dynamic adaptability for spatial-spectral fusion.

entry.title: GATE-AD: Graph Attention Network Encoding For Few-Shot Industrial Visual Anomaly Detection

author.name: Aggelos Psiris, Yannis Panagakis, Maria Vakalopoulou, Georgios Th. Papadopoulos

entry.summary: Proposes GATE-AD for few-shot industrial visual anomaly detection using masked graph attention networks on patch-level features to learn normal appearance patterns.

entry.title: Spectral Rectification for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Foundation Models in Colonoscopy Depth Estimation

author.name: Xiaoxian Zhang, Minghai Shi, Lei Li

entry.summary: Proposes SpecDepth for colonoscopy depth estimation, identifying the core domain gap as frequency-domain statistical shift and addressing it with adaptive spectral rectification via learnable wavelet decomposition.

entry.title: Automated Counting of Stacked Objects in Industrial Inspection

author.name: Corentin Dumery, Noa Ett\'e, Aoxiang Fan, Ren Li, Jingyi Xu, Hieu Le, Pascal Fua

entry.summary: Proposes a 3D counting approach for stacked industrial objects by decomposing into visible item counting and total stack volume estimation, addressing heavy occlusion in bins and containers.

entry.title: Bayesian Uncertainty-Aware MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Ahmed Karam Eldaly, Matteo Figini, Daniel C. Alexander

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian framework for joint MRI reconstruction and uncertainty quantification using MCMC sampling with total variation priors. Demonstrates superior performance over optimization-based compressed sensing methods.

entry.title: Sonar-MASt3R: Real-Time Opti-Acoustic Fusion in Turbid, Unstructured Environments

author.name: Amy Phung, Richard Camilli

entry.summary: Sonar-MASt3R proposes real-time opti-acoustic fusion for underwater 3D reconstruction in turbid environments, combining sonar and camera data to resolve their complementary ambiguities for underwater intervention tasks.

entry.title: ToMPC: Task-oriented Model Predictive Control via ADMM for Safe Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Xinyu Jia, Wenxin Wang, Jun Yang, Yongping Pan, Haoyong Yu

entry.summary: ToMPC unifies collision-free motion and robot-environment interaction in a task-oriented MPC framework, using ADMM to decompose the optimization into DDP and QP subproblems with task-oriented obstacle avoidance leveraging kinematic redundancy.

entry.title: H-RINS: Hierarchical Tightly-coupled Radar-Inertial Navigation via Smoothing and Mapping

author.name: Ali Alridha Abdulkarim, Mikhail Litvinov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: H-RINS is a hierarchical tightly-coupled radar-inertial navigation system using factor graphs with decoupled high-rate resetting and persistent global graphs to address radar's limited observability of absolute orientation.

entry.title: AeroGen: Agentic Drone Autonomy through Single-Shot Structured Prompting & Drone SDK

author.name: Kautuk Astu, Yogesh Simmhan

entry.summary: AeroGen enables single-shot LLM-generated drone control programs through structured guardrail prompting integrated with a drone SDK, evaluated across 20 navigation tasks and 5 missions.

entry.title: VIP-Loco: A Visually Guided Infinite Horizon Planning Framework for Legged Locomotion

author.name: Aditya Shirwatkar, Satyam Gupta, Shishir Kolathaya

entry.summary: VIP-Loco combines vision-based scene understanding with reinforcement learning and planning for legged robot locomotion. The framework learns compact kinodynamic features from depth images and proprioceptive states during training, then uses these learned models for planning at deployment. This bridges the gap between MPC's interpretability and RL's adaptability.

entry.title: End-to-End Dexterous Grasp Learning from Single-View Point Clouds via a Multi-Object Scene Dataset

author.name: Tao Geng, Dapeng Yang, Ziwei Liu, Le Zhang, Le Qi, WangYang Li, Yi Ren, Shan Luo, Fenglei Ni

entry.summary: DGS-Net learns dense grasp configurations from single-view point clouds in multi-object scenes for dexterous hands. Proposes a two-stage data generation strategy from single-object to scene-level grasping with a dataset of 307 objects.

entry.title: SHAMISA: SHAped Modeling of Implicit Structural Associations for Self-supervised No-Reference Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Mahdi Naseri, Zhou Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SHAMISA, a self-supervised framework for no-reference image quality assessment that learns from unlabeled distorted images using soft, structured relational supervision rather than rigid binary similarity constraints.

entry.title: DiFlowDubber: Discrete Flow Matching for Automated Video Dubbing via Cross-Modal Alignment and Synchronization

author.name: Ngoc-Son Nguyen, Thanh V. T. Tran, Jeongsoo Choi, Hieu-Nghia Huynh-Nguyen, Truong-Son Hy, Van Nguyen

entry.summary: DiFlowDubber uses discrete flow matching for automated video dubbing with cross-modal alignment, transferring knowledge from a pretrained TTS model to video-driven dubbing. Includes a FaPro module for capturing prosody from facial expressions.

entry.title: Storage and selection of multiple chaotic attractors in minimal reservoir computers

author.name: Francesco Martinuzzi, Holger Kantz

entry.summary: Investigates whether minimal deterministic reservoir computers can learn and select between multiple chaotic attractors, challenging the assumption that large random reservoirs are needed for multi-attractor learning.

entry.title: RL-ScanIQA: Reinforcement-Learned Scanpaths for Blind 360{\deg}Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Yujia Wang, Yuyan Li, Jiuming Liu, Fang-Lue Zhang, Xinhu Zheng, Neil. A Dodgson

entry.summary: RL-ScanIQA uses reinforcement learning to jointly optimize scanpath generation and quality assessment for blind 360° image quality evaluation, enabling end-to-end task-aligned exploration.

entry.title: Uni-MDTrack: Learning Decoupled Memory and Dynamic States for Parameter-Efficient Visual Tracking in All Modality

author.name: Wenrui Cai, Zhenyi Lu, Yuzhe Li, Yongchao Feng, Jinqing Zhang, Qingjie Liu, Yunhong Wang

entry.summary: Uni-MDTrack proposes a parameter-efficient visual tracker with decoupled memory and dynamic state modeling for all-modality tracking, addressing limited context utilization in existing methods.

entry.title: $\text{F}^2\text{HDR}$: Two-Stage HDR Video Reconstruction via Flow Adapter and Physical Motion Modeling

author.name: Huanjing Yue, Dawei Li, Shaoxiong Tu, Jingyu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes F²HDR, a two-stage HDR video reconstruction framework with a flow adapter for motion-aware alignment and physical motion modeling for detail restoration in dynamic scenes.

entry.title: A PPO-Based Bitrate Allocation Conditional Diffusion Model for Remote Sensing Image Compression

author.name: Yuming Han, Jooho Kim, Anish Shakya

entry.summary: Proposes PCDC, a framework combining conditional diffusion decoder with PPO-based block-wise bitrate allocation for remote sensing image compression, also releasing a high-res drone dataset.

entry.title: ViSA: Visited-State Augmentation for Generalized Goal-Space Contrastive Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Issa Nakamura, Tomoya Yamanokuchi, Yuki Kadokawa, Jia Qu, Shun Otsub, Ken Miyamoto, Shotaro Miwa, Takamitsu Matsubara

entry.summary: ViSA improves Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning by augmenting data in Contrastive RL. Generates augmented state samples to address the limitation that CRL can only accurately estimate value functions for limited goals based on visited states.

entry.title: KiRAS: Keyframe Guided Self-Imitation for Robust and Adaptive Skill Learning in Quadruped Robots

author.name: Xiaoyi Wei, Peng Zhai, Jiaxin Tu, Yueqi Zhang, Yuqi Li, Zonghao Zhang, Hu Zhou, Lihua Zhang

entry.summary: KiRAS uses keyframes as minimal skill representations for quadruped robots, enabling diverse skill learning on complex terrains through self-imitation. Relaxes the need for terrain-specific datasets by using keyframe-guided learning.

entry.title: Perception-Aware Autonomous Exploration in Feature-Limited Environments

author.name: Moji Shi, Rajitha de Silva, Hang Yu, Riccardo Polvara, Marija Popovi\'c

entry.summary: Proposes a perception-aware exploration framework for UAVs that couples exploration progress with visual feature observability. Prevents the robot from entering feature-sparse regions where VIO tracking degrades, avoiding odometry drift and mission failure.

entry.title: Zero-Forgetting CISS via Dual-Phase Cognitive Cascades

author.name: Yuquan Lu, Yifu Guo, Zishan Xu, Siyu Zhang, Yu Huo, Siyue Chen, Siyan Wu, Chenghua Zhu, Ruixuan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces CogCaS for continual class-incremental semantic segmentation, providing theoretical analysis of catastrophic forgetting sources and a dual-phase cascade approach inspired by human annotation behavior.

entry.title: A Physically-Grounded Attack and Adaptive Defense Framework for Real-World Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Tongshun Zhang, Pingping Liu, Yuqing Lei, Zixuan Zhong, Qiuzhan Zhou, Zhiyuan Zha

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-based attack and defense paradigm for low-light image enhancement that models ISP inversion and physically plausible noise injection.

entry.title: Reference-Free Omnidirectional Stereo Matching via Multi-View Consistency Maximization

author.name: Lehuai Xu, Weiming Zhang, Yang Li, Sidan Du, Lin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FreeOmniMVS, a reference-free omnidirectional stereo matching framework using multi-view consistency maximization for depth estimation from multi-fisheye cameras.

entry.title: SRL-MAD: Structured Residual Latents for One-Class Morphing Attack Detection

author.name: Diogo J. Paulo, Hugo Proen\c{c}a, Jo\~ao C. Neves

entry.summary: Introduces SRL-MAD, a one-class morphing attack detection method using structured residual Fourier representations for open-set face morphing detection trained only on bona fide samples.

entry.title: Self-Supervised ImageNet Representations for In Vivo Confocal Microscopy: Tortuosity Grading without Segmentation Maps

author.name: Kim Ouan, No\'emie Moreau, Katarzyna Bozek

entry.summary: Demonstrates that DINO self-supervised features from ImageNet transfer effectively to corneal nerve fiber tortuosity grading, outperforming SOTA without requiring expensive segmentation maps.

entry.title: ManiBench: A Benchmark for Testing Visual-Logic Drift and Syntactic Hallucinations in Manim Code Generation

author.name: Nabin Oli

entry.summary: Introduces ManiBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM code generation specifically for Manim mathematical animation library, targeting syntactic hallucinations (non-existent APIs) and visual-logic drift (visuals diverging from intended math).

entry.title: StatePlane: A Cognitive State Plane for Long-Horizon AI Systems Under Bounded Context

author.name: Sasank Annapureddy, John Mulcahy, Anjaneya Prasad Thamatani

entry.summary: Proposes StatePlane, a model-agnostic cognitive state plane for AI systems that manages episodic, semantic, and procedural state across long interaction horizons, addressing context window limitations.

entry.title: LLM-MINE: Large Language Model based Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias Phenotypes Mining from Clinical Notes

author.name: Mingchen Shao, Yuzhang Xie, Carl Yang, Jiaying Lu

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-MINE for extracting Alzheimer's Disease phenotypes from clinical notes using LLMs and expert-defined phenotype lists. Validates extracted phenotypes through chi-square analysis and unsupervised disease staging.

entry.title: The Institutional Scaling Law: Non-Monotonic Fitness, Capability-Trust Divergence, and Symbiogenetic Scaling in Generative AI

author.name: Mark Baciak, Thomas A. Cellucci

entry.summary: Derives an 'Institutional Scaling Law' showing that institutional fitness (capability + trust + affordability + sovereignty) is non-monotonic with model scale, with environment-dependent optima. Argues orchestrated domain-specific models can outperform frontier generalists.

entry.title: Scaling the Explanation of Multi-Class Bayesian Network Classifiers

author.name: Yaofang Zhang, Adnan Darwiche

entry.summary: Proposes a new algorithm for compiling Bayesian network classifiers into class formulas for explanation computation, extending beyond binary classifiers with faster compilation and OR-decomposable NNF outputs.

entry.title: OpenHospital: A Thing-in-itself Arena for Evolving and Benchmarking LLM-based Collective Intelligence

author.name: Peigen Liu, Rui Ding, Yuren Mao, Ziyan Jiang, Yuxiang Ye, Yunjun Gao, Ying Zhang, Renjie Sun, Longbin Lai, Zhengping Qian

entry.summary: Introduces OpenHospital, an interactive arena where LLM-based physician agents evolve collective intelligence through interactions with patient agents. Uses a data-in-agent-self paradigm for rapid capability enhancement and provides metrics for benchmarking medical proficiency.

entry.title: A Hybrid AI and Rule-Based Decision Support System for Disease Diagnosis and Management Using Labs

author.name: Muhammad Hammad Maqsood, Mubashir Sajid, Khubaib Ahmed, Muhammad Usamah Shahid, Muddassar Farooq

entry.summary: Develops a clinical decision support system combining AI predictive modeling with rule-based expert systems for disease diagnosis using lab results. Trained on data from 593,055 patients across 547 US primary care centers.

entry.title: Probe-then-Plan: Environment-Aware Planning for Industrial E-commerce Search

author.name: Mengxiang Chen, Zhouwei Zhai, Jin Li

entry.summary: Proposes Environment-Aware Search Planning (EASP) for e-commerce search, using a Probe-then-Plan mechanism where a lightweight retrieval probe exposes the real-time retrieval state before LLM planning, resolving the blindness-latency dilemma.

entry.title: PMAx: An Agentic Framework for AI-Driven Process Mining

author.name: Anton Antonov, Humam Kourani, Alessandro Berti, Gyunam Park, Wil M. P. van der Aalst

entry.summary: Introduces PMAx, an autonomous agentic framework for process mining that uses LLMs as orchestrators of specialized tools rather than direct analytical engines, addressing hallucination and data privacy concerns.

entry.title: From Prompts to Worlds: How Users Iterate, Explore, and Make Sense of AI-Generated 3D Environments

author.name: Aung Pyae

entry.summary: First empirical study of commercial text-to-3D platforms, finding users can convey semantic intent but struggle to specify spatial structure (asymmetric expressibility), and that immersion is episodic, arising when expectations align with outputs.

entry.title: Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and the Institutional Turn: Legal Architectures and Financial Governance in the Age of Distributional AGI

author.name: Marcel Osmond

entry.summary: Examines legal and financial governance challenges posed by agentic AI systems, proposing institutional governance structures for autonomous AI in financial markets, moving beyond model-level alignment.

entry.title: FedUAF: Uncertainty-Aware Fusion with Reliability-Guided Aggregation for Multimodal Federated Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Xianxun Zhu, Zezhong Sun, Imad Rida, Erik Cambria, Junqi Su, Rui Wang, Hui Chen

entry.summary: Proposes FedUAF, a federated multimodal sentiment analysis framework with uncertainty-aware fusion and reliability-guided aggregation for handling missing modalities and noisy data.

entry.title: BrainCast: A Spatio-Temporal Forecasting Model for Whole-Brain fMRI Time Series Prediction

author.name: Yunlong Gao, Jinbo Yang, Li Xiao, Haiye Huo, Yang Ji, Hao Wang, Aiying Zhang, Yu-Ping Wang

entry.summary: Proposes BrainCast, a spatio-temporal forecasting framework for whole-brain fMRI time series that jointly models temporal dynamics within ROIs and spatial interactions across ROIs to extend fMRI data without additional acquisition.

entry.title: Querying Everything Everywhere All at Once: Supervaluationism for the Agentic Lakehouse

author.name: Jacopo Tagliabue

entry.summary: Demonstrates a system for querying across data branches in agentic analytics using supervaluationary semantics, addressing the challenge of multiple competing data pipelines in lakehouse architectures.

entry.title: Self-Flow-Matching assisted Full Waveform Inversion

author.name: Xinquan Huang, Paris Perdikaris

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Flow-Matching for full waveform inversion in seismic imaging, eliminating the need for offline pretraining of generative priors by constructing a self-consistent flow-matching path from the current FWI iterate.

entry.title: Technical Case Study of Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) for Public Health

author.name: Avinash Laddha, Danil Mikhailov, Uyi Stewart

entry.summary: Presents a technical case study on using differential privacy to create synthetic financial transaction data for pandemic management, demonstrating spatial-temporal predictive power while preserving privacy.

entry.title: Unsupervised Adaptation from FDG to PSMA PET/CT for 3D Lesion Detection under Label Shift

author.name: Xiaofeng Liu, Menghua Xia, Yanis Chemli, Georges El Fakhri, Chi Liu, Jinsong Ouyang

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised domain adaptation framework for 3D lesion detection that adapts from FDG PET/CT to PSMA PET/CT, handling both covariate and label shift through adaptive anchor adjustment and confidence thresholding.

entry.title: Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models

author.name: Alejandro Paredes La Torre, Barbara Flores, Diego Rodriguez

entry.summary: Proposes a knowledge distillation framework combining chain-of-thought reinforcement learning, distilling from Qwen 3B to Qwen 0.5B across English, Spanish, and code tasks, retaining 70-95% of teacher capability.

entry.title: Retrieval-Feedback-Driven Distillation and Preference Alignment for Efficient LLM-based Query Expansion

author.name: Minghan Li, Guodong Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieval-feedback-driven distillation framework for transferring query expansion capabilities from large teacher LLMs to compact student models, using retrieval metrics to guide preference alignment.

entry.title: Power Term Polynomial Algebra for Boolean Logic

author.name: Emanuele Sansone, Armando Solar-Lezama

entry.summary: Introduces power term polynomial algebra as a representation for Boolean formulae that bridges CNF and ANF forms, addressing the exponential blowup of direct conversion through a compact encoding of structured monomial families.

entry.title: Robust Self-Training with Closed-loop Label Correction for Learning from Noisy Labels

author.name: Zhanhui Lin, Yanlin Liu, Sanping Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a self-training label correction framework for learning from noisy labels using decoupled bilevel optimization where a classifier and neural correction function co-evolve.

entry.title: VAD4Space: Visual Anomaly Detection for Planetary Surface Imagery

author.name: Fabrizio Genilotti, Arianna Stropeni, Francesco Borsatti, Manuel Barusco, Davide Dalle Pezze, Gian Antonio Susto

entry.summary: Investigates Visual Anomaly Detection for planetary surface imagery, presenting the first empirical evaluation of VAD methods on real lunar and Mars rover images with two new benchmarks.

entry.title: EI-Part: Explode for Completion and Implode for Refinement

author.name: Wanhu Sun, Zhongjin Luo, Heliang Zheng, Jiahao Chang, Chongjie Ye, Huiang He, Shengchu Zhao, Rongfei Jia, Xiaoguang Han

entry.summary: Introduces EI-Part, a framework for part-level 3D generation that uses 'explode and implode' strategy with distinct representations at different stages for structural coherence and geometric fidelity.

entry.title: Walking Further: Semantic-aware Multimodal Gait Recognition Under Long-Range Conditions

author.name: Zhiyang Lu, Wen Jiang, Tianren Wu, Zhichao Wang, Changwang Zhang, Siqi Shen, Ming Cheng

entry.summary: Presents LRGait, the first LiDAR-Camera multimodal benchmark for long-range gait recognition, and EMGaitNet, a framework using CLIP-based semantic mining for cross-modal fusion.

entry.title: UniFusion: A Unified Image Fusion Framework with Robust Representation and Source-Aware Preservation

author.name: Xingyuan Li, Songcheng Du, Yang Zou, HaoYuan Xu, Zhiying Jiang, Jinyuan Liu

entry.summary: UniFusion proposes a unified image fusion framework using DINOv3 features that works across multi-modal, multi-exposure, and multi-focus fusion tasks. It addresses source information degradation during deep-layer propagation with a cross-task generalization design.

entry.title: A Real-Time Neuro-Symbolic Ethical Governor for Safe Decision Control in Autonomous Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Aueaphum Aueawatthanaphisut, Kuepon Aueawatthanaphisut

entry.summary: Presents a real-time neuro-symbolic ethical governor for autonomous robotic manipulation that integrates transformer-based ethical reasoning with probabilistic risk fields and override control. Uses a fine-tuned DistilBERT on the ETHICS dataset for language-grounded ethical intent inference.

entry.title: AgroNVILA: Perception-Reasoning Decoupling for Multi-view Agricultural Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Jiarui Zhang, Junqi Hu, Zurong Mai, Yuhang Chen, Shuohong Lou, Henglian Huang, Lingyuan Zhao, Jianxi Huang, Yutong Lu, Haohuan Fu, Juepeng Zheng

entry.summary: AgroNVILA introduces a multi-view agricultural MLLM with a Perception-Reasoning Decoupling architecture to handle varying scales from ground-level to satellite imagery. Includes AgroOmni, a 288K multi-view training corpus for precision agriculture.

entry.title: SPARQ: Spiking Early-Exit Neural Networks for Energy-Efficient Edge AI

author.name: Parth Patne, Mahdi Taheri, Ali Mahani, Maksim Jenihhin, Reza Mahani, Christian Herglotz

entry.summary: SPARQ integrates spiking neural networks with quantization-aware training and RL-guided early exits for energy-efficient edge AI. Achieves up to 5.15% higher accuracy and 330x lower energy than baseline approaches.

entry.title: Extending Minimal Pairs with Ordinal Surprisal Curves and Entropy Across Applied Domains

author.name: Andrew Katz

entry.summary: Extends the minimal pairs evaluation paradigm from binary grammaticality to ordinal-scaled classification across multiple domains, using surprisal-based metrics rather than expensive text generation.

entry.title: The Scenic Route to Deception: Dark Patterns and Explainability Pitfalls in Conversational Navigation

author.name: Ilya Ilyankou, Stefano Cavazzi, James Haworth

entry.summary: Categorizes risks of LLM-based conversational navigation using a 2x2 framework of intent and origin, distinguishing dark patterns from explainability pitfalls. Proposes seamful design and neuro-symbolic architecture for trustworthy navigation.

entry.title: MVHOI: Bridge Multi-view Condition to Complex Human-Object Interaction Video Reenactment via 3D Foundation Model

author.name: Jinguang Tong, Jinbo Wu, Kaisiyuan Wang, Zhelun Shen, Xuan Huang, Mochu Xiang, Xuesong Li, Yingying Li, Haocheng Feng, Chen Zhao, Hang Zhou, Wei He, Chuong Nguyen, Jingdong Wang, Hongdong Li

entry.summary: MVHOI proposes a two-stage framework for human-object interaction video reenactment using multi-view reference conditions bridged via a 3D foundation model, handling complex non-planar manipulations.

entry.title: Describing Agentic AI Systems with C4: Lessons from Industry Projects

author.name: Andreas Rausch, Stefan Wittek

entry.summary: Reports industrial experience documenting agentic AI systems using the C4 architecture model. Derives documentation practices tailored to agentic AI's characteristic style of specialized agents collaborating via artifacts and tools. Practical guidance from real industry projects.

entry.title: RoCo Challenge at AAAI 2026: Benchmarking Robotic Collaborative Manipulation for Assembly Towards Industrial Automation

author.name: Haichao Liu, Yuheng Zhou, Zhenyu Wu, Ziheng Ji, Ziyu Shan, Qianzhun Wang, Ruixuan Liu, Zhiyuan Yang, Yejun Gu, Shalman Khan, Shijun Yan, Jun Liu, Haiyue Zhu, Changliu Liu, Jianfei Yang, Jingbing Zhang, Ziwei Wang

entry.summary: Introduces the RoCo Challenge benchmark for robotic collaborative assembly, focusing on high-precision planetary gearbox assembly tasks. Combines simulation and real-world manipulation in an industrial automation context.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Neural Systems for the Simulation of EUV Electromagnetic Wave Diffraction from a Lithography Mask

author.name: Vasiliy A. Es'kin, Egor V. Ivanov

entry.summary: Introduces a hybrid Waveguide Neural Operator for simulating EUV electromagnetic wave diffraction from lithography masks, replacing expensive numerical components with neural networks.

entry.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Gait Classification Using Text-Encoded Kinematic Waveforms

author.name: Carlo Dindorf, Jonas Dully, Rebecca Keilhauer, Michael Lorenz, Michael Fr\"ohlich

entry.summary: Evaluates whether general-purpose LLMs can classify continuous gait kinematics when represented as text, comparing GPT-5, GPT-5-mini, GPT-4.1 and o4-mini against conventional ML approaches.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning for IoT: A Cross-Paradigm Survey and Future Roadmap

author.name: Zakia Zaman, Praveen Gauravaram, Mahbub Hassan, Sanjay Jha, Wen Hu

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of privacy-preserving machine learning for IoT, introducing a structured taxonomy spanning perturbation-based, cryptographic, and federated approaches.

entry.title: Close to Reality: Interpretable and Feasible Data Augmentation for Imbalanced Learning

author.name: Matheus Camilo da Silva, Gabriel Gustavo Costanzo, Andrea de Lorenzo, Sylvio Barbon Junior

entry.summary: Introduces DPG-da, a framework that extracts interpretable decision predicates from trained models to enforce domain rules during data augmentation for imbalanced datasets.

entry.title: Benchmarking Open-Source PPG Foundation Models for Biological Age Prediction

author.name: N. Brag

entry.summary: Benchmarks open-source PPG foundation models for biological age prediction, finding that a general-purpose foundation model outperforms a task-specific model on a different clinical population.

entry.title: Bootstrapped Physically-Primed Neural Networks for Robust T2 Distribution Estimation in Low-SNR Pancreatic MRI

author.name: Hadas Ben Atya, Nicole Abramenkov, Noa Mashiah, Luise Brock, Daphna Link Sourani, Ram Weiss, Moti Freiman

entry.summary: Introduces a bootstrap-based inference framework for robust T2 distribution estimation in pancreatic MRI, converting deterministic relaxometry networks into probabilistic estimators through stochastic resampling.

entry.title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Early Prediction of Patient Deterioration in the ICU: Integrating Time-Series EHR Data with Clinical Notes

author.name: Binesh Sadanandan

entry.summary: Presents a multimodal deep learning approach for early ICU patient deterioration prediction combining structured time-series data (LSTM) with clinical notes (ClinicalBERT) using the MIMIC-IV database.

entry.title: DeFRiS: Silo-Cooperative IoT Applications Scheduling via Decentralized Federated Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhiyu Wang, Mohammad Goudarzi, Mingming Gong, Rajkumar Buyya

entry.summary: Proposes DeFRiS, a decentralized federated reinforcement learning framework for IoT application scheduling across heterogeneous silos, addressing state-action space incompatibility and adversarial robustness.

entry.title: OpenReservoirComputing: GPU-Accelerated Reservoir Computing in JAX

author.name: Jan Williams, Dima Tretiak, Steven L. Brunton, J. Nathan Kutz, Krithika Manohar

entry.summary: Presents OpenReservoirComputing (ORC), a Python library for reservoir computing in JAX with GPU/TPU acceleration, supporting various RC architectures for time-series forecasting and other applications.

entry.title: SFedHIFI: Fire Rate-Based Heterogeneous Information Fusion for Spiking Federated Learning

author.name: Ran Tao, Qiugang Zhan, Shantian Yang, Xiurui Xie, Qi Tian, Guisong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces SFedHIFI, a spiking federated learning framework supporting heterogeneous SNN models via channel-wise matrix decomposition and fire rate-based information fusion for aggregating models of different scales.

entry.title: Joint Routing and Model Pruning for Decentralized Federated Learning in Bandwidth-Constrained Multi-Hop Wireless Networks

author.name: Xiaoyu He, Weicai Li, Tiejun Lv, Xi Yu

entry.summary: Proposes joint routing and model pruning optimization for decentralized federated learning in bandwidth-constrained multi-hop wireless networks, showing each client's model retention rate is path-dependent.

entry.title: Robust and Computationally Efficient Linear Contextual Bandits under Adversarial Corruption and Heavy-Tailed Noise

author.name: Naoto Tani, Futoshi Futami

entry.summary: Proposes a computationally efficient algorithm for linear contextual bandits under both adversarial corruption and heavy-tailed noise with finite (1+ε)-th moments. Reduces per-round computational cost from O(t log T) to O(1) using online mirror descent.

entry.title: OpenExtract: Automated Data Extraction for Systematic Reviews in Health

author.name: Jim Achterberg, Bram Van Dijk, Jing Meng, Saif Ul Islam, Gregory Epiphaniou, Carsten Maple, Xuefei Ding, Theodoros N. Arvanitis, Simon Brouwer, Marcel Haas, Marco Spruit

entry.summary: Presents OpenExtract, an open-source pipeline using LLMs for automated data extraction in systematic literature reviews, achieving >0.8 precision and recall compared to human researchers.

entry.title: Diffusion-based Generative Machine Learning Model for Predicting Crack Propagation in Aluminum Nitride at the Atomic Scale

author.name: Jiali Lu, Shengfeng Yang

entry.summary: Develops a diffusion-based generative model for predicting atomic-scale crack propagation in aluminum nitride, achieving significant speedup over molecular dynamics while reproducing physical mechanisms.

entry.title: AMES: Approximate Multi-modal Enterprise Search via Late Interaction Retrieval

author.name: Tony Joseph, Carlos Pareja, David Lopes Pegna, Abhishek Singh

entry.summary: Presents AMES, a multimodal late interaction retrieval architecture for enterprise search that handles text, images, and video in a shared representation space with a two-stage ANN+MaxSim pipeline.

entry.title: Holographic Invariant Storage: Design-Time Safety Contracts via Vector Symbolic Architectures

author.name: Arsenios Scrivens

entry.summary: Introduces Holographic Invariant Storage (HIS), a protocol using Vector Symbolic Architectures to provide design-time safety contracts for LLM context-drift mitigation with closed-form guarantees on recovery fidelity and capacity.

entry.title: The Taxonomies, Training, and Applications of Event Stream Modelling for Electronic Health Records

author.name: Mingcheng Zhu, Yu Liu, Zhiyao Luo, Tingting Zhu

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of event stream modeling approaches for electronic health records, proposing taxonomies for representations, training paradigms, and applications across clinical tasks.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Uncertainty Estimation For Super-Resolution of Satellite Images

author.name: Zhe Zheng, Val\'ery Dewil, Pablo Arias

entry.summary: Introduces a self-supervised loss for uncertainty estimation in satellite image super-resolution without ground-truth high-resolution data, using a decision-theoretic framework where the optimal estimators are the posterior mean and variance.

entry.title: AR-Flow VAE: A Structured Autoregressive Flow Prior Variational Autoencoder for Unsupervised Blind Source Separation

author.name: Yuan-Hao Wei, Fu-Hao Deng, Lin-Yong Cui, Yan-Jie Sun

entry.summary: Introduces AR-Flow VAE, a VAE-based framework for blind source separation where each latent source uses a parameter-adaptive autoregressive flow prior, enabling capture of non-Gaussian behaviors and structured temporal dependencies in sources.

entry.title: Investigating the Impact of Speech Enhancement on Audio Deepfake Detection in Noisy Environments

author.name: Anacin, Angela, Shruti Kshirsagar, Anderson R. Avila

entry.summary: Investigates how speech enhancement algorithms affect audio deepfake detection in noisy environments, evaluating the correlation between speech quality metrics and spoofing detection performance.

entry.title: Spatio-temporal probabilistic forecast using MMAF-guided learning

author.name: Leonardo Bardi, Imma Valentina Curato, Lorenzo Proietti

entry.summary: Proposes MMAF-guided learning for spatio-temporal probabilistic forecasting using stochastic neural networks with Gaussian-distributed weights, where the embedding design is guided by spatio-temporal Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process assumptions.

entry.title: BiT-MCTS: A Theme-based Bidirectional MCTS Approach to Chinese Fiction Generation

author.name: Zhaoyi Li, Xu Zhang, Xiaojun Wan

entry.summary: Presents BiT-MCTS, a framework for generating long-form Chinese fiction using bidirectional Monte Carlo Tree Search, starting from a climax and expanding both forward and backward based on Freytag's Pyramid narrative structure.

entry.title: PARSA-Bench: A Comprehensive Persian Audio-Language Model Benchmark

author.name: Mohammad Javad Ranjbar Kalahroodi, Mohammad Amini, Parmis Bathayan, Heshaam Faili, Azadeh Shakery

entry.summary: Introduces PARSA-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating large audio-language models on Persian language and culture, with 16 tasks and 8,000+ samples including novel tasks like poetry meter detection and traditional music understanding.

entry.title: Multilingual TinyStories: A Synthetic Combinatorial Corpus of Indic Children's Stories for Training Small Language Models

author.name: Deepon Halder, Angira Mukherjee

entry.summary: Introduces a Multilingual TinyStories dataset of synthetically generated children's stories in 17 Indian languages for training small language models, using a hybrid pipeline with combinatorial prompt engineering and cross-lingual translation.

entry.title: Automating the Analysis and Improvement of Dynamic Programming Algorithms with Applications to Natural Language Processing

author.name: Tim Vieira

entry.summary: A thesis developing a system for automatically analyzing and improving dynamic programs using the Dyna domain-specific language, with static analysis for complexity and meaning-preserving transformations, applied to NLP.

entry.title: MER-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Meme Reappraisal

author.name: Yiqi Nie, Fei Wang, Junjie Chen, Kun Li, Yudi Cai, Dan Guo, Chenglong Li, Meng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Meme Reappraisal, a task to transform negatively framed memes into constructive ones while preserving structure, with MER-Bench providing fine-grained multimodal annotations for this emotion-controllable generation task.

entry.title: Int3DNet: Scene-Motion Cross Attention Network for 3D Intention Prediction in Mixed Reality

author.name: Taewook Ha, Woojin Cho, Dooyoung Kim, Woontack Woo

entry.summary: Proposes Int3DNet for 3D intention area prediction in Mixed Reality from scene geometry and head-hand motion cues using cross-attention fusion, without requiring explicit object-level perception.

entry.title: Every Error has Its Magnitude: Asymmetric Mistake Severity Training for Multiclass Multiple Instance Learning

author.name: Sungrae Hong, Jiwon Jeong, Jisu Shin, Donghee Han, Sol Lee, Kyungeun Kim, Mun Yong Yi

entry.summary: Proposes mistake-severity-aware training for multiple instance learning in whole slide image diagnosis, organizing classes hierarchically and penalizing high-severity misclassifications more strongly.

entry.title: RSEdit: Text-Guided Image Editing for Remote Sensing

author.name: Chen Zhenyuan, Zhang Zechuan, Zhang Feng

entry.summary: Presents RSEdit, a framework adapting pretrained diffusion models for text-guided remote sensing image editing via channel/token concatenation, trained on 60K+ bi-temporal RS image pairs.

entry.title: VFM-Loc: Zero-Shot Cross-View Geo-Localization via Aligning Discriminative Visual Hierarchies

author.name: Jun Lu, Zehao Sang, Haoqi Wei, Xiangyun Liu, Kun Zhu, Haitao Guo, Zhihui Gong, Lei Ding

entry.summary: Presents VFM-Loc, a training-free zero-shot framework for cross-view geo-localization using vision foundation models with progressive hierarchical alignment of discriminative visual clues.

entry.title: OpenCOOD-Air: Prompting Heterogeneous Ground-Air Collaborative Perception with Spatial Conversion and Offset Prediction

author.name: Xianke Wu, Songlin Bai, Chengxiang Li, Zhiyao Luo, Yulin Tian, Fenghua Zhu, Yisheng Lv, Yonglin Tian

entry.summary: Proposes OpenCOOD-Air for ground-air collaborative perception integrating UAV platforms into V2V systems, using transfer learning and heterogeneous feature integration to overcome ground-air domain gaps.

entry.title: VID-AD: A Dataset for Image-Level Logical Anomaly Detection under Vision-Induced Distraction

author.name: Hiroto Nakata, Yawen Zou, Shunsuke Sakai, Shun Maeda, Chunzhi Gu, Yijin Wei, Shangce Gao, Chao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces VID-AD, a dataset for logical anomaly detection under vision-induced distractions with 10 manufacturing scenarios, 5 capture conditions, and 50 one-class tasks, testing robustness to visual nuisance factors.

entry.title: SGR-OCC: Evolving Monocular Priors for Embodied 3D Occupancy Prediction via Soft-Gating Lifting and Semantic-Adaptive Geometric Refinement

author.name: Yiran Guo, Simone Mentasti, Xiaofeng Jin, Matteo Frosi, Matteo Matteucci

entry.summary: Proposes SGR-OCC for monocular 3D occupancy prediction with soft-gating feature lifting to preserve monocular priors during temporal fusion, addressing 'cold start' instability and depth ambiguity.

entry.title: Revisiting the Perception-Distortion Trade-off with Spatial-Semantic Guided Super-Resolution

author.name: Dan Wang, Haiyan Sun, Shan Du, Z. Jane Wang, Zhaochong An, Serge Belongie, Xinrui Cui

entry.summary: Proposes SpaSemSR, a spatial-semantic guided diffusion framework for super-resolution that integrates object-level spatial grounding with semantic text guidance to balance perceptual quality and fidelity.

entry.title: Joint Segmentation and Grading with Iterative Optimization for Multimodal Glaucoma Diagnosis

author.name: Zhiwei Wang, Yuxing Li, Meilu Zhu, Defeng He, Edmund Y. Lam

entry.summary: Proposes an iterative multimodal optimization model for joint glaucoma segmentation and grading that fuses fundus and OCT data through cross-modal feature alignment and diffusion-based refinement.

entry.title: DC-ViT: Modulating Spatial and Channel Interactions for Multi-Channel Images

author.name: Umar Marikkar, Syed Sameed Husain, Muhammad Awais, Sara Atito

entry.summary: Proposes DC-ViT, a decoupled Vision Transformer for multi-channel imaging that preserves channel-specific semantics by controlling spatial and channel interactions.

entry.title: LoCAtion: Long-time Collaborative Attention Framework for High Dynamic Range Video Reconstruction

author.name: Qianyu Zhang, Bolun Zheng, Lingyu Zhu, Aiai Huang, Zongpeng Li, Shiqi Wang

entry.summary: LoCAtion proposes a long-time collaborative attention framework for HDR video reconstruction that replaces explicit alignment-and-fusion with attention-based implicit alignment.

entry.title: G-ZAP: A Generalizable Zero-Shot Framework for Arbitrary-Scale Pansharpening

author.name: Zhiqi Yang, Shan Yin, Jingze Liang, Liang-Jian Deng

entry.summary: G-ZAP proposes a generalizable zero-shot framework for arbitrary-scale pansharpening that handles cross-resolution, cross-scene, and cross-sensor generalization without per-image optimization.

entry.title: Wi-Spike: A Low-power WiFi Human Multi-action Recognition Model with Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Nengbo Zhang, Yao Ying, Lu Wang, Kaishun Wu, Jieming Ma, Fei Luo

entry.summary: Wi-Spike introduces a spiking neural network framework for WiFi-based human action recognition, leveraging bio-inspired event-driven processing for energy efficiency.

entry.title: Expanding mmWave Datasets for Human Pose Estimation with Unlabeled Data and LiDAR Datasets

author.name: Zhuoxuan Peng, Boan Zhu, Xingjian Zhang, Wenying Li, S. -H. Gary Chan

entry.summary: EMDUL expands mmWave datasets for human pose estimation by using pseudo-labels for unlabeled data and converting LiDAR datasets to mmWave counterparts.

entry.title: From Artefact to Insight: Efficient Low-Rank Adaptation of BrushNet for Scanning Probe Microscopy Image Restoration

author.name: Ziwei Wei, Yao Shen, Wanheng Lu, Ghim Wei Ho, Kaiyang Zeng

entry.summary: Adapts BrushNet diffusion model with LoRA fine-tuning (0.2% of weights) for removing structured artifacts from Scanning Probe Microscopy images. Introduces SPM InpBench benchmark using only 739 experimental scans.

entry.title: SpiralDiff: Spiral Diffusion with LoRA for RGB-to-RAW Conversion Across Cameras

author.name: Huanjing Yue, Shangbin Xie, Cong Cao, Qian Wu, Lei Zhang, Lei Zhao, Jingyu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes SpiralDiff, a diffusion-based RGB-to-RAW conversion framework with signal-dependent noise weighting and CamLoRA for camera-specific adaptation, addressing intensity-dependent reconstruction difficulty.

entry.title: GT-PCQA: Geometry-Texture Decoupled Point Cloud Quality Assessment with MLLM

author.name: Guohua Zhang, Jian Jin, Meiqin Liu, Chao Yao, Weisi Lin, Yao Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes GT-PCQA, an MLLM-based no-reference point cloud quality assessment framework that decouples geometry and texture evaluation, addressing MLLMs' insufficient sensitivity to geometric degradations.

entry.title: The Good, the Better, and the Best: Improving the Discriminability of Face Embeddings through Attribute-aware Learning

author.name: Ana Dias, Jo\~ao Ribeiro Pinto, Hugo Proen\c{c}a, Jo\~ao C. Neves

entry.summary: Proposes an attribute-aware face recognition architecture that learns varying discriminative power across facial attributes rather than assuming equal relevance, improving performance under challenging conditions.

entry.title: Steering Generative Models for Accessibility: EasyRead Image Generation

author.name: Nicolas Dickenmann, Yanis Merzouki, Sonia Laguna, Thy Nowak-Tran, Emanuele Palumbo, Julia E. Vogt, Gerda Binder

entry.summary: Explores steering diffusion models to generate EasyRead pictograms for accessibility, addressing the need for simple, clear images for people with intellectual disabilities or low literacy. Tackles the challenge that standard models produce overly detailed outputs.

entry.title: Covariance-Guided Resource Adaptive Learning for Efficient Edge Inference

author.name: Ahmad N. L. Nabhaan, Zaki Sukma, Rakandhiya D. Rachmanto, Muhammad Husni Santriaji, Byungjin Cho, Arief Setyanto, In Kee Kim

entry.summary: CORAL is an online optimization method for deep learning inference on edge devices that discovers near-optimal hardware configurations without offline profiling, using distance covariance to capture non-linear dependencies between hardware settings and performance.

entry.title: Seeing Where to Deploy: Metric RGB-Based Traversability Analysis for Aerial-to-Ground Hidden Space Inspection

author.name: Seoyoung Lee, Shaekh Mohammad Shithil, Durgakant Pushp, Lantao Liu, Zhangyang Wang

entry.summary: Presents a metric RGB-based framework for aerial-to-ground robot deployment, enabling a UAV to assess terrain traversability for deploying a ground robot into confined spaces like culverts using geometric-semantic reconstruction.

entry.title: Safety-guaranteed and Goal-oriented Semantic Sensing, Communication, and Control for Robotics

author.name: Wenchao Wu, Shutong Chen, Wenjie Liu, Zhibo Pang, Yansha Deng

entry.summary: Proposes goal-oriented semantic communication for robotics that explicitly incorporates safety requirements alongside effectiveness metrics, using safety constraints as top priority in wirelessly-connected robotic systems.

entry.title: End-to-End O-RAN Testbed for Edge-AI-Enabled 5G/6G Connected Industrial Robotics

author.name: Sasa Talosi, Vladimir Vincan, Srdjan Sobot, Goran Martic, Vladimir Morosev, Vukan Ninkovic, Dragisa Miskovic, Dejan Vukobratovic

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end O-RAN testbed for edge-AI-enabled 5G/6G connected industrial robotics, demonstrating Edge AI as a Service (E-AIaaS) for offloading compute-intensive perception/control to network edge.

entry.title: Path-conditioned Reinforcement Learning-based Local Planning for Long-Range Navigation

author.name: Mateo Haro, Julia Richter, Fan Yang, Cesar Cadena, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: Proposes an RL-based local navigation policy conditioned on global reference path observations, improving long-range navigation by providing global context while maintaining reactive local control.

entry.title: Vision-guided Autonomous Dual-arm Extraction Robot for Bell Pepper Harvesting

author.name: Kshitij Madhav Bhat, Tom Gao, Abhishek Mathur, Rohit Satishkumar, Francisco Yandun, Dominik Bauer, Nancy Pollard

entry.summary: VADER is a dual-arm mobile manipulation system for autonomous bell pepper harvesting in outdoor environments, integrating perception and dual-arm planning for agricultural robotics.

entry.title: CORAL: COntextual Reasoning And Local Planning in A Hierarchical VLM Framework for Underwater Monitoring

author.name: Zhenqi Wu, Yuanjie Lu, Xuesu Xiao, Xiaomin Lin

entry.summary: CORAL is a hierarchical VLM framework for autonomous underwater monitoring of oyster reefs. It separates high-level contextual reasoning from local planning to avoid having the VLM generate every navigation decision, addressing limitations of end-to-end VLM-driven systems.

entry.title: GraspALL: Adaptive Structural Compensation from Illumination Variation for Robotic Garment Grasping in Any Low-Light Conditions

author.name: Haifeng Zhong, Wenshuo Han, Zhouyu Wang, Runyang Feng, Fan Tang, Tong-Yee Lee, Zipei Fan, Ruihai Wu, Yuran Wang, Hao Dong, Hechang Chen, Hyung Jin Chang, Yixing Gao

entry.summary: GraspALL addresses garment grasping under varying illumination by adaptively compensating structural features using multimodal fusion. Proposes an illumination-structure interactive compensation model that adjusts dependence on non-RGB features based on lighting conditions.

entry.title: From Folding Mechanics to Robotic Function: A Unified Modeling Framework for Compliant Origami

author.name: Bohan Zhang, Bo Wang, Huajiang Ouyang, Zhigang Wu, Haohao Bi, Jiawei Xu, Mingchao Liu, Weicheng Huang

entry.summary: Introduces a geometry-consistent modeling framework for compliant origami based on discrete differential geometry, unifying panel elasticity and crease rotation. Enables simulation of rigid folding, elastic deformation, and stability-driven transitions for origami-inspired robotic systems.

entry.title: CycleRL: Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robust Autonomous Bicycle Control

author.name: Gelu Liu, Teng Wang, Zhijie Wu, Junliang Wu, Songyuan Li, Xiangwei Zhu

entry.summary: CycleRL presents the first sim-to-real deep RL framework for autonomous bicycle control, training end-to-end neural policies in NVIDIA Isaac Sim using PPO. Demonstrates successful transfer to real hardware for balance and navigation tasks.

entry.title: GNIO: Gated Neural Inertial Odometry

author.name: Dapeng Feng, Yizhen Yin, Zhiqiang Chen, Yuhua Qi, Hongbo Chen

entry.summary: GNIO introduces Gated Neural Inertial Odometry with a learnable Motion Bank (global dictionary of motion patterns) and a Gated Prediction Head that decomposes displacement into motion-active and stationary modes. Addresses micro-drift during stationarity and mode fusion issues.

entry.title: EAAE: Energy-Aware Autonomous Exploration for UAVs in Unknown 3D Environments

author.name: Jacob Elskamp, Moji Shi, Leonard Bauersfeld, Davide Scaramuzza, Marija Popovi\'c

entry.summary: EAAE proposes energy-aware autonomous 3D exploration for UAVs that makes energy an explicit decision variable during frontier selection. Clusters frontiers, plans feasible trajectories, and predicts energy costs to optimize exploration under battery constraints.

entry.title: Do LLMs Have Stable Preferences?

author.name: Robert Gambee

entry.summary: Experiments testing whether GPT-5 mini and Claude Haiku 4.5 have stable preferences when presented with pairwise task comparisons. Explores revealed preferences across different response formats and option lengths.

entry.title: SFF-2026 S-Process Grant Round Application Announcement

author.name: Ethan Ashkie

entry.summary: The Survival and Flourishing Fund announces a new grant round planning to distribute $20-40MM across multiple tracks, including main funding and themed rounds on Climate Change, Animal Welfare, and Human Self-Enhancement. The round is organized in collaboration with Jaan Tallinn and includes a Speculation Grant mechanism for eligibility.

entry.title: Histo-MExNet: A Unified Framework for Real-World, Cross-Magnification, and Trustworthy Breast Cancer Histopathology

author.name: Enam Ahmed Taufika, Md Ahasanul Arafatha, Abhijit Kumar Ghoshb, Md. Tanzim Rezab, Md Ashad Alamc

entry.summary: Histo-MExNet proposes a multi-expert framework for breast cancer histopathology classification with uncertainty quantification and physics-informed regularization.

entry.title: Low-light Image Enhancement with Retinex Decomposition in Latent Space

author.name: Bolun Zheng, Qingshan Lei, Quan Chen, Qianyu Zhang, Kainan Yu, Xu Jia, Lingyu Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a Retinex-guided Transformer for low-light image enhancement using latent space decomposition with log transformation for stable reflectance-illumination separation.

entry.title: Pointing-Based Object Recognition

author.name: Luk\'a\v{s} Hajd\'uch, Viktor Kocur

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline for pointing-based object recognition integrating object detection, pose estimation, depth estimation, and VLMs to identify objects targeted by human pointing gestures.

entry.title: AeroGrab: A Unified Framework for Aerial Grasping in Cluttered Environments

author.name: Shivansh Pratap Singh, Naveen Sudheer Nair, Samaksh Ujjawal, Sarthak Mishra, Soham Patil, Rishabh Dev Yadav, Spandan Roy

entry.summary: AeroGrab presents an integrated pipeline for aerial grasping in cluttered environments combining language-guided target identification, active exploration for better views, 6-DoF grasp generation, and collision-aware evaluation.

entry.title: Enhanced Atrial Fibrillation Prediction in ESUS Patients with Hypergraph-based Pre-training

author.name: Yuzhang Xie, Yuhua Wu, Ruiyu Wang, Fadi Nahab, Xiao Hu, Carl Yang

entry.summary: Introduces hypergraph-based pre-training strategies to improve atrial fibrillation prediction in ESUS patients, pre-training on a large stroke cohort (7,780 patients) and transferring to smaller ESUS cohorts.

entry.title: Locally Linear Continual Learning for Time Series based on VC-Theoretical Generalization Bounds

author.name: Yan V. G. Ferreira, Igor B. Lima, Pedro H. G. Mapa S., Felipe V. Campos, Antonio P. Braga

entry.summary: Proposes SyMPLER, an explainable continual learning model for time series forecasting in nonstationary environments using piecewise-linear approximations guided by VC-theory generalization bounds.

entry.title: Evaluating Semantic Fragility in Text-to-Audio Generation Systems Under Controlled Prompt Perturbations

author.name: Jiahui Wu

entry.summary: Evaluates semantic fragility of text-to-audio models (MusicGen, Stable Audio) under controlled prompt perturbations, finding that small linguistic changes lead to substantial variation in generated audio.

entry.title: Deep EM with Hierarchical Latent Label Modelling for Multi-Site Prostate Lesion Segmentation

author.name: Wen Yan, Yipei Wang, Shiqi Huang, Natasha Thorley, Mark Emberton, Vasilis Stavrinides, Yipeng Hu, Dean Barratt

entry.summary: Proposes HierEM, a hierarchical expectation-maximization framework for prostate lesion segmentation that treats annotations as noisy observations and estimates site-specific label quality under a hierarchical prior.

entry.title: PiGRAND: Physics-informed Graph Neural Diffusion for Intelligent Additive Manufacturing

author.name: Benjamin Uhrich, Tim H\"antschel, Erhard Rahm

entry.summary: Presents PiGRAND, a physics-informed graph neural diffusion framework for heat transport prediction in 3D printing, combining graph learning with physics-based constraints and efficient graph construction.

entry.title: CLIPoint3D: Language-Grounded Few-Shot Unsupervised 3D Point Cloud Domain Adaptation

author.name: Mainak Singha, Sarthak Mehrotra, Paolo Casari, Subhasis Chaudhuri, Elisa Ricci, Biplab Banerjee

entry.summary: Introduces CLIPoint3D, the first CLIP-based framework for few-shot unsupervised 3D point cloud domain adaptation, projecting 3D samples into depth maps and using knowledge-driven prompt tuning with frozen CLIP backbone.

entry.title: Generative Semantic HARQ: Latent-Space Text Retransmission and Combining

author.name: Bin Han, Yulin Hu, Hans D. Schotten

entry.summary: Proposes semantic-level HARQ for text communication using a Transformer-VAE codec that generates diverse latent representations across retransmissions, providing incremental knowledge without dedicated protocol design.

entry.title: The GELATO Dataset for Legislative NER

author.name: Matthew Flynn, Timothy Obiso, Sam Newman

entry.summary: Introduces GELATO, a dataset of US legislative bills annotated with a two-level NER ontology, using BERT/RoBERTa for first-level and LLMs for second-level entity prediction.

entry.title: Vietnamese Automatic Speech Recognition: A Revisit

author.name: Thi Vu, Linh The Nguyen, Dat Quoc Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes a generalizable data aggregation and preprocessing pipeline for constructing high-quality Vietnamese ASR datasets from noisy open-source sources, demonstrating state-of-the-art results for Vietnamese speech recognition.

entry.title: ViX-Ray: A Vietnamese Chest X-Ray Dataset for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Duy Vu Minh Nguyen, Chinh Thanh Truong, Phuc Hoang Tran, Hung Tuan Le, Nguyen Van-Thanh Dat, Trung Hieu Pham, Kiet Van Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces ViX-Ray, a dataset of 5,400 Vietnamese chest X-ray images with expert-written findings and impressions for evaluating vision-language models in Vietnamese medical diagnosis.

entry.title: MOGeo: Beyond One-to-One Cross-View Object Geo-localization

author.name: Bo Lv, Qingwang Zhang, Le Wu, Yuanyuan Li, Yingying Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes CVMOGL (Cross-View Multi-Object Geo-Localization) task and MOGeo method for locating multiple objects from query images in satellite imagery, with new benchmark datasets.

entry.title: DCP-CLIP:A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with Dual Interaction

author.name: Jing Wang, Huimin Shi, Quan Zhou, Qibo Liu, Suofei Zhang, Huimin Lu

entry.summary: Proposes DCP-CLIP for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation with dynamic category-relevant textual features and dual spatial-class interactions, reducing computation with massive category sets.

entry.title: Enhancing Eye Feature Estimation from Event Data Streams through Adaptive Inference State Space Modeling

author.name: Viet Dung Nguyen, Mobina Ghorbaninejad, Chengyi Ma, Reynold Bailey, Gabriel J. Diaz, Alexander Fix, Ryan J. Suess, Alexander Ororbia

entry.summary: Introduces AISSM (Adaptive Inference State Space Model) for eye feature extraction from event data, dynamically adjusting information weighting based on signal-to-noise ratio and event density.

entry.title: Multi-Period Texture Contrast Enhancement for Low-Contrast Wafer Defect Detection and Segmentation

author.name: Zihan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TexWDS for wafer defect segmentation using texture-aware multi-scale feature retention and frequency-domain perturbation modeling to detect low-contrast defects.

entry.title: In-Field 3D Wheat Head Instance Segmentation From TLS Point Clouds Using Deep Learning Without Manual Labels

author.name: Tomislav Medic, Liangliang Nan

entry.summary: Addresses in-field wheat head instance segmentation from terrestrial laser scanning point clouds using a two-stage pipeline that avoids manual annotations through synthetic-to-real transfer.

entry.title: Efficient Event Camera Volume System

author.name: Juan Camilo Soto, Ian Noronha, Saru Bharti, Upinder Kaur

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for efficient event camera data compression using continuous-time Dirac impulse modeling with adaptive transform selection based on event density.

entry.title: SemanticFace: Semantic Facial Action Estimation via Semantic Distillation in Interpretable Space

author.name: Zejian Kang, Kai Zheng, Yuanchen Fei, Wentao Yang, Hongyuan Zou, Xiangru Huang

entry.summary: SemanticFace reformulates ARKit blendshape coefficient prediction as structured semantic reasoning through a two-stage distillation paradigm for interpretable facial action estimation.

entry.title: Pansharpening for Thin-Cloud Contaminated Remote Sensing Images: A Unified Framework and Benchmark Dataset

author.name: Songcheng Du, Yang Zou, Jiaxin Li, Mingxuan Liu, Ying Li, Changjing Shang, Qiang Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Pan-TCR, an end-to-end pansharpening framework with thin cloud removal using frequency-decoupled restoration, addressing the joint degradation of spatial resolution loss and cloud-induced spectral distortion.

entry.title: Thermal Image Refinement with Depth Estimation using Recurrent Networks for Monocular ORB-SLAM3

author.name: H\"urkan \c{S}ahin, Huy Xuan Pham, Van Huyen Dang, Alper Yegenoglu, Erdal Kayacan

entry.summary: Proposes a pipeline for thermal image depth estimation and SLAM on UAVs using recurrent networks with a thermal refinement network for GPS-denied environments.

entry.title: Vision-Language Model Based Multi-Expert Fusion for CT Image Classification

author.name: Jianfa Bai, Kejin Lu, Runtian Yuan, Qingqiu Li, Jilan Xu, Junlin Hou, Yuejie Zhang, Rui Feng

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-expert framework for COVID-19 CT classification using source-aware fusion of 3D volumetric and MedSigLIP-based experts with source classifier for multi-institutional settings.

entry.title: Physically Accurate Rigid-Body Dynamics in Particle-Based Simulation

author.name: Ava Abderezaei, Nataliya Nechyporenko, Joseph Miceli, Gilberto Briscoe-Martinez, Alessandro Roncone

entry.summary: Proposes improvements to position-based dynamics (PBD) particle simulations to achieve physical accuracy suitable for robotics, while maintaining the computational efficiency and unified material representation benefits of particle-based approaches.

entry.title: Multi-Mode Pneumatic Artificial Muscles Driven by Hybrid Positive-Negative Pressure

author.name: Siyuan Feng, Ruoyu Feng, Shuguang Li

entry.summary: Introduces IN-FOAMs: inflatable fluid-driven origami-inspired artificial muscles that combine positive and negative pressures. Made from heat-sealable sheet materials, they're ultra-thin when not actuated and capable of contracting, bending, twisting, and rotating motions.

entry.title: Distributional Uncertainty and Adaptive Decision-Making in System

author.name: Yujun Huang, Gioele Zardini

entry.summary: Develops a distributional extension of monotone co-design that models uncertain design outcomes as distributions and supports adaptive decision processes through Markov-kernel representations. Goes beyond interval bounds to represent probabilistic risk.

entry.title: Optimizing LLM Annotation of Classroom Discourse through Multi-Agent Orchestration

author.name: Bakhtawar Ahtisham, Kirk Vanacore, Rene F. Kizilcec

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent orchestration approach for LLM annotation of classroom discourse, addressing the unreliability of single-pass LLM outputs for educational constructs requiring pedagogical judgment.

entry.title: Memory as Asset: From Agent-centric to Human-centric Memory Management

author.name: Yanqi Pan, Qinghao Huang, Weihao Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Memory-as-Asset paradigm for human-centric AGI where personal memory is owned by users (Memory in Hand), shared collaboratively (Memory Group), and evolves continuously (Collective Memory Evolution).

entry.title: Algorithms for Deciding the Safety of States in Fully Observable Non-deterministic Problems: Technical Report

author.name: Johannes Schmalz, Chaahat Jain

entry.summary: Presents improved algorithms for deciding state safety in fully observable non-deterministic planning problems, closing the gap between exponential worst-case TarjanSafe and slower linear-time alternatives.

entry.title: FastODT: A tree-based framework for efficient continual learning
