entry.summary: MOCR presents a multimodal OCR paradigm that jointly parses text and graphics (charts, diagrams, tables) into unified textual representations, treating visual elements as first-class parsing targets rather than cropped pixels.

entry.title: MXNorm: Reusing MXFP block scales for efficient tensor normalisation

author.name: Callum McLean, Luke Y. Prince, Alexandre Payot, Paul Balan\c{c}a, and Carlo Luschi

entry.summary: MXNorm proposes replacing RMSNorm with an approximation that reuses block scaling factors already computed during MXFP8 quantization, achieving a 32x reduction in reduction operations needed for normalization. Validated on Llama 3 models up to 8B parameters with minimal accuracy loss.

entry.title: Emergent stigmergic coordination in AI agents?

author.name: David Africa

entry.summary: Draws an analogy between Anthropic's finding that multi-agent web interactions create persistent environmental traces (via auto-generated web pages from search queries) and stigmergic coordination in ant colonies. Suggests this is a novel contamination vector for evaluations.

entry.title: Influence Malleability in Linearized Attention: Dual Implications of Non-Convergent NTK Dynamics

author.name: Jose Marie Antonio Mi\~noza, Paulo Mario P. Medina, Sebastian C. Iba\~nez

entry.summary: Reveals that linearized attention does not converge to its infinite-width NTK limit due to spectral amplification that cubes the Gram matrix condition number, requiring impractically large widths for convergence. This non-convergence has dual implications for both vulnerability and adaptability.

entry.title: ActTail: Global Activation Sparsity in Large Language Models

author.name: Wenwen Hou, Xinyuan Song, Shiwei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes ActTail, a global activation sparsity method for LLM inference that assigns per-projection sparsity budgets based on heavy-tail exponents from the empirical spectral density, rather than applying uniform sparsity across all projections.

entry.title: Thermodynamics of Reinforcement Learning Curricula

author.name: Jacob Adamczyk and Juan Sebastian Rojas and Rahul V. Kulkarni

entry.summary: Proposes a thermodynamic framework for curriculum learning in RL, interpreting reward parameters as coordinates on a task manifold and showing that optimal curricula correspond to geodesics minimizing excess thermodynamic work. Derives MEW algorithm for temperature annealing in max-entropy RL.

entry.title: Revisiting Model Stitching In the Foundation Model Era

author.name: Zheda Mai, Ke Zhang, Fu-En Wang, Zixiao Ken Wang, Albert Y. C. Chen, Lu Xia, Min Sun, Wei-Lun Chao, Cheng-Hao Kuo

entry.summary: Revisits model stitching — connecting layers of different models — for Vision Foundation Models like CLIP, DINOv2, and SigLIP 2. Finds that heterogeneous VFMs are more stitchable than expected when using proper training loss and stitch layer design.

entry.title: The Perfection Paradox: From Architect to Curator in AI-Assisted API Design

author.name: Mak Ahmad, Andrew Macvean, JJ Geewax, David Karger

entry.summary: Presents a case study showing AI-generated API designs scored higher than human ones on 10 of 11 usability dimensions with 87% less authoring time, but identifies a 'Perfection Paradox' where hyper-consistency signals lack of pragmatic judgment.

entry.title: Do You See What I Am Pointing At? Gesture-Based Egocentric Video Question Answering

author.name: Yura Choi, Roy Miles, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias, Ismail Elezi, Jiankang Deng, Stefanos Zafeiriou

entry.summary: EgoPointVQA introduces a dataset and benchmark for gesture-grounded egocentric question answering with Hand Intent Tokens (HINT) that encode 3D hand keypoints to provide spatial context. Addresses the gap in understanding pointing gestures for egocentric AI assistants.

entry.title: A2Z-10M+: Geometric Deep Learning with A-to-Z BRep Annotations for AI-Assisted CAD Modeling and Reverse Engineering

author.name: Pritham Kumar Jena, Bhavika Baburaj, Tushar Anand, Vedant Dutta, Vineeth Ulavala, Sk Aziz Ali

entry.summary: Presents A2Z-10M+, the largest compilation of 10 million multi-modal annotations for 1 million CAD models, including meshes, hand-drawn sketches, geometric info, and textual captions for BRep learning.

entry.title: LightMoE: Reducing Mixture-of-Experts Redundancy through Expert Replacing

author.name: Jiawei Hao, Zhiwei Hao, Jianyuan Guo, Li Shen, Yong Luo, Han Hu, Dan Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes LightMoE, an expert compression paradigm that replaces redundant MoE experts with parameter-efficient modules and recovers capabilities with low training cost, avoiding irreversible knowledge loss from pruning/merging.

entry.title: VGGT-World: Transforming VGGT into an Autoregressive Geometry World Model

author.name: Xiangyu Sun, Shijie Wang, Fengyi Zhang, Lin Liu, Caiyan Jia, Ziying Song, Zi Huang, Yadan Luo

entry.summary: Introduces VGGT-World, a geometry world model that forecasts temporal evolution of frozen geometry-foundation-model features rather than generating video frames, using a lightweight temporal flow transformer for autoregressive prediction.

entry.title: MetaKE: Meta-learning Aligned Knowledge Editing via Bi-level Optimization

author.name: Shuxin Liu, Ou Wu

entry.summary: Proposes MetaKE, reframing knowledge editing as bi-level optimization where edit targets are learnable meta-parameters, addressing the 'Semantic-Execution Disconnect' in current knowledge editing methods.

entry.title: Show, Don't Tell: Detecting Novel Objects by Watching Human Videos

author.name: James Akl, Jose Nicolas Avendano Arbelaez, James Barabas, Jennifer L. Barry, Kalie Ching, Noam Eshed, Jiahui Fu, Michel Hidalgo, Andrew Hoelscher, Tushar Kusnur, Andrew Messing, Zachary Nagler, Brian Okorn, Mauro Passerino, Tim J. Perkins, Eric Rosen, Ankit Shah, Tanmay Shankar, Scott Shaw

entry.summary: Presents 'Show, Don't Tell,' a self-supervised system for robot object detection that trains a bespoke detector from human demonstration videos, eliminating the need for language descriptions or prompt engineering to recognize novel objects.

entry.title: A Multi-task Large Reasoning Model for Molecular Science

author.name: Pengfei Liu, Shuang Ge, Jun Tao and Zhixiang Ren

entry.summary: Introduces a multi-task large reasoning model for molecular science that emulates cognitive processes through structured reasoning and chain-of-thought enhanced by reinforcement learning with molecular knowledge.

entry.title: Composing Driving Worlds through Disentangled Control for Adversarial Scenario Generation

author.name: Yifan Zhan, Zhengqing Chen, Qingjie Wang, Zhuo He, Muyao Niu, Xiaoyang Guo, Wei Yin, Weiqiang Ren, Qian Zhang, Yinqiang Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces CompoSIA, a compositional driving video simulator that disentangles scene structure, object identity, and ego actions for fine-grained adversarial scenario generation with noise-level identity injection.

entry.title: MotionAnymesh: Physics-Grounded Articulation for Simulation-Ready Digital Twins

author.name: WenBo Xu, Liu Liu, Li Zhang, Dan Guo, RuoNan Liu

entry.summary: MotionAnymesh converts static 3D meshes into simulation-ready articulated digital twins using a zero-shot pipeline. It addresses kinematic hallucinations in VLMs by grounding reasoning with physical priors and preventing mesh inter-penetration during simulation.

entry.title: ESPIRE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yanpeng Zhao, Wentao Ding, Hongtao Li, Baoxiong Jia, Zilong Zheng

entry.summary: ESPIRE is a diagnostic benchmark for embodied spatial reasoning in VLMs, providing a simulated world that evaluates spatial reasoning through robotic tasks decomposed into localization and execution, framed as generative problems.

entry.title: Mending the Holes: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning for Multilingual Translation

author.name: Yifeng Liu, Siqi Ouyang, Yatish Hosmane Revanasiddappa, Lei Li

entry.summary: WALAR is a reinforcement learning method for improving multilingual translation using only monolingual text, addressing reward hacking in quality estimation models that occurs when RL amplifies failure modes of QE models.

entry.title: Topo-R1: Detecting Topological Anomalies via Vision-Language Models

author.name: Meilong Xu, Qingqiao Hu, Xiaoling Hu, Shahira Abousamra, Xin Yu, Weimin Lyu, Kehan Qi, Dimitris Samaras, Chao Chen

entry.summary: Topo-R1 applies GRPO reinforcement learning to train VLMs for detecting topological anomalies in segmentation masks of tubular structures, finding that standard VLMs perform near-random on this task without specialized training.

entry.title: Reasoning over Video: Evaluating How MLLMs Extract, Integrate, and Reconstruct Spatiotemporal Evidence

author.name: Seunghwan Bang and Hwanjun Song

entry.summary: Formalizes abstractive spatiotemporal reasoning from videos and constructs a controlled synthetic benchmark to evaluate whether MLLMs can integrate observations over time and infer implicit spatial structure, beyond just extracting explicit answers.

entry.title: Learnability and Privacy Vulnerability are Entangled in a Few Critical Weights

author.name: Xingli Fang and Jung-Eun Kim

entry.summary: Reveals that privacy vulnerability in neural networks is concentrated in a very small fraction of weights, and that these same weights are critical for utility. Proposes a method that scores and rewinds only critical weights rather than retraining entire networks, achieving better privacy-utility tradeoffs.

entry.title: Some models don't identify with their official name

author.name: jordine

entry.summary: Systematic survey of 102 LLMs finding that 36 models self-report as a different model on at least one prompt (e.g., DeepSeek V3 claiming to be ChatGPT, Claude Sonnet 4.6 saying it's DeepSeek). Maps out identity confusion across current models with replication of prior informal observations.

entry.title: Budget-Sensitive Discovery Scoring: A Formally Verified Framework for Evaluating AI-Guided Scientific Selection

author.name: Abhinaba Basu, Pavan Chakraborty

entry.summary: Introduces Budget-Sensitive Discovery Score (BSDS), a formally verified evaluation metric for AI-guided scientific candidate selection that jointly penalizes false discoveries and excessive abstention at each budget level. Features 20 theorems machine-checked in Lean 4.

entry.title: Diagnosing Retrieval Bias Under Multiple In-Context Knowledge Updates in Large Language Models

author.name: Boyu Qiao, Sean Guo, Xian Yang, Kun Li, Wei Zhou, Songlin Hu, Yunya Song

entry.summary: Studies how LLMs handle multiple in-context knowledge updates for the same fact, drawing from cognitive psychology's AB-AC interference paradigm. Introduces a Dynamic Knowledge Instance evaluation framework and finds systematic retrieval biases across models.

entry.title: Generalist Large Language Models for Molecular Property Prediction: Distilling Knowledge from Specialist Models

author.name: Khiem Le, Sreejata Dey, Marcos Mart\'inez Galindo, Vanessa Lopez, Ting Hua, Nitesh V. Chawla, Hoang Thanh Lam

entry.summary: Proposes TreeKD, a knowledge distillation method that transfers knowledge from tree-based models to LLMs for molecular property prediction by verbalizing decision tree rules as natural language for in-context learning. Includes a rule-consistency test-time scaling technique.

entry.title: ABRA: Teleporting Fine-Tuned Knowledge Across Domains for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

author.name: Mattia Bernardi, Chiara Cappellino, Matteo Mosconi, Enver Sangineto, Angelo Porrello and Simone Calderara

entry.summary: ABRA introduces a method for transferring detection knowledge from a labeled source domain to target domains (e.g., nighttime, foggy) for open-vocabulary object detection, formulating adaptation as a geometric transport problem in weight space.

entry.title: Learning Pore-scale Multiphase Flow from 4D Velocimetry

author.name: Chunyang Wang, Linqi Zhu, Yuxuan Gu, Robert van der Merwe, Xin Ju, Catherine Spurin, Samuel Krevor, Rex Ying, Tobias Pfaff, Martin J. Blunt, Tom Bultreys, Gege Wen

entry.summary: Introduces a multimodal learning framework for pore-scale multiphase flow prediction that couples graph network simulators for Lagrangian particles with 3D U-Nets for interface evolution, trained on experimental 4D micro-velocimetry data.

entry.title: Lyapunov Stable Graph Neural Flow

author.name: Haoyu Chu, Xiaotong Chen, Wei Zhou, Wenjun Cui, Kai Zhao, Shikui Wei, Qiyu Kang

entry.summary: Proposes Lyapunov Stable Graph Neural Flow that constrains GNN feature-update dynamics using integer- and fractional-order Lyapunov stability theory, providing theoretically provable stability guarantees against adversarial perturbations.

entry.title: Accelerating materials discovery using foundation model based In-context active learning

author.name: Jeffrey Hu, Rongzhi Dong, Ying Feng, Ming Hu, Jianjun Hu

entry.summary: Proposes In-Context Active Learning (ICAL) using TabPFN, a transformer-based foundation model, as a surrogate for materials discovery, replacing GP and RF surrogates that struggle with small-data regimes common in materials science.

entry.title: RTD-Guard: A Black-Box Textual Adversarial Detection Framework via Replacement Token Detection

author.name: He Zhu, Yanshu Li, Wen Liu, Haitian Yang

entry.summary: RTD-Guard is a black-box framework for detecting textual adversarial examples by leveraging the insight that word-substitution perturbations resemble 'replaced tokens' that pre-trained discriminators are already trained to identify.

entry.title: Neural Gate: Mitigating Privacy Risks in LVLMs via Neuron-Level Gradient Gating

author.name: Xiangkui Cao, Jie Zhang, Meina Kan, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Neural Gate, a neuron-level gradient gating mechanism for LVLMs that mitigates privacy risks by selectively controlling information flow, addressing both generalization to unseen privacy queries and non-destructiveness.

entry.title: FastDSAC: Unlocking the Potential of Maximum Entropy RL in High-Dimensional Humanoid Control

author.name: Jun Xue, Junze Wang, Xinming Zhang, Shanze Wang, Yanjun Chen, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces FastDSAC, which unlocks maximum entropy RL for high-dimensional humanoid control through Dimension-wise Entropy Modulation and a continuous distributional critic, challenging the dominance of deterministic policy gradients.

entry.title: From Sparse to Dense: Multi-View GRPO for Flow Models via Augmented Condition Space

author.name: Jiazi Bu, Pengyang Ling, Yujie Zhou, Yibin Wang, Yuhang Zang, Tianyi Wei, Xiaohang Zhan, Jiaqi Wang, Tong Wu, Xingang Pan, Dahua Lin

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-View GRPO (MV-GRPO) for text-to-image flow models, enhancing GRPO by augmenting the condition space to create dense multi-view reward mappings through semantically adjacent but diverse captions.

entry.title: RetroReasoner: A Reasoning LLM for Strategic Retrosynthesis Prediction

author.name: Hanbum Ko, Chanhui Lee, Ye Rin Kim, Rodrigo Hormazabal, Sehui Han, Sungbin Lim, Sungwoong Kim

entry.summary: Introduces RetroReasoner, an LLM for retrosynthesis that reasons about bond-disconnection strategies explicitly, trained with SFT and reinforcement learning to mimic chemists' strategic thinking.

entry.title: Learning Athletic Humanoid Tennis Skills from Imperfect Human Motion Data

author.name: Zhikai Zhang, Haofei Lu, Yunrui Lian, Ziqing Chen, Yun Liu, Chenghuai Lin, Han Xue, Zicheng Zeng, Zekun Qi, Shaolin Zheng, Qing Luan, Jingbo Wang, Junliang Xing, He Wang, Li Yi

entry.summary: Proposes LATENT, a system for learning athletic humanoid tennis skills from imperfect (fragmented) human motion data rather than requiring complete tennis match recordings, significantly reducing data collection difficulty.

entry.title: AI Model Modulation with Logits Redistribution

author.name: Zihan Wang, Zhongkui Ma, Xinguo Feng, Zhiyang Mei, Ethan Ma, Derui Wang, Minhui Xue, Guangdong Bai

entry.summary: Proposes AIM, a model modulation paradigm enabling a single model to exhibit diverse behaviors through logits redistribution, supporting utility and focus modulation modes without retraining or requiring training data.

entry.title: Coherent Human-Scene Reconstruction from Multi-Person Multi-View Video in a Single Pass

author.name: Sangmin Kim, Minhyuk Hwang, Geonho Cha, Dongyoon Wee, Jaesik Park

entry.summary: Presents CHROMM, a unified framework that jointly estimates cameras, scene point clouds, and human meshes from multi-person multi-view videos without external modules, integrating priors from Pi3X and Multi-HMR.

entry.title: FLUX: Accelerating Cross-Embodiment Generative Navigation Policies via Rectified Flow and Static-to-Dynamic Learning

author.name: Zeying Gong, Yangyi Zhong, Yiyi Ding, Tianshuai Hu, Guoyang Zhao, Lingdong Kong, Rong Li, Jiadi You, Junwei Liang

entry.summary: Introduces FLUX, the first flow-based unified navigation policy for quadrupedal robots using rectified flow to replace iterative denoising, improving inference efficiency by 47% over prior flow-based methods, with a static-to-dynamic curriculum learning approach.

entry.title: Context is all you need: Towards autonomous model-based process design using agentic AI in flowsheet simulations

author.name: Pascal Sch\"afer, Lukas J. Krinke, Martin Wlotzka, Norbert Asprion

entry.summary: Presents an agentic AI framework for chemical process flowsheet simulation, demonstrating that Claude Opus 4.6 with GitHub Copilot can generate valid syntax for industrial process modeling tools using documentation as context.

entry.title: Multimodal Protein Language Models for Enzyme Kinetic Parameters: From Substrate Recognition to Conformational Adaptation

author.name: Fei Wang, Xinye Zheng, Kun Li, Yanyan Wei, Yuxin Liu, Ganpeng Hu, Tong Bao, Jingwen Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal protein language model for predicting enzyme kinetic parameters (kcat, Km, Ki) that models both substrate recognition and conformational adaptation phases of catalysis.

entry.title: Beyond Imitation: Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for Adaptive Diffusion Navigation Policies

author.name: Junhe Sheng, Ruofei Bai, Kuan Xu, Ruimeng Liu, Jie Chen, Shenghai Yuan, Wei-Yun Yau, Lihua Xie

entry.summary: Proposes reinforcement learning fine-tuning for diffusion-based robot navigation policies to address distribution shift in unseen settings, overcoming challenges of gradient backpropagation through iterative denoising.

entry.title: Rethinking VLMs for Image Forgery Detection and Localization

author.name: Shaofeng Guo, Jiequan Cui, Richang Hong

entry.summary: Investigates how to leverage VLMs for image forgery detection and localization, finding that VLM priors can actually hurt performance due to semantic plausibility biases. Proposes using location masks as extra priors to enhance interpretability of detection results.

entry.title: Structured Distillation for Personalized Agent Memory: 11x Token Reduction with Retrieval Preservation

author.name: Sydney Lewis

entry.summary: Studies personalized agent memory compression, distilling conversation histories into compact retrieval layers achieving 11x token reduction while preserving recall across 4,182 conversations from software engineering projects.

entry.title: Purify Once, Edit Freely: Breaking Image Protections under Model Mismatch

author.name: Qichen Zhao, Shengfang Zhai, Xinjian Bai, Qingni Shen, Qiqi Lin, Yansong Gao, Zhonghai Wu

entry.summary: Introduces a unified post-release purification framework showing that adversarial image protections fail under model mismatch—when attackers use different diffusion pipelines than protections were optimized against.

entry.title: Are General-Purpose Vision Models All We Need for 2D Medical Image Segmentation? A Cross-Dataset Empirical Study

author.name: Vanessa Borst and Samuel Kounev

entry.summary: Conducts a controlled empirical study comparing specialized medical segmentation architectures with general-purpose vision models across multiple medical imaging datasets, finding surprising competitiveness of general models.

entry.title: Causal Cellular Context Transfer Learning (C3TL): An Efficient Architecture for Prediction of Unseen Perturbation Effects

author.name: Michael Scholkemper and Sach Mukherjee

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight causal transfer learning framework for predicting cellular perturbation effects that works with bulk molecular data rather than requiring massive single-cell datasets and foundation models.

entry.title: NOIR: Neural Operator mapping for Implicit Representations

author.name: Sidaty El Hadramy and Nazim Haouchine and Michael Wehrli and Philippe C. Cattin

entry.summary: NOIR reframes medical imaging tasks as operator learning between continuous function spaces using implicit neural representations, enabling resolution-independent transformations across segmentation, completion, translation, and synthesis.

entry.title: Towards Spatio-Temporal World Scene Graph Generation from Monocular Videos

author.name: Rohith Peddi, Saurabh, Shravan Shanmugam, Likhitha Pallapothula, Yu Xiang, Parag Singla, Vibhav Gogate

entry.summary: Introduces ActionGenome4D, a dataset upgrading Action Genome videos into 4D scenes with world-frame bounding boxes and dense relationship annotations including for occluded objects. Formalizes World Scene Graph Generation (WSGG), the task of maintaining a persistent world scene graph across time.

entry.title: When Your Model Stops Working: Anytime-Valid Calibration Monitoring

author.name: Tristan Farran

entry.summary: Introduces PITMonitor, an anytime-valid calibration monitor that detects distributional shifts in deployed probabilistic models using mixture e-processes, providing formal Type I error control over unbounded monitoring horizons with Bayesian changepoint estimation.

entry.title: Global Evolutionary Steering: Refining Activation Steering Control via Cross-Layer Consistency

author.name: Xinyan Jiang, Wenjing Yu, Di Wang, Lijie Hu

entry.summary: Proposes GER-steer, a training-free activation steering framework that exploits cross-layer geometric consistency to rectify steering vectors, separating robust semantic intent from noise artifacts in LLM control.

entry.title: 98$\times$ Faster LLM Routing Without a Dedicated GPU: Flash Attention, Prompt Compression, and Near-Streaming for the vLLM Semantic Router

author.name: Xunzhuo Liu, Bowei He, Xue Liu, Andy Luo, Haichen Zhang, Huamin Chen

entry.summary: Presents three staged optimizations (Flash Attention, prompt compression, near-streaming) for vLLM semantic routers on AMD MI300X, achieving 98x speedup while enabling CPU-only operation for safety classification and domain routing.

entry.title: From Text to Forecasts: Bridging Modality Gap with Temporal Evolution Semantic Space

author.name: Lehui Li, Yuyao Wang, Jisheng Yan, Wei Zhang, Jinliang Deng, Haoliang Sun, Zhongyi Han, Yongshun Gong

entry.summary: Proposes TESS, which bridges text and time-series forecasting through a Temporal Evolution Semantic Space of interpretable primitives (mean shift, volatility, shape, lag), addressing the modality gap between qualitative text and quantitative signals.

entry.title: Federated Few-Shot Learning on Neuromorphic Hardware: An Empirical Study Across Physical Edge Nodes

author.name: Steven Motta and Gioele Nanni

entry.summary: First empirical study of federated learning on neuromorphic hardware (BrainChip Akida), running ~1,580 trials and finding that neuron-level concatenation (FedUnion) works while standard FedAvg destroys accuracy due to binary STDP weight updates.

entry.title: Visual-ERM: Reward Modeling for Visual Equivalence

author.name: Ziyu Liu, Shengyuan Ding, Xinyu Fang, Xuanlang Dai, Penghui Yang, Jianze Liang, Jiaqi Wang, Kai Chen, Dahua Lin, Yuhang Zang

entry.summary: Visual-ERM proposes a multimodal generative reward model for vision-to-code tasks (charts, tables, SVGs) that evaluates output quality directly in the rendered visual space rather than through textual rules or coarse embedding similarity. Integrated with reinforcement learning, it improves fine-grained visual fidelity.

entry.title: The Conundrum of Trustworthy Research on Attacking Personally Identifiable Information Removal Techniques

author.name: Sebastian Ochs, Ivan Habernal

entry.summary: Critically analyzes existing attacks on PII removal techniques and finds that reported attack success rates are overestimated due to data leakage and contamination. Concludes that only truly private data can objectively evaluate vulnerability of PII removal.

entry.title: Sinkhorn-Drifting Generative Models

author.name: Ping He, Om Khangaonkar, Hamed Pirsiavash, Yikun Bai, Soheil Kolouri

entry.summary: Establishes a theoretical connection between drifting generative dynamics and Sinkhorn divergence gradient flows, showing both share a cross-minus-self decomposition but with one-sided vs two-sided normalization respectively.

entry.title: Asymptotic and Finite-Time Guarantees for Langevin-Based Temperature Annealing in InfoNCE

author.name: Faris Chaudhry

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of temperature annealing in InfoNCE contrastive learning loss using Langevin dynamics on compact Riemannian manifolds. Shows logarithmic cooling schedules ensure convergence to globally optimal representations while faster schedules risk local minima.

entry.title: TASTE-Streaming: Towards Streamable Text-Aligned Speech Tokenization and Embedding for Spoken Language Modeling

author.name: Liang-Hsuan Tseng, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: Proposes TASTE-S, a streamable extension of text-aligned speech tokenization for spoken language models, integrating CTC-based ASR for instant dual-modality encoding and redesigning the decoder for on-the-fly operation suitable for real-time usage.

entry.title: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework Combining Inductive and Deductive Reasoning for Autonomous Driving Planning

author.name: Hongyan Wei, Wael AbdAlmageed

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic autonomous driving framework that uses an LLM for dynamic scene rule extraction and Answer Set Programming for logical arbitration, bridging discrete symbolic decisions with continuous trajectory planning.

entry.title: FloeNet: A mass-conserving global sea ice emulator that generalizes across climates

author.name: William Gregory, Mitchell Bushuk, James Duncan, Elynn Wu, Adam Subel, Spencer K. Clark, Bill Hurlin, Oliver Watt-Meyer, Alistair Adcroft, Chris Bretherton, Laure Zanna

entry.summary: FloeNet is a mass-conserving ML emulator for global sea ice modeling that generalizes across different climate scenarios (reanalysis, pre-industrial, 1% CO2). It outperforms non-conservative models with volume anomaly correlations above 0.96 in the Antarctic.

entry.title: Bridging the Gap Between Security Metrics and Key Risk Indicators: An Empirical Framework for Vulnerability Prioritization

author.name: Emad Sherif, Iryna Yevseyeva, Vitor Basto-Fernandes, Allan Cook

entry.summary: Proposes a composite Key Risk Indicator for vulnerability prioritization that dramatically outperforms CVSS scores (ROC-AUC 0.927 vs 0.747) on predicting actually exploited vulnerabilities from a dataset of 280K CVEs.

entry.title: Unleashing Video Language Models for Fine-grained HRCT Report Generation

author.name: Yingying Fang and Huichi Zhou and KinHei Lee and Yijia Wang and Zhenxuan Zhang and Jiahao Huang and Guang Yang

entry.summary: AbSteering adapts Video Language Models for HRCT report generation using an abnormality-centric chain-of-thought scheme and Direct Preference Optimization with clinically confusable abnormalities for fine-grained diagnostic accuracy.

entry.title: CALF: Communication-Aware Learning Framework for Distributed Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Carlos Purves and Pietro Lio'

entry.summary: CALF trains RL policies under realistic network models (delays, jitter, packet loss) during simulation, showing that network-aware training substantially reduces deployment performance gaps compared to network-agnostic baselines.

entry.title: Expert Pyramid Tuning: Efficient Parameter Fine-Tuning for Expertise-Driven Task Allocation

author.name: Jia-Chen Zhang, Zhen-Wei Yan, Yu-Jie Xiong and Chun-Ming Xia

entry.summary: Expert Pyramid Tuning (EPT) introduces multi-scale expert hierarchies for MoE-based LoRA fine-tuning, where different experts handle different levels of task complexity from high-level semantics to fine-grained syntactic manipulation.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Speech Models Encode Phonetic Context via Position-dependent Orthogonal Subspaces

author.name: Kwanghee Choi and Eunjung Yeo and Cheol Jun Cho and David R. Mortensen and David Harwath

entry.summary: Demonstrates that self-supervised speech models encode phonetic context via position-dependent orthogonal subspaces, where vectors for previous, current, and next phones are superposed within a single frame representation.

entry.title: Continual Learning in Large Language Models: Methods, Challenges, and Opportunities

author.name: Hongyang Chen, Zhongwu Sun, Hongfei Ye, Kunchi Li, Xuemin Lin

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of continual learning methods for LLMs, covering continual pre-training, fine-tuning, and alignment stages, with comparative analysis of forgetting mitigation mechanisms.

entry.title: Experimental evidence of progressive ChatGPT models self-convergence

author.name: Konstantinos F. Xylogiannopoulos, Petros Xanthopoulos, Panagiotis Karampelas, Georgios A. Bakamitsos

entry.summary: Provides empirical evidence that successive ChatGPT model releases show declining diversity in text generation (self-convergence), measured using text similarity metrics across models over time.

entry.title: VCBench: A Streaming Counting Benchmark for Spatial-Temporal State Maintenance in Long Videos

author.name: Pengyiang Liu, Zhongyue Shi, Hongye Hao, Qi Fu, Xueting Bi, Siwei Zhang, Xiaoyang Hu, Zitian Wang, Linjiang Huang, Si Liu

entry.summary: Introduces VCBench, a streaming counting benchmark for evaluating how video understanding models maintain world state during playback, decomposed into object counting and event counting with fine-grained subcategories.

entry.title: Cost-Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference via Cross-Tier GPU Heterogeneity

author.name: Donglin Yu

entry.summary: Analyzes multimodal LLM inference by showing that partitioning at the modality boundary minimizes cross-device transfer, enabling cost-efficient deployment across heterogeneous GPU tiers.

entry.title: AI Planning Framework for LLM-Based Web Agents

author.name: Orit Shahnovsky and Rotem Dror

entry.summary: Maps modern LLM-based web agent architectures to classical planning paradigms (BFS, Best-First Tree Search, DFS) and proposes five evaluation metrics for diagnosing agent failures like context drift.

entry.title: HIFICL: High-Fidelity In-Context Learning for Multimodal Tasks

author.name: Xiaoyu Li, Yuhang Liu, Zheng Luo, Xuanshuo Kang, Fangqi Lou, Xiaohua Wu, Zihan Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes HIFICL, a high-fidelity in-context learning method for multimodal models that uses virtual key-value pairs and low-rank factorization to more faithfully model the ICL mechanism, reducing computational cost.

entry.title: Forecasting Epileptic Seizures from Contactless Camera via Cross-Species Transfer Learning

author.name: Mingkai Zhai, Wei Wang, Zongsheng Li, Quanying Liu

entry.summary: Formulates video-based epileptic seizure forecasting from pre-ictal video segments and proposes cross-species transfer learning (mouse to human) to address scarce annotated human epilepsy video data.

entry.title: Stake the Points: Structure-Faithful Instance Unlearning

author.name: Kiseong Hong, JungKyoo Shin, Eunwoo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a structure-faithful machine unlearning framework using 'stakes' (semantic anchors from language-driven prototypes) to preserve knowledge structure during targeted data removal.

entry.title: DS$^2$-Instruct: Domain-Specific Data Synthesis for Large Language Models Instruction Tuning

author.name: Ruiyao Xu, Noelle I. Samia, Han Liu

entry.summary: DS²-Instruct is a zero-shot framework for generating domain-specific instruction tuning datasets using task-informed keywords paired with Bloom's Taxonomy cognitive levels, plus self-consistency validation. Evaluated across seven challenging domains.

entry.title: Is Human Annotation Necessary? Iterative MBR Distillation for Error Span Detection in Machine Translation

author.name: Boxuan Lyu, Haiyue Song and Zhi Qu

entry.summary: Proposes Iterative MBR Distillation for machine translation error span detection that eliminates reliance on human annotations by using LLM-generated pseudo-labels, outperforming supervised baselines trained on human annotations.

entry.title: SAW: Toward a Surgical Action World Model via Controllable and Scalable Video Generation

author.name: Sampath Rapuri, Lalithkumar Seenivasan, Dominik Schneider, Roger Soberanis-Mukul, Yufan He, Hao Ding, Jiru Xu, Chenhao Yu, Chenyan Jing, Pengfei Guo, Daguang Xu, Mathias Unberath

entry.summary: SAW proposes a surgical action world model using video diffusion conditioned on lightweight signals (laparoscopic tool type, trajectory, direction, speed) to generate realistic surgical videos without expensive annotations.

entry.title: Interrogating Design Homogenization in Web Vibe Coding

author.name: Donghoon Shin, Alice Gao, Rock Yuren Pang, Jaewook Lee, Katharina Reinecke, Emily Tseng

entry.summary: Interrogates design homogenization risks in 'vibe coding' (using LLMs to generate websites), characterizing the vibe coding lifecycle and conducting sociotechnical risk analysis of how LLMs may narrow web design diversity.

entry.title: Mitigating Memorization in Text-to-Image Diffusion via Region-Aware Prompt Augmentation and Multimodal Copy Detection

author.name: Yunzhuo Chen, Jordan Vice, Naveed Akhtar, Nur Al Hasan Haldar, Ajmal Mian

entry.summary: Introduces RAPTA and ADMCD to mitigate training data memorization in text-to-image diffusion models using region-aware prompt augmentation and attention-driven copy detection, addressing copyright and privacy risks.

entry.title: InterEdit: Navigating Text-Guided Multi-Human 3D Motion Editing

author.name: Yebin Yang, Di Wen, Lei Qi, Weitong Kong, Junwei Zheng, Ruiping Liu, Yufan Chen, Chengzhi Wu, Kailun Yang, Yuqian Fu, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool, Kunyu Peng

entry.summary: InterEdit introduces multi-person 3D motion editing from text instructions, proposing a new dataset (InterEdit3D) with two-person motion annotations and a synchronized diffusion model that captures inter-person interaction cues.

entry.title: ZO-SAM: Zero-Order Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Efficient Sparse Training

author.name: Jie Ji, Gen Li, Kaiyuan Deng, Fatemeh Afghah, Xiaolong Ma

entry.summary: ZO-SAM integrates zero-order optimization within sharpness-aware minimization for sparse neural network training, requiring only one backpropagation step while improving convergence at high sparsity levels.

entry.title: Neuron-Aware Data Selection In Instruction Tuning For Large Language Models

author.name: Xin Chen, Junchao Wu, Shu Yang, Runzhe Zhan, Zeyu Wu, Min Yang, Shujian Huang, Lidia S. Chao, Derek F. Wong

entry.summary: NAIT is a framework for instruction tuning data selection that evaluates data impact by analyzing neuron activation pattern similarity between instruction tuning data and target domain capabilities. It provides a principled way to select efficient subsets of training data for developing specific or general abilities in LLMs.

entry.title: VQQA: An Agentic Approach for Video Evaluation and Quality Improvement

author.name: Yiwen Song, Tomas Pfister, Yale Song

entry.summary: Introduces VQQA, a multi-agent framework for video generation quality evaluation and improvement that uses VLM critiques as 'semantic gradients' for closed-loop prompt optimization through a black-box natural language interface.

entry.title: Maximum Entropy Exploration Without the Rollouts

author.name: Jacob Adamczyk and Adam Kamoski and Rahul V. Kulkarni

entry.summary: Proposes a maximum entropy exploration approach that avoids on-policy rollouts by using an intrinsic average-reward formulation where the reward derives from the visitation distribution itself, enabling steady-state entropy maximization without explicit frequency estimation.

entry.title: NeuroLoRA: Context-Aware Neuromodulation for Parameter-Efficient Multi-Task Adaptation

author.name: Yuxin Yang, Haoran Zhang, Mingxuan Li, Jiachen Xu, Ruoxi Shen, Zhenyu Wang, Tianhao Liu, Siqi Chen, Weilin Huang

entry.summary: Proposes NeuroLoRA, a Mixture-of-Experts LoRA framework inspired by biological neuromodulation that adds a lightweight context-dependent gating mechanism to frozen random projections, improving multi-task adaptation over static routing methods like FlyLoRA.

entry.title: Literary Narrative as Moral Probe : A Cross-System Framework for Evaluating AI Ethical Reasoning and Refusal Behavior

author.name: David C. Flynn

entry.summary: Proposes using literary narratives (specifically unresolvable moral scenarios from science fiction) as probes for evaluating AI ethical reasoning across 13 systems and 24 conditions, finding zero delta between blind and declared conditions.

entry.title: SLICE: Semantic Latent Injection via Compartmentalized Embedding for Image Watermarking

author.name: Zheng Gao, Yifan Yang, Xiaoyu Li, Xiaoyan Feng, Haoran Fan, Yang Song, Jiaojiao Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes SLICE, a semantic-aware watermarking framework for diffusion models that decouples image semantics into four compartmentalized factors, providing robustness against localized semantic edits that defeat single global semantic binding approaches.

entry.title: OARS: Process-Aware Online Alignment for Generative Real-World Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Shijie Zhao, Xuanyu Zhang, Bin Chen, Weiqi Li, Qunliang Xing, Kexin Zhang, Yan Wang, Junlin Li, Li Zhang, Jian Zhang, and Tianfan Xue

entry.summary: Proposes OARS, a process-aware online alignment framework for image super-resolution that uses COMPASS, an MLLM-based reward model evaluating LR-to-SR transitions with adaptive fidelity-perception tradeoff.

entry.title: From AI Weather Prediction to Infrastructure Resilience: A Correction-Downscaling Framework for Tropical Cyclone Impacts

author.name: You Wu, Zhenguo Wang, Naiyu Wang

entry.summary: Introduces ACDF, a framework transforming coarse AI weather predictions into 500m wind fields and infrastructure failure probabilities for tropical cyclones, reducing wind-speed MAE by 38.8% vs Pangu-Weather.

entry.title: Efficient and Interpretable Multi-Agent LLM Routing via Ant Colony Optimization

author.name: Xudong Wang, Chaoning Zhang, Jiaquan Zhang, Chenghao Li, Qigan Sun, Sung-Ho Bae, Peng Wang, Ning Xie, Jie Zou, Yang Yang, Hengtao Shen

entry.summary: AMRO-S applies ant colony optimization for routing queries to heterogeneous LLM agents, modeling the problem as a combinatorial optimization over a pheromone-weighted bipartite graph. Aims for efficient, interpretable routing under dynamic loads.

entry.title: A New Kernel Regularity Condition for Distributed Mirror Descent: Broader Coverage and Simpler Analysis

author.name: Junwen Qiu, Ziyang Zeng, Leilei Mei, Junyu Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Hessian Relative Uniform Continuity (HRUC), a new kernel regularity condition for distributed mirror descent that is satisfied by nearly all practical kernels, closing a theory-practice gap where existing conditions were violated by standard kernels.

entry.title: Mastering Negation: Boosting Grounding Models via Grouped Opposition-Based Learning

author.name: Zesheng Yang, Xi Jiang, Bingzhang Hu, Weili Guan, Runmin Cong, Guo-Jun Qi, and Feng Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces D-Negation dataset and a grouped opposition-based learning framework to help vision-language grounding models handle negative semantics, addressing a significant blind spot in current models.

entry.title: Sobolev--Ricci Curvature

author.name: Kyoichi Iwasaki, Tam Le, Hideitsu Hino

entry.summary: Proposes Sobolev-Ricci Curvature (SRC), a graph Ricci curvature induced by Sobolev transport geometry, with efficient tree-metric evaluation. Shows SRC recovers Ollivier-Ricci curvature on trees and demonstrates applications in graph rewiring.

entry.title: Semantic Invariance in Agentic AI

author.name: I. de Zarz\`a and J. de Curt\`o and Jordi Cabot and Pietro Manzoni and Carlos T. Calafate

entry.summary: This paper introduces a metamorphic testing framework for assessing semantic invariance in LLM reasoning agents—whether they produce consistent outputs under semantically equivalent input variations like paraphrasing, fact reordering, or style changes. Eight semantic-preserving transformations are applied to systematically probe reasoning robustness.

entry.title: Bayesian Conservative Policy Optimization (BCPO): A Novel Uncertainty-Calibrated Offline Reinforcement Learning with Credible Lower Bounds

author.name: Debashis Chatterjee

entry.summary: Proposes Bayesian Conservative Policy Optimization (BCPO), a framework for offline RL that uses hierarchical Bayesian posteriors to construct credible lower bounds on action values, addressing overestimation under distribution shift. The method combines epistemic uncertainty quantification with KL-regularized policy updates for provably conservative improvement.

entry.title: Detecting Miscitation on the Scholarly Web through LLM-Augmented Text-Rich Graph Learning

author.name: Huidong Wu, Haojia Xiang, Jingtong Gao, Xiangyu Zhao, Dengsheng Wu, Jianping Li

entry.summary: Introduces LAGMiD for detecting miscitations in scholarly networks by combining LLM semantic reasoning with graph learning on citation networks, addressing the problem of references that don't support the claims they're cited for.

entry.title: Human Knowledge Integrated Multi-modal Learning for Single Source Domain Generalization

author.name: Ayan Banerjee, Kuntal Thakur, Sandeep Gupta

entry.summary: Proposes domain conformal bounds (DCB) for evaluating cross-domain divergence, and GenEval, a multimodal VLM approach combining MedGemma-4B with human knowledge for single source domain generalization in medical imaging tasks like diabetic retinopathy grading.

entry.title: Generating Expressive and Customizable Evals for Timeseries Data Analysis Agents with AgentFuel

author.name: Aadyaa Maddi, Prakhar Naval, Deepti Mande, Shane Duan, Muckai Girish, Vyas Sekar

entry.summary: AgentFuel is a framework for generating expressive evaluations of conversational data analysis agents operating on timeseries data. Finds that 6 popular agents fail on stateful and incident-specific queries, exposing gaps in existing evaluation suites.

entry.title: Scaling Laws and Pathologies of Single-Layer PINNs: Network Width and PDE Nonlinearity

author.name: Faris Chaudhry

entry.summary: Identifies dual pathologies in single-layer PINNs: a baseline pathology where error doesn't decrease with width, and a compounding pathology where nonlinearity exacerbates this. Shows optimization rather than approximation capacity is the bottleneck.

entry.title: AccelAes: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers for Training-Free Aesthetic-Enhanced Image Generation

author.name: Xuanhua Yin, Chuanzhi Xu, Haoxian Zhou, Boyu Wei, Weidong Cai

entry.summary: AccelAes accelerates Diffusion Transformers by exploiting the observation that denoising is spatially non-uniform with respect to aesthetic prompt tokens. Creates aesthetic focus masks for spatio-temporal token reduction.

entry.title: Maximizing Incremental Information Entropy for Contrastive Learning

author.name: Jiansong Zhang, Zhuoqin Yang, Xu Wu, Xiaoling Luo, Peizhong Liu, Linlin Shen

entry.summary: Proposes IE-CL, a contrastive learning framework that explicitly optimizes entropy gain between augmented views while preserving semantic consistency, reframing the encoder as an information bottleneck.

entry.title: TacVLA: Contact-Aware Tactile Fusion for Robust Vision-Language-Action Manipulation

author.name: Kaidi Zhang, Heng Zhang, Zhengtong Xu, Zhiyuan Zhang, Md Rakibul Islam Prince, Xiang Li, Xiaojing Han, Yuhao Zhou, Arash Ajoudani, Yu She

entry.summary: Proposes TacVLA, integrating tactile modalities into Vision-Language-Action models with a contact-aware gating mechanism that selectively activates tactile tokens only during contact events.

entry.title: RXNRECer Enables Fine-grained Enzymatic Function Annotation through Active Learning and Protein Language Models

author.name: Zhenkun Shi, Jun Zhu, Dehang Wang, BoYu Chen, Qianqian Yuan, Zhitao Mao, Fan Wei, Weining Wu, Xiaoping Liao, Hongwu Ma

entry.summary: Introduces RXNRECer, a transformer-based framework that directly predicts enzyme-catalyzed reactions without EC numbers as intermediaries, using protein language models and active learning.

entry.title: Graph In-Context Operator Networks for Generalizable Spatiotemporal Prediction

author.name: Chenghan Wu, Zongmin Yu, Boai Sun, Liu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes GICON, a Graph In-Context Operator Network that combines graph message passing with example-aware positional encoding for spatiotemporal prediction. It provides the first controlled comparison between in-context operator learning and classical single-operator learning under identical training conditions.

entry.title: Taming the Long Tail: Efficient Item-wise Sharpness-Aware Minimization for LLM-based Recommender Systems

author.name: Jiaming Zhang, Yuyuan Li, Xiaohua Feng, Li Zhang, Longfei Li, Jun Zhou, Chaochao Chen

entry.summary: Studies the long-tail problem in LLM-based recommender systems, identifying two distinct types (prior long-tail from pretraining and data long-tail from recommendation datasets), and proposes an efficient item-wise sharpness-aware minimization approach.

entry.title: Catalyst4D: High-Fidelity 3D-to-4D Scene Editing via Dynamic Propagation

author.name: Shifeng Chen, Yihui Li, Jun Liao, Hongyu Yang, Di Huang

entry.summary: Introduces Catalyst4D, a framework for transferring high-quality 3D edits to dynamic 4D Gaussian scenes using Anchor-based Motion Guidance with optimal transport for consistent deformation propagation.

entry.title: PVI: Plug-in Visual Injection for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zezhou Zhang, Songxin Zhang, Xiao Xiong, Junjie Zhang, Zejian Xie, Jingyi Xi, Zunyao Mao, Zan Mao, Zhixin Mai, Zhuoyang Song, Jiaxing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Plug-in Visual Injection (PVI), a lightweight encoder-agnostic module that injects auxiliary visual representations including temporal cues into VLA action experts for robotic manipulation.

entry.title: GLEAM: A Multimodal Imaging Dataset and HAMM for Glaucoma Classification

author.name: Jiao Wang, Chi Liu, Yiying Zhang, Hongchen Luo, Zhifen Guo, Ying Hu, Ke Xu, Jing Zhou, Hongyan Xu, Ruiting Zhou, Man Tang

entry.summary: Proposes GLEAM, the first publicly available tri-modal glaucoma dataset (fundus images, OCT, visual field maps) with four disease stages, and HAMM, a hierarchical attentive masked modeling framework for multimodal glaucoma classification.

entry.title: coDrawAgents: A Multi-Agent Dialogue Framework for Compositional Image Generation

author.name: Chunhan Li, Qifeng Wu, Jia-Hui Pan, Ka-Hei Hui, Jingyu Hu, Yuming Jiang, Bin Sheng, Xihui Liu, Wenjuan Gong, Zhengzhe Liu

entry.summary: Proposes coDrawAgents, a multi-agent dialogue framework for compositional image generation with four specialized agents (Interpreter, Planner, Checker, Painter) collaborating through layout-aware multi-agent processing.

entry.title: A protocol for evaluating robustness to H&E staining variation in computational pathology models

author.name: Lydia A. Sch\"onpflug, Nikki van den Berg, Sonali Andani, Nanda Horeweg, Jurriaan Barkey Wolf, Tjalling Bosse, Viktor H. Koelzer, Maxime W. Lafarge

entry.summary: Develops a three-step protocol for evaluating computational pathology models' robustness to H&E staining variation, tested on 306 microsatellite instability classification models.

entry.title: GoalSwarm: Multi-UAV Semantic Coordination for Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation

author.name: MoniJesu Wonders James, Amir Atef Habel, Aleksey Fedoseev, and Dzmitry Tsetserokou

entry.summary: Presents GoalSwarm, a decentralized multi-UAV framework for zero-shot semantic object-goal navigation using shared lightweight 2D semantic occupancy maps projected from aerial depth observations.

entry.title: Surprised by Attention: Predictable Query Dynamics for Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Kadir-Kaan \"Ozer, Ren\'e Ebeling, Markus Enzweiler

entry.summary: AxonAD is an unsupervised time series anomaly detector that monitors multi-head attention query evolution rather than raw signal reconstruction, catching cross-channel dependency shifts. It uses a gradient-updated reconstruction pathway coupled with a history-only predictor, showing particular relevance for autonomous driving where coordination anomalies matter.

entry.title: Language-Grounded Decoupled Action Representation for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Wuding Weng, Tongshu Wu, Liucheng Chen, Siyu Xie, Zheng Wang, Xing Xu, Jingkuan Song, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: LaDA framework uses natural language as a semantic bridge between high-level vision-language understanding and low-level robot control, introducing three interpretable action primitives (translation, rotation, gripper) with contrastive learning for alignment.

entry.title: Accelerating Stroke MRI with Diffusion Probabilistic Models through Large-Scale Pre-training and Target-Specific Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yamin Arefeen and Sidharth Kumar and Steven Warach and Hamidreza Saber and Jonathan Tamir

entry.summary: Develops a pre-train-then-fine-tune strategy for diffusion probabilistic models applied to accelerated stroke MRI reconstruction, achieving strong results with limited fully-sampled data by pre-training on diverse brain MRI and fine-tuning on target FLAIR data.

entry.title: SldprtNet: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset for CAD Generation in Language-Driven 3D Design

author.name: Ruogu Li, Sikai Li, Yao Mu and Mingyu Ding

entry.summary: SldprtNet is a large-scale dataset of 242k industrial CAD parts with encoder/decoder tools supporting 13 CAD commands, enabling semantic-driven CAD modeling and multimodal model training for 3D design.

entry.title: Panoramic Multimodal Semantic Occupancy Prediction for Quadruped Robots

author.name: Guoqiang Zhao, Zhe Yang, Sheng Wu, Fei Teng, Mengfei Duan, Yuanfan Zheng, Kai Luo, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: PanoMMOcc introduces the first panoramic multimodal occupancy dataset for quadruped robots with VoxelHound framework that handles vertical jitter compensation and spherical imaging specific to legged mobility.

entry.title: Geometry-Guided Camera Motion Understanding in VideoLLMs

author.name: Haoan Feng, Sri Harsha Musunuri, Guan-Ming Su

entry.summary: Addresses the gap in VideoLLMs' understanding of camera motion through a benchmark (CameraMotionVQA), diagnosis of representation weaknesses, and geometry-guided injection into video encoders.

entry.title: DiT-IC: Aligned Diffusion Transformer for Efficient Image Compression

author.name: Junqi Shi, Ming Lu, Xingchen Li, Anle Ke, Ruiqi Zhang, Zhan Ma

entry.summary: DiT-IC replaces the U-Net architecture in diffusion-based image compression with a Diffusion Transformer that operates in much more compact latent spaces (16x-64x downscaling vs 8x). This addresses the prohibitive sampling overhead and memory usage that has limited practical deployment of diffusion compression.

entry.title: Was Anthropic that strategically incompetent?

author.name: StanislavKrym

entry.summary: Retrospective analysis of Anthropic's strategic approach to AI safety, examining whether their 'race then slow down' strategy was competent. Discusses Anthropic's worldview around superalignment, misuse risks, and empiricism-first research approach, with critical evaluation of their execution.

entry.title: How post-training shapes legal representations: probing SCOTUS opinions across model families

author.name: burnssa

entry.summary: Investigates how post-training shapes legal concept representations in LLMs by probing activations of base vs instruction-tuned models on US Supreme Court opinions. Created a new dataset using Claude Opus 4.5 to annotate landmark SCOTUS opinions with legal principles.

entry.title: Batched Kernelized Bandits: Refinements and Extensions

author.name: Chenkai Ma, Keqin Chen, Jonathan Scarlett

entry.summary: Refines regret bounds for batched kernelized bandits in RKHS settings, finding optimal batch counts including constant factors and removing a factor of B in the regret bound. Also extends lower bounds to handle unequal batch sizes.

entry.title: HyDA: Hypernetworks for Test Time Domain Adaptation in Medical Imaging Analysis

author.name: Doron Serebro and Tammy Riklin-Raviv

entry.summary: Proposes HyDA, a hypernetwork-based approach for test-time domain adaptation in medical imaging that generates model parameters adapted to new domains in real-time without requiring target domain data during training.

entry.title: Synthetic Data Generation for Brain-Computer Interfaces: Overview, Benchmarking, and Future Directions

author.name: Ziwei Wang, Zhentao He, Xingyi He, Hongbin Wang, Tianwang Jia, Jingwei Luo, Siyang Li, Xiaoqing Chen, and Dongrui Wu

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of synthetic brain signal generation for BCIs, covering methodological taxonomies, benchmarks, evaluation metrics, and applications across knowledge-based, feature-based, model-based, and translation-based approaches.

entry.title: Alternating Gradient Flow Utility: A Unified Metric for Structural Pruning and Dynamic Routing in Deep Networks

author.name: Tianhao Qian, Zhuoxuan Li, Jinde Cao, Xinli Shi, Hanjie Liu, Leszek Rutkowski

entry.summary: Proposes Alternating Gradient Flow (AGF) utility for structural pruning and dynamic routing in vision networks, using absolute feature-space Taylor expansion to capture functional importance rather than weight magnitude, discovering topological phase transitions at extreme sparsity.

entry.title: Bases of Steerable Kernels for Equivariant CNNs: From 2D Rotations to the Lorentz Group

author.name: Alan Garbarz

entry.summary: Presents an alternative method for computing steerable kernel bases for equivariant CNNs that bypasses Clebsch-Gordan coefficients, working directly with representations. Covers groups from 2D rotations to the Lorentz group.

entry.title: Modal Logical Neural Networks for Financial AI

author.name: Antonin Sulc

entry.summary: Proposes Modal Logical Neural Networks (MLNNs) that integrate Kripke semantics into neural architectures for financial AI, enabling differentiable reasoning about necessity, possibility, time, and knowledge for compliance and risk management.

entry.title: ELLA: Generative AI-Powered Social Robots for Early Language Development at Home

author.name: Victor Nikhil Antony, Shiye Cao, Shuning Wang, Chien-Ming Huang

entry.summary: ELLA is a generative AI-powered social robot for early language development in children, using LLMs for interactive storytelling and scaffolded dialogue. Evaluated through home deployments with pre-schoolers over multiple days.

entry.title: From Woofs to Words: Towards Intelligent Robotic Guide Dogs with Verbal Communication

author.name: Yohei Hayamizu, David DeFazio, Hrudayangam Mehta, Zainab Altaweel, Jacqueline Choe, Chao Lin, Jake Juettner, Furui Xiao, Jeremy Blackburn, and Shiqi Zhang

entry.summary: Develops a dialog system for robotic guide dogs that uses LLMs to verbalize navigational plans and scenes for visually impaired users, enabling collaborative decision-making between the handler and robot.

entry.title: A Spectral Revisit of the Distributional Bellman Operator under the Cram\'er Metric

author.name: Keru Wang, Yixin Deng, Yao Lyu, Stephen Redmond and Shengbo Eben Li

entry.summary: Provides spectral analysis of the distributional Bellman operator under the Cramér metric, revealing the structural action of Bellman updates on CDFs at the level of a functional linear operator with spectral decomposition.

entry.title: Multiscale Structure-Guided Latent Diffusion for Multimodal MRI Translation

author.name: Jianqiang Lin (1 and 2), Zhiqiang Shen (1 and 2), Peng Cao (1, 2 and 3), Jinzhu Yang (1, 2 and 3), Osmar R. Zaiane (4) and Xiaoli Liu (5) ((1) Northeastern University, Shenyang, China, (2) Key Laboratory of Intelligent Computing in Medical Image, Shenyang, China, (3) National Frontiers Science Center for Industrial Intelligence and Systems Optimization, Shenyang, China, (4) University of Alberta, Edmonton, Canada, (5) AiShiWeiLai AI Research, Beijing, China)

entry.summary: MSG-LDM proposes a latent diffusion framework for multi-modal MRI translation with style-structure disentanglement and multiscale structural guidance, handling arbitrary missing-modality scenarios.

entry.title: CA-HFP: Curvature-Aware Heterogeneous Federated Pruning with Model Reconstruction

author.name: Gang Hu, Yinglei Teng, Pengfei Wu, and Shijun Ma

entry.summary: Presents CA-HFP, a federated learning framework enabling device-specific structured pruning guided by curvature-informed significance scores, with theoretical convergence bounds accounting for pruning perturbations.

entry.title: The Economics of AI Supply Chain Regulation

author.name: Sihan Qian and Amit Mehra and Dengpan Liu

entry.summary: Develops a game-theoretic model analyzing how policy interventions affect consumer surplus in AI supply chains involving foundation model providers and downstream firms. Shows price competition in downstream markets benefits consumers.

entry.title: Adaptive Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Data and Model Fusion of Complex Nonlinear Dynamical Systems

author.name: Dibyajyoti Chakraborty, Hojin Kim and Romit Maulik

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive diffusion posterior sampling for surrogate modeling of chaotic dynamical systems, with multi-step autoregressive training for stability and adaptive correction using sparse observations.

entry.title: VFM-Recon: Unlocking Cross-Domain Scene-Level Neural Reconstruction with Scale-Aligned Foundation Priors

author.name: Yuhang Ming, Tingkang Xi, Xingrui Yang, Lixin Yang, Yong Peng, Cewu Lu, Wanzeng Kong

entry.summary: Presents VFM-Recon, the first method bridging vision foundation model priors with scale-consistent neural volumetric reconstruction, using a lightweight scale alignment stage to resolve VFM scale ambiguity.

entry.title: Disentangled Latent Dynamics Manifold Fusion for Solving Parameterized PDEs

author.name: Zhangyong Liang, Ji Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DLDMF for solving parameterized PDEs, disentangling latent dynamics to handle both parameter generalization and temporal extrapolation simultaneously, addressing limitations of existing neural surrogate models.

entry.title: UNIStainNet: Foundation-Model-Guided Virtual Staining of H&E to IHC

author.name: Jillur Rahman Saurav, Thuong Le Hoai Pham, Pritam Mukherjee, Paul Yi, Brent A. Orr and Jacob M. Luber

entry.summary: Presents UNIStainNet for virtual IHC staining from H&E images, conditioned on dense spatial tokens from a frozen pathology foundation model (UNI), with learned stain embeddings for multi-marker support.

entry.title: CognitionCapturerPro: Towards High-Fidelity Visual Decoding from EEG/MEG via Multi-modal Information and Asymmetric Alignment

author.name: Kaifan Zhang, Lihuo He, Junjie Ke, Yuqi Ji, Lukun Wu, Lizi Wang, Xinbo Gao

entry.summary: Proposes CognitionCapturerPro for visual reconstruction from EEG, integrating multi-modal priors (images, text, depth, edges) with uncertainty-weighted scoring and a fusion encoder, achieving 25.9% improvement in Top-1 retrieval.

entry.title: MoKus: Leveraging Cross-Modal Knowledge Transfer for Knowledge-Aware Concept Customization

author.name: Chenyang Zhu, Hongxiang Li, Xiu Li, Long Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Knowledge-aware Concept Customization, a new task binding textual knowledge to visual concepts, and proposes MoKus framework leveraging cross-modal knowledge transfer for high-fidelity customized image generation.

entry.title: SAVA-X: Ego-to-Exo Imitation Error Detection via Scene-Adaptive View Alignment and Bidirectional Cross View Fusion

author.name: Xiang Li, Heqian Qiu, Lanxiao Wang, Benliu Qiu, Fanman Meng, Linfeng Xu, Hongliang Li

entry.summary: Formalizes Ego-to-Exo Imitation Error Detection and proposes SAVA-X, an Align-Fuse-Detect framework for assessing first-person imitations against third-person demonstrations across asynchronous, mismatched videos.

entry.title: Think and Answer ME: Benchmarking and Exploring Multi-Entity Reasoning Grounding in Remote Sensing

author.name: Shuchang Lyu, Haiquan Wen, Guangliang Cheng, Meng Li, Zheng Zhou, You Zhou, Dingding Yao, Zhenwei Shi

entry.summary: Introduces ME-RSRG benchmark for multi-entity reasoning grounding in remote sensing and proposes an Entity-Aware Reasoning framework that generates structured reasoning chains for multi-entity localization.

entry.title: Mask2Flow-TSE: Two-Stage Target Speaker Extraction with Masking and Flow Matching

author.name: Junwon Moon, Hyunjin Choi, Hansol Park, Heeseung Kim, Kyuhong Shim

entry.summary: Proposes Mask2Flow-TSE, a two-stage target speaker extraction framework combining discriminative masking for coarse separation with flow matching refinement, reducing inference steps while maintaining speech quality.

entry.title: Enhanced Drug-drug Interaction Prediction Using Adaptive Knowledge Integration

author.name: Pengfei Liu, Jun Tao and Zhixiang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes a knowledge augmentation framework for drug-drug interaction prediction that uses reinforcement learning to adaptively infuse prior drug knowledge into an LLM for few-shot DDIE prediction.

entry.title: Spectral-Geometric Neural Fields for Pose-Free LiDAR View Synthesis

author.name: Yinuo Jiang, Jun Cheng, Yiran Wang, Cheng Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes SG-NLF, a pose-free LiDAR NeRF framework integrating spectral information with geometric consistency for novel view synthesis from LiDAR data without requiring accurate poses.

entry.title: Delta1 with LLM: symbolic and neural integration for credible and explainable reasoning

author.name: Yang Xu, Jun Liu, Shuwei Chen, Chris Nugent, and Hailing Guo

entry.summary: Integrates the Delta1 automated theorem generator with LLMs to create an end-to-end explainable reasoning pipeline where Delta1 handles formal logic and LLMs verbalize proofs into natural language explanations.

entry.title: SCOPE: Semantic Coreset with Orthogonal Projection Embeddings for Federated learning

author.name: Md Anwar Hossen, Nathan R. Tallent, Luanzheng Guo, Ali Jannesary

entry.summary: SCOPE is a federated learning coreset selection framework that uses orthogonal projection embeddings to filter anomalies and adaptively prune redundant data, addressing extreme class imbalance in scientific federated datasets.

entry.title: 3DTCR: A Physics-Based Generative Framework for Vortex-Following 3D Reconstruction to Improve Tropical Cyclone Intensity Forecasting

author.name: Jun Liu, Xiaohui Zhong, Kai Zheng, Jiarui Li, Yifei Li, Tao Zhou, Wenxu Qian, Shun Dai, Ruian Tie, Yangyang Zhao, Hao Li

entry.summary: 3DTCR uses a physics-based generative framework to reconstruct 3D tropical cyclone structures from 2D satellite observations, combining physical constraints with generative AI for weather forecasting applications.

entry.title: Breaking the Tuning Barrier: Zero-Hyperparameters Yield Multi-Corner Analysis Via Learned Priors

author.name: Wei W. Xing, Kaiqi Huang, Jiazhan Liu, Hong Qiu, Shan Shen

entry.summary: Proposes a zero-hyperparameter approach to yield multi-corner circuit analysis by replacing engineered priors with learned priors from a foundation model pre-trained on millions of regression tasks, using in-context learning.

entry.title: Evaluating VLMs' Spatial Reasoning Over Robot Motion: A Step Towards Robot Planning with Motion Preferences

author.name: Wenxi Wu, Jingjing Zhang, Martim Brand\~ao

entry.summary: Evaluates four state-of-the-art VLMs on spatial reasoning about robot motion, testing distance preferences, topological properties, and motion style preferences. Finds significant gaps in spatial reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: Towards Faithful Multimodal Concept Bottleneck Models

author.name: Pierre Moreau, Emeline Pineau Ferrand, Yann Choho, Benjamin Wong, Annabelle Blangero, Milan Bhan

entry.summary: f-CBM introduces a faithful multimodal Concept Bottleneck Model framework built on vision-language models that jointly addresses concept detection accuracy and information leakage in interpretable predictions. It tackles the problem that existing CBMs often smuggle extraneous information through concept representations, undermining faithfulness of explanations.

entry.title: PhysMoDPO: Physically-Plausible Humanoid Motion with Preference Optimization

author.name: Yangsong Zhang, Anujith Muraleedharan, Rikhat Akizhanov, Abdul Ahad Butt, G\"ul Varol, Pascal Fua, Fabio Pizzati, Ivan Laptev

entry.summary: PhysMoDPO applies Direct Preference Optimization to text-conditioned human motion generation, integrating a Whole-Body Controller into the training pipeline so diffusion models learn to produce motions that remain faithful after physics simulation. This addresses deviations introduced when converting generated motions to physically executable trajectories.

entry.title: From Garbage to Gold: A Data-Architectural Theory of Predictive Robustness

author.name: Terrence J. Lee-St. John, Jordan L. Lawson, Bartlomiej Piechowski-Jozwiak

entry.summary: Presents a theoretical framework explaining why high-dimensional, noisy tabular data can still yield robust predictions by distinguishing 'Predictor Error' from 'Structural Uncertainty.' Shows that leveraging many error-prone predictors asymptotically overcomes noise better than cleaning a small set of features.

entry.title: Rethinking the Backbone in Class Imbalanced Federated Source Free Domain Adaptation: The Utility of Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Kosuke Kihara, Junki Mori, Taiki Miyagawa, Akinori F. Ebihara

entry.summary: Extends federated source-free domain adaptation to handle class imbalances in both source and target domains, and proposes using vision foundation models as feature backbones instead of focusing on aggregation methods, finding this simple change yields significant improvements.

entry.title: DART: Input-Difficulty-AwaRe Adaptive Threshold for Early-Exit DNNs

author.name: Parth Patne, Mahdi Taheri, Christian Herglotz, Maksim Jenihhin, Milos Krstic, and Michael H\"ubner

entry.summary: Introduces DART, an adaptive early-exit framework for DNNs that estimates input difficulty to set per-sample exit thresholds, jointly optimizing exit policies across layers using dynamic programming.

entry.title: Beyond Motion Imitation: Is Human Motion Data Alone Sufficient to Explain Gait Control and Biomechanics?

author.name: Xinyi Liu, Jangwhan Ahn, Edgar Lobaton, Jennie Si, He Huang

entry.summary: Investigates whether motion data alone is sufficient for learning human gait through imitation learning, finding that kinematics-only approaches fail to produce biomechanically plausible joint kinetics. Adding foot-ground contact forces to the reward function significantly improves physical consistency.

entry.title: Adaptation of Weakly Supervised Localization in Histopathology by Debiasing Predictions

author.name: Alexis Guichemerre, Banafsheh Karimian, Soufiane Belharbi, Natacha Gillet, Nicolas Thome, Pourya Shamsolmoali, Mohammadhadi Shateri, Luke McCaffrey, Eric Granger

entry.summary: Addresses domain adaptation for weakly supervised object localization in histopathology, tackling the problem of prediction bias toward dominant classes that gets reinforced during self-training in source-free domain adaptation.

entry.title: COAD: Constant-Time Planning for Continuous Goal Manipulation with Compressed Library and Online Adaptation

author.name: Adil Shiyas, Zhuoyun Zhong, and Constantinos Chamzas

entry.summary: COAD provides constant-time motion planning for continuous goal-parameterized manipulation tasks by discretizing the task space, constructing a compressed solution library, and adapting solutions online via trajectory optimization.

entry.title: Byzantine-Robust Optimization under $(L_0, L_1)$-Smoothness

author.name: Arman Bolatov, Samuel Horv\'ath, Martin Tak\'a\v{c}, Eduard Gorbunov

entry.summary: Proposes Byz-NSGDM, a normalized SGD method with momentum for Byzantine-robust distributed optimization under (L0,L1)-smoothness. Achieves O(K^{-1/4}) convergence rate with robustness against Byzantine workers.

entry.title: Addressing Data Scarcity in 3D Trauma Detection through Self-Supervised and Semi-Supervised Learning with Vertex Relative Position Encoding

author.name: Shivam Chaudhary, Sheethal Bhat, Andreas Maier

entry.summary: Combines self-supervised pre-training (masked image modeling) with semi-supervised detection for 3D trauma detection in CT scans, addressing the severe data scarcity in medical imaging with a label-efficient approach.

entry.title: A Reduction Algorithm for Markovian Contextual Linear Bandits

author.name: Kaan Buyukkalayci, Osama Hanna, Christina Fragouli

entry.summary: Extends the 'contexts are cheap' reduction from i.i.d. to Markovian contextual linear bandits, constructing a stationary surrogate action set and delayed-update scheme to handle temporal correlations in action availability.

entry.title: Decoding Matters: Efficient Mamba-Based Decoder with Distribution-Aware Deep Supervision for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Fares Bougourzi, Fadi Dornaika, Abdenour Hadid

entry.summary: Proposes Deco-Mamba, a decoder-centric approach for medical image segmentation combining CNN-Transformer encoders with novel Mamba-based decoders featuring Co-Attention Gates and Vision Mamba Fusion blocks.

entry.title: Feynman: Knowledge-Infused Diagramming Agent for Scalable Visual Designs

author.name: Zixin Wen, Yifu Cai, Kyle Lee, Sam Estep, Josh Sunshine, Aarti Singh, Yuejie Chi, Wode Ni

entry.summary: Presents Feynman, a diagram generation agent that enumerates domain-specific knowledge components, plans code, and renders via the Penrose diagramming system. Creates a scalable pipeline for generating knowledge-rich diagram-text pairs.

entry.title: Autonomous Integration and Improvement of Robotic Assembly using Skill Graph Representations

author.name: Peiqi Yu, Philip Huang, Chaitanya Chawla, Guanya Shi, Jiaoyang Li, and Changliu Liu

entry.summary: Presents a Skill Graph framework for autonomous integration and improvement of robotic assembly systems, linking semantic descriptions with executable policies, pre/post-conditions, and evaluators.

entry.title: HaltNav: Reactive Visual Halting over Lightweight Topological Priors for Robust Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Pingcong Li, Zihui Yu, Bichi Zhang and S\"oren Schwertfeger

entry.summary: Proposes HaltNav, a hierarchical VLN framework combining lightweight topological priors (osmAG) with reactive visual halting for robust navigation when local connectivity changes.

entry.title: Conflict Mitigation in Shared Environments using Flow-Aware Multi-Agent Path Finding

author.name: Lukas Heuer, Yufei Zhu, Luigi Palmieri, Andrey Rudenko, Anna Mannucci, Sven Koenig and Martin Magnusson

entry.summary: Introduces Flow-Aware Multi-Agent Path Finding (FA-MAPF), integrating learned motion patterns of uncontrollable dynamic agents into centralized MAPF algorithms for multi-robot systems in shared environments.

entry.title: A Method for Learning Large-Scale Computational Construction Grammars from Semantically Annotated Corpora

author.name: Paul Van Eecke and Katrien Beuls

entry.summary: Presents a method for learning large-scale computational construction grammars from semantically annotated corpora, producing networks of tens of thousands of constructions within the Fluid Construction Grammar framework.

entry.title: Easy-IIL: Reducing Human Operational Burden in Interactive Imitation Learning via Assistant Experts

author.name: Chengjie Zhang, Chao Tang, Wenlong Dong, Dehao Huang, Aoxiang Gu, and Hong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Easy-IIL, a framework reducing human operational burden in interactive imitation learning by using model-based imitation methods as assistant experts, requiring only a single human demonstration.

entry.title: Spectral Defense Against Resource-Targeting Attack in 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Yang Chen, Yi Yu, Jiaming He, Yueqi Duan, Zheng Zhu, Yap-Peng Tan

entry.summary: Proposes a spectral defense against resource-targeting attacks in 3D Gaussian Splatting, where poisoned training images induce excessive Gaussian growth. Uses spectral analysis to detect and mitigate high-frequency perturbations.

entry.title: DAST: A Dual-Stream Voice Anonymization Attacker with Staged Training

author.name: Ridwan Arefeen, Xiaoxiao Miao, Rong Tong, Aik Beng Ng, Simon See, Timothy Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DAST, a dual-stream attacker for evaluating voice anonymization systems, using spectral and self-supervised features with a three-stage training strategy including cross-system robustness from voice conversion exposure.

entry.title: SmoothTurn: Learning to Turn Smoothly for Agile Navigation with Quadrupedal Robots

author.name: Zunzhi You, Haolan Guo, Yunke Wang, Chang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes SmoothTurn for quadrupedal robot agile navigation, formulating sequential local navigation to enable smooth direction changes at high speed through anticipatory planning across goal sequences.

entry.title: Surrogates for Physics-based and Data-driven Modelling of Parametric Systems: Review and New Perspectives

author.name: Matteo Giacomini and Pedro D\'iez

entry.summary: Comprehensive review of surrogate models for parametric systems, covering physics-based, data-driven, and hybrid approaches, with connections to optimization, digital twins, and uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: TRACE: Structure-Aware Character Encoding for Robust and Generalizable Document Watermarking

author.name: Jiale Meng, Jie Zhang, Runyi Hu, Zhe-Ming Lu, Tianwei Zhang, Yiming Li

entry.summary: Proposes TRACE, a structure-aware document watermarking framework using diffusion models for localized character encoding, exploiting character structural stability for noise-resistant data embedding.

entry.title: Coordinated Manipulation of Hybrid Deformable-Rigid Objects in Constrained Environments

author.name: Anees Peringal, Anup Teejo Mathew, Panagiotis liatsis, Federico Renda

entry.summary: Presents a quasi-static optimization planner for manipulating hybrid deformable-rigid objects (like cables with rigid connectors) in constrained environments, using a Cosserat rod model with analytically derived gradients for 33x speedup over finite-difference baselines.

entry.title: Efficient Real-World Autonomous Racing via Attenuated Residual Policy Optimization

author.name: Raphael Trumpp, Denis Hoornaert, Mirco Theile, and Marco Caccamo

entry.summary: Introduces α-RPO for autonomous racing, extending residual policy learning by progressively attenuating the base policy during training to produce a standalone neural policy, reducing deployment complexity and inference latency.

entry.title: Fair Lung Disease Diagnosis from Chest CT via Gender-Adversarial Attention Multiple Instance Learning

author.name: Aditya Parikh and Aasa Feragen

entry.summary: Presents a fairness-aware framework for lung disease diagnosis from chest CT using attention-based MIL with gender-adversarial training, developed for CVPR 2026's Fair Disease Diagnosis Challenge.

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop LLM Grading for Handwritten Mathematics Assessments

author.name: Arne Vanhoyweghen, Vincent Holst, Melika Mobini, Lukas Van de Voorde, Tibo Vanleke, Bert Verbruggen, Brecht Verbeken, Andres Algaba, Sam Verboven, Marie-Anne Guerry, Filip Van Droogenbroeck, Vincent Ginis

entry.summary: Presents a scalable human-in-the-loop workflow for LLM-assisted grading of handwritten math assessments, combining automated scanning, multi-pass LLM scoring, consistency checks, and human verification across two undergraduate courses.

entry.title: Steve-Evolving: Open-World Embodied Self-Evolution via Fine-Grained Diagnosis and Dual-Track Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Zhengwei Xie, Zhisheng Chen, Ziyan Weng, Tingyu Wu, Chenglong Li, Vireo Zhang, Kun Wang

entry.summary: Steve-Evolving introduces a non-parametric self-evolving framework for open-world embodied agents that uses fine-grained execution diagnosis and dual-track knowledge distillation to organize and evolve interaction experience. The system structures experience into tuples and organizes them in a three-tier experience space, enabling closed-loop self-improvement for long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: From Experiments to Expertise: Scientific Knowledge Consolidation for AI-Driven Computational Research

author.name: Haonan Huang

entry.summary: Presents QMatSuite, an open-source platform that enables AI agents in computational materials science to accumulate and reuse knowledge across simulation runs, rather than treating each execution in isolation. Agents record findings with provenance, retrieve prior knowledge, and synthesize observations.

entry.title: EB-RANSAC: Random Sample Consensus based on Energy-Based Model

author.name: Muneki Yasuda and Nao Watanabe and Kaiji Sekimoto

entry.summary: Proposes EB-RANSAC, replacing the sampling procedure in classical RANSAC with an energy-based model formulation for robust estimation. The method eliminates the need for repeated sampling and reduces hyperparameters to just one.

entry.title: VL-KGE: Vision-Language Models Meet Knowledge Graph Embeddings

author.name: Athanasios Efthymiou, Stevan Rudinac, Monika Kackovic, Nachoem Wijnberg, Marcel Worring

entry.summary: Proposes VL-KGE, integrating vision-language models with knowledge graph embeddings for multimodal knowledge graphs. Addresses weak cross-modal alignment and non-uniform modality availability in existing KGE methods.

entry.title: VLM4Rec: Multimodal Semantic Representation for Recommendation with Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Ty Valencia, Burak Barlas, Varun Singhal, Ruchir Bhatia, Wei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes VLM4Rec, which uses large vision-language models to create semantically aligned multimodal item representations for recommendation, focusing on semantic factors like style and material rather than raw visual similarity.

entry.title: FGTR: Fine-Grained Multi-Table Retrieval via Hierarchical LLM Reasoning

author.name: Chaojie Sun, Bin Cao, Tiantian Li, Chenyu Hou, Ruizhe Li, Qing Fan

entry.summary: Proposes FGTR, a hierarchical LLM-based multi-table retrieval method that uses fine-grained reasoning over table structures rather than coarse-grained encoding of entire tables.

entry.title: Residual SODAP: Residual Self-Organizing Domain-Adaptive Prompting with Structural Knowledge Preservation for Continual Learning

author.name: Gyutae Oh, Jungwoo Bae, Jitae Shin
