entry.title: Rethinking Adam for Time Series Forecasting: A Simple Heuristic to Improve Optimization under Distribution Shifts

author.name: Yuze Dong, Jinsong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes TS_Adam, a simple Adam variant that removes second-order bias correction for time series forecasting, arguing this improves adaptability to distributional drift in non-stationary settings.

entry.title: Estimating condition number with Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Erin Carson, Xinye Chen

entry.summary: Proposes using graph neural networks for fast estimation of sparse matrix condition numbers, achieving significant speedup over traditional Hager-Higham and Lanczos methods with O(nnz + n) feature engineering.

entry.title: GSVD for Geometry-Grounded Dataset Comparison: An Alignment Angle Is All You Need

author.name: Eduarda de Souza Marques, Arthur Sobrinho Ferreira da Rocha, Joao Paixao, Heudson Mirandola, Daniel Sadoc Menasche

entry.summary: Proposes GSVD-based alignment angles for geometry-grounded dataset comparison, using generalized singular value decomposition to separate shared vs. dataset-specific directions.

entry.title: World Model for Battery Degradation Prediction Under Non-Stationary Aging

author.name: Kai Chin Lim, Khay Wai See

entry.title: Riemannian Geometry-Preserving Variational Autoencoder for MI-BCI Data Augmentation

author.name: Viktorija Po\c{l}aka, Ivo Pascal de Jong, Andreea Ioana Sburlea

entry.title: Evaluating randomized smoothing as a defense against adversarial attacks in trajectory prediction

author.name: Julian F. Schumann, Eduardo Figueiredo, Frederik Baymler Mathiesen, Luca Laurenti, Jens Kober, Arkady Zgonnikov

entry.summary: Evaluates randomized smoothing as a defense against adversarial attacks in trajectory prediction for autonomous driving, showing consistent robustness improvements.

entry.title: Cross-Species Transfer Learning for Electrophysiology-to-Transcriptomics Mapping in Cortical GABAergic Interneurons

author.name: Theo Schwider, Ramin Ramezani

entry.summary: Demonstrates cross-species transfer learning for mapping electrophysiology to transcriptomics in cortical GABAergic interneurons, analyzing mouse and human Patch-seq datasets.

entry.title: Unbalanced Optimal Transport Dictionary Learning for Unsupervised Hyperspectral Image Clustering

author.name: Joshua Lentz, Nicholas Karris, Alex Cloninger, James M. Murphy

entry.summary: Proposes using unbalanced optimal transport for dictionary learning in hyperspectral image clustering, avoiding the information loss from balancing spectral profiles.

entry.title: A Trust-Region Interior-Point Stochastic Sequential Quadratic Programming Method

author.name: Yuchen Fang, Jihun Kim, Sen Na, James Demmel, Javad Lavaei

entry.summary: Proposes TR-IP-SSQP, a trust-region interior-point stochastic SQP method for optimization with stochastic objectives and deterministic nonlinear constraints.

entry.title: A New Tensor Network: Tubal Tensor Train and Its Applications

author.name: Salman Ahmadi-Asl, Valentin Leplat, Anh-Huy Phan, Andrzej Cichocki

entry.summary: Introduces the tubal tensor train decomposition combining t-product algebra with tensor train format, achieving linear storage scaling for high-order tensors with a distinguished tube mode.

entry.title: A Principle-Driven Adaptive Policy for Group Cognitive Stimulation Dialogue for Elderly with Cognitive Impairment

author.name: Jiyue Jiang, Yanyu Chen, Pengan Chen, Kai Liu, Jingqi Zhou, Zheyong Zhu, He Hu, Fei Ma, Qi Tian, Chuan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a principle-driven adaptive policy for group cognitive stimulation dialogue for elderly with cognitive impairment, using real CST conversation data and therapeutic reasoning.

entry.title: MUNIChus: Multilingual News Image Captioning Benchmark

author.name: Yuji Chen, Alistair Plum, Hansi Hettiarachchi, Diptesh Kanojia, Saroj Basnet, Marcos Zampieri, Tharindu Ranasinghe

entry.summary: MUNIChus is the first multilingual news image captioning benchmark covering 9 languages including low-resource ones like Sinhala and Urdu. Evaluates state-of-the-art models and finds news image captioning remains challenging across languages.

entry.title: HG-Lane: High-Fidelity Generation of Lane Scenes under Adverse Weather and Lighting Conditions without Re-annotation

author.name: Daichao Zhao, Qiupu Chen, Feng He, Xin Ning, Qiankun Li

entry.summary: HG-Lane generates realistic lane detection training data under adverse weather conditions (rain, snow, fog) without re-annotation, constructing a 30K image benchmark for extreme weather lane detection.

entry.title: OilSAM2: Memory-Augmented SAM2 for Scalable SAR Oil Spill Detection

author.name: Shuaiyu Chen, Ming Yin, Peng Ren, Chunbo Luo, Zeyu Fu

entry.summary: OilSAM2 adapts SAM2 for SAR oil spill detection by introducing hierarchical multi-scale memory management designed for unordered image collections, addressing SAM2's assumption of temporal coherence.

entry.title: EmoStory: Emotion-Aware Story Generation

author.name: Jingyuan Yang, Rucong Chen, Hui Huang

entry.summary: EmoStory introduces emotion-aware story generation, a new task that generates subject-consistent visual stories with explicit emotional directions, grounding abstract emotions in concrete visual elements across narrative frames.

entry.title: TractoRC: A Unified Probabilistic Learning Framework for Joint Tractography Registration and Clustering

author.name: Yijie Li, Xi Zhu, Junyi Wang, Ye Wu, Lauren J. O'Donnell, Fan Zhang

entry.summary: TractoRC unifies tractography registration and streamline clustering into a single probabilistic framework, learning a latent embedding space where both tasks benefit from complementary information.

entry.title: IMTBench: A Multi-Scenario Cross-Modal Collaborative Evaluation Benchmark for In-Image Machine Translation

author.name: Jiahao Lyu, Pei Fu, Zhenhang Li, Weichao Zeng, Shaojie Zhan, Jiahui Yang, Can Ma, Yu Zhou, Zhenbo Luo, Jian Luan

entry.title: UHD Image Deblurring via Autoregressive Flow with Ill-conditioned Constraints

author.name: Yucheng Xin, Dawei Zhao, Xiang Chen, Chen Wu, Pu Wang, Dianjie Lu, Guijuan Zhang, Xiuyi Jia, Zhuoran Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes an autoregressive flow method for UHD image deblurring with ill-conditioned constraints, decomposing restoration into a progressive coarse-to-fine process balancing computational cost and detail recovery.

entry.title: How To Embed Matters: Evaluation of EO Embedding Design Choices

author.name: Luis Gilch, Isabelle Wittmann, Maximilian Nitsche, Johannes Jakubik, Arne Ewald, Thomas Brunschwiler

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes how embedding design choices (extraction, aggregation, combination) affect downstream performance in Earth Observation workflows with Geospatial Foundation Models. Provides practical guidance for scalable EO pipelines.

entry.title: Event-based Photometric Stereo via Rotating Illumination and Per-Pixel Learning

author.name: Hyunwoo Kim, Won-Hoe Kim, Sanghoon Lee, Jianfei Cai, Giljoo Nam, Jae-Sang Hyun

entry.summary: Proposes an event-based photometric stereo system using a rotating single light source and event camera for surface normal estimation. Introduces a per-pixel learning approach with a lightweight MLP for handling complex lighting.

entry.title: Bridging the Skill Gap in Clinical CBCT Interpretation with CBCTRepD

author.name: Qinxin Wu, Fucheng Niu, Hengchuan Zhu, Yifan Sun, Ye Shen, Xu Li, Han Wu, Leqi Liu, Zhiwen Pan, Zuozhu Liu, Fudong Zhu, Bin Feng

entry.summary: Introduces CBCTRepD, a bilingual CBCT report generation system for oral and maxillofacial imaging with 7,408 paired studies covering 55 disease entities. Designed for radiologist-AI co-authoring workflows.

entry.title: Autonomous Search for Sparsely Distributed Visual Phenomena through Environmental Context Modeling

author.name: Eric Chen, Travis Manderson, Nare Karapetyan, Peter Edmunds, Nicholas Roy, Yogesh Girdhar

entry.summary: Proposes using visual environmental context (co-occurring habitat features) to guide AUV search for sparsely distributed coral species, rather than relying on sparse target detections alone.

entry.title: Learning Adaptive Force Control for Contact-Rich Sample Scraping with Heterogeneous Materials

author.name: Cenk Cetin, Shreyas Pouli, Gabriella Pizzuto

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive force control for robotic sample scraping of heterogeneous materials in chemistry labs, addressing the challenge of handling diverse chemicals (granular, powdery, viscous) with fine-grained movements.

entry.title: How Hard a Problem is Alignment? (My Opinionated Answer)

author.name: RogerDearnaley

entry.summary: Companion piece arguing alignment is harder than steam engine safety but probably easier than the Apollo program or P≠NP, estimating required person-years of effort. Attempts to ground the difficulty discussion in concrete historical analogies.

entry.title: HAPEns: Hardware-Aware Post-Hoc Ensembling for Tabular Data

author.name: Jannis Maier, Lennart Purucker

entry.summary: Introduces HAPEns, a post-hoc ensembling method for tabular data that explicitly balances accuracy against hardware efficiency using multi-objective optimization along the Pareto front.

entry.title: ARCHE: Autoregressive Residual Compression with Hyperprior and Excitation

author.name: Sofia Iliopoulou, Dimitris Ampeliotis, Athanassios Skodras

entry.summary: Presents ARCHE, an end-to-end learned image compression framework that unifies hierarchical, spatial, and channel-based priors for efficient compression with balanced computational cost.

entry.title: A PUF-Based Approach for Copy Protection of Intellectual Property in Neural Network Models

author.name: Daniel Dorfmeister, Flavio Ferrarotti, Bernhard Fischer, Martin Schwandtner, Hannes Sochor

entry.summary: Proposes using Physically Unclonable Functions to bind neural network model weights to specific hardware, preventing IP theft through hardware cloning.

entry.title: ForwardFlow: Simulation only statistical inference using deep learning

author.name: Stefan B\"ohringer

entry.summary: Explores frequentist simulation-based inference using a single summary network trained to minimize MSE between learned summaries and parameters, compared to Bayesian normalizing flow approaches.

entry.title: PEEM: Prompt Engineering Evaluation Metrics for Interpretable Joint Evaluation of Prompts and Responses

author.name: Minki Hong, Eunsoo Lee, Sohyun Park, Jihie Kim

entry.summary: PEEM proposes a framework for jointly evaluating both prompts and LLM responses along 9 structured axes, providing interpretable scores and natural-language rationales rather than just answer correctness. Aims to give actionable feedback on prompt engineering.

entry.title: Multi-Person Pose Estimation Evaluation Using Optimal Transportation and Improved Pose Matching

author.name: Takato Moriki, Hiromu Taketsugu, Norimichi Ukita

entry.summary: Proposes OCpose, a new metric for multi-person pose estimation using optimal transportation that equally evaluates all detected poses regardless of confidence ranking, addressing the bias of current metrics toward high-confidence detections.

entry.title: Dynamic Modeling and Attitude Control of a Reaction-Wheel-Based Low-Gravity Bipedal Hopper

author.name: Shriram Hari, M Venkata Sai Nikhil, R Prasanth Kumar

entry.summary: Presents an underactuated bipedal hopping robot using a reaction wheel for mid-flight attitude control, modeled as a gyrostat for low-gravity planetary locomotion.

entry.title: Nurture-First Agent Development: Building Domain-Expert AI Agents Through Conversational Knowledge Crystallization

author.name: Linghao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Nurture-First Development (NFD), a paradigm where domain-expert AI agents are built through conversational knowledge crystallization rather than code-first or prompt-first approaches. Agents evolve continuously through interaction rather than discrete engineering phases.

entry.title: Social Knowledge for Cross-Domain User Preference Modeling

author.name: Nir Lotan, Adir Solomon, Ido Guy, Einat Minkov

entry.summary: Demonstrates cross-domain user preference prediction using large-scale social network embeddings from Twitter/X. Projects users and entities into a joint social space for zero-shot personalization via cosine similarity.

entry.title: Cluster-Aware Attention-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Pickup and Delivery Problems

author.name: Wentao Wang, Lifeng Han, Guangyu Zou

entry.summary: Proposes CAADRL for pickup and delivery problems, using cluster-aware encoding and hierarchical decoding to exploit multi-scale spatial structure in DRL-based vehicle routing.

entry.title: Copula-ResLogit: A Deep-Copula Framework for Unobserved Confounding Effects

author.name: Kimia Kamal, Bilal Farooq

entry.summary: Introduces Copula-ResLogit, a deep learning framework combining ResNet with copula models to detect and mitigate unobserved confounding in travel demand analysis.

entry.title: Mitigating Frequency Learning Bias in Quantum Models via Multi-Stage Residual Learning

author.name: Ammar Daskin

entry.summary: Adapts multi-stage residual learning from classical Fourier neural operators to quantum circuits, addressing the frequency learning bias where quantum models struggle with non-dominant frequencies.

entry.title: ViDia2Std: A Parallel Corpus and Methods for Low-Resource Vietnamese Dialect-to-Standard Translation

author.name: Khoa Anh Ta, Nguyen Van Dinh, Kiet Van Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces ViDia2Std, the first manually annotated parallel corpus for Vietnamese dialect-to-standard translation covering all 63 provinces, including underrepresented Central and Southern dialects. Addresses a significant gap in Vietnamese NLP resources.

entry.title: An Automated Radiomics Framework for Postoperative Survival Prediction in Colorectal Liver Metastases using Preoperative MRI

author.name: Muhammad Alberb, Jianan Chen, Hossam El-rewaidy, Paul Karanicolas, Arun Seth, Yutaka Amemiya, Anne Martel, Helen Cheung

entry.summary: Presents an automated AI framework for predicting postoperative survival in colorectal liver metastasis patients using pre-contrast MRI, combining anatomy-aware segmentation with radiomics analysis on 227 patients.

entry.title: A dataset of medication images with instance segmentation masks for preventing adverse drug events

author.name: W. I. Chu, S. Hirani, G. Tarroni, L. Li

entry.summary: Presents MEDISEG, an instance segmentation dataset for 32 pill types across 8,262 images including complex real-world conditions like overlapping pills and varied lighting. Demonstrates usability with YOLOv8 and YOLOv9.

entry.title: Shape Control of a Planar Hyper-Redundant Robot via Hybrid Kinematics-Informed and Learning-based Approach

author.name: Yuli Song, Wenbo Li, Wenci Xin, Zhiqiang Tang, Daniela Rus, Cecilia Laschi

entry.summary: Proposes SpatioCoupledNet for shape control of hyper-redundant planar robots, using a hierarchical neural network that captures bidirectional spatial coupling between segments with confidence-gated kinematic priors.

author.name: Ihor Kendiukhov

entry.summary: Proposes the 'Lethal Reality Hypothesis' — that civilization faces systemic risks not just from AI but from a general pattern where complex systems become increasingly fragile and interdependent. Argues this pattern makes catastrophic outcomes likely regardless of any single technology.

entry.title: Agentic Control Center for Data Product Optimization

author.name: Priyadarshini Tamilselvan, Gregory Bramble, Sola Shirai, Ken C. L. Wong, Faisal Chowdhury, Horst Samulowitz

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic system that automates data product improvement through specialized AI agents in a continuous optimization loop, with human-in-the-loop controls. The system monitors quality metrics and surfaces questions to refine data assets like SQL pairs and database views.

entry.title: Adaptive RAN Slicing Control via Reward-Free Self-Finetuning Agents

author.name: Yuanhao Li, Haozhe Wang, Geyong Min, Nektarios Georgalas, Wang Miao

entry.summary: Proposes a self-finetuning framework for generative AI agents in RAN (Radio Access Network) slicing control, enabling agents to internalize experience into parameters rather than relying on prompt-based memory for continuous control tasks.

entry.title: AMB-DSGDN: Adaptive Modality-Balanced Dynamic Semantic Graph Differential Network for Multimodal Emotion Recognition

author.name: Yunsheng Wang, Yuntao Shou, Yilong Tan, Wei Ai, Tao Meng, Keqin Li

entry.summary: Proposes AMB-DSGDN for multimodal dialogue emotion recognition, addressing modality dominance and redundant signal filtering through dynamic semantic graph differential networks with adaptive modality balancing.

entry.title: Gated Adaptation for Continual Learning in Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Reza Rahimi Azghan, Gautham Krishna Gudur, Mohit Malu, Edison Thomaz, Giulia Pedrielli, Pavan Turaga, Hassan Ghasemzadeh

entry.summary: Proposes a parameter-efficient continual learning approach for human activity recognition on wearable devices, using gated adaptation to balance plasticity and stability for domain-incremental learning across subjects.

entry.title: Hardware Efficient Approximate Convolution with Tunable Error Tolerance for CNNs

entry.title: Learning from Radio using Variational Quantum RF Sensing

author.name: Ivana Nikoloska

entry.summary: Proposes variational quantum RF sensing using a parameterized quantum circuit to learn from radio-frequency electromagnetic fields for localization tasks. Trained using ray-tracer data.

entry.title: NasoVoce: A Nose-Mounted Low-Audibility Speech Interface for Always-Available Speech Interaction

author.name: Jun Rekimoto, Yu Nishimura, Bojian Yang

entry.title: Enhancing Network Intrusion Detection Systems: A Multi-Layer Ensemble Approach to Mitigate Adversarial Attacks

author.name: Nasim Soltani, Shayan Nejadshamsi, Zakaria Abou El Houda, Raphael Khoury, Kelton A. P. Costa, Tiago H. Falk, Anderson R. Avila

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-layer ensemble defense mechanism for network intrusion detection systems against adversarial attacks, evaluating against GAN-based and FGSM adversarial examples.

entry.title: Domain-Adaptive Health Indicator Learning with Degradation-Stage Synchronized Sampling and Cross-Domain Autoencoder

author.name: Jungho Choo, Hanbyeol Park, Gawon Lee, Yunkyung Park, Hyerim Bae

entry.summary: Proposes a domain-adaptive health indicator framework for prognostics using degradation-stage synchronized sampling and cross-domain autoencoders to handle distribution mismatch from varying operating conditions.

entry.title: UAV-MARL: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Time-Critical and Dynamic Medical Supply Delivery

author.name: Islam Guven, Mehmet Parlak

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for coordinating UAV fleets in stochastic medical delivery scenarios, formulated as a POMDP with urgency-varying requests.

entry.title: Towards Cognitive Defect Analysis in Active Infrared Thermography with Vision-Text Cues

author.name: Mohammed Salah, Eman Ouda, Giuseppe Dell'Avvocato, Fabrizio Sarasini, Ester D'Accardi, Jorge Dias, Davor Svetinovic, Stefano Sfarra, Yusra Abdulrahman

entry.summary: Introduces a language-guided framework for cognitive defect analysis in carbon fiber-reinforced polymers using active infrared thermography and vision-language models, avoiding the need for training datasets.

entry.title: UAV traffic scene understanding: A cross-spectral guided approach and a unified benchmark

author.name: Yu Zhang, Zhicheng Zhao, Ze Luo, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Proposes CTCNet, a cross-spectral traffic cognition network for UAV-based traffic scene understanding that combines optical and other spectral imagery to handle adverse illumination conditions. Addresses limitations of current VQA models for traffic regulatory knowledge.

entry.title: Human Presence Detection via Wi-Fi Range-Filtered Doppler Spectrum on Commodity Laptops

author.name: Jessica Sanson, Rahul C. Shah, Valerio Frascolla

entry.summary: Proposes a monostatic Wi-Fi sensing solution for human presence detection using only built-in laptop Wi-Fi hardware, introducing Range-Filtered Doppler Spectrum for privacy-preserving presence estimation without external sensors.

entry.title: Instruction set for the representation of graphs

author.name: Ezequiel Lopez-Rubio, Mario Pascual-Gonzalez

entry.summary: Presents IsalGraph, a method to encode any finite simple graph as a compact string over a nine-character alphabet using a virtual machine with a sparse graph and circular linked list.

entry.title: Learning to Score: Tuning Cluster Schedulers through Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Martin Asenov, Qiwen Deng, Gingfung Yeung, Adam Barker

entry.summary: Proposes using RL to learn scoring function weights in cluster schedulers, replacing manual expert tuning with automated optimization for improved job allocation.

entry.title: Surrogate models for nuclear fusion with parametric Shallow Recurrent Decoder Networks: applications to magnetohydrodynamics

author.name: M. Lo Verso, C. Introini, E. Cervi, L. Savoldi, J. N. Kutz, A. Cammi

entry.title: Prioritizing Gradient Sign Over Modulus: An Importance-Aware Framework for Wireless Federated Learning

author.name: Yiyang Yue, Jiacheng Yao, Wei Xu, Zhaohui Yang, George K. Karagiannidis, Dusit Niyato

entry.summary: Proposes Sign-Prioritized Federated Learning (SP-FL) that prioritizes transmitting gradient signs over magnitudes to improve communication efficiency in wireless federated learning settings.

entry.title: Tureis: Transformer-based Unified Resilience for IoT Devices in Smart Homes

author.name: Alireza Borhani, Vafa Andalibi, Bahar Asgari

entry.summary: Proposes Tureis, a self-supervised transformer-based method for failure detection and faulty-sensor localization in smart homes, designed for multi-failure, multi-resident edge settings.

entry.title: Hybrid Hidden Markov Model for Modeling Equity Excess Growth Rate Dynamics: A Discrete-State Approach with Jump-Diffusion

author.name: Abdulrahman Alswaidan, Jeffrey D. Varner

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid hidden Markov model for financial time series that discretizes excess growth rates into Laplace quantile-defined states with Poisson-driven jump-duration mechanisms.

entry.title: GhazalBench: Usage-Grounded Evaluation of LLMs on Persian Ghazals

author.name: Ghazal Kalhor, Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh

entry.summary: Introduces GhazalBench for evaluating LLMs on Persian ghazals, revealing a dissociation between models' ability to paraphrase meaning versus access canonical verse forms.

entry.title: S-GRADES -- Studying Generalization of Student Response Assessments in Diverse Evaluative Settings

author.name: Tasfia Seuti, Sagnik Ray Choudhury

entry.summary: S-GRADES consolidates 14 diverse educational grading datasets under a unified benchmark, bridging the gap between Automated Essay Scoring and Automatic Short Answer Grading communities. Provides standardized evaluation protocols for student response assessment.

entry.title: Interpretable Chinese Metaphor Identification via LLM-Assisted MIPVU Rule Script Generation: A Comparative Protocol Study

author.name: Weihang Huang, Mengna Liu

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-assisted pipeline for Chinese metaphor identification that operationalizes four metaphor identification protocols as executable, human-auditable rule scripts. Focuses on interpretability in figurative language processing for Chinese.

entry.title: 4DEquine: Disentangling Motion and Appearance for 4D Equine Reconstruction from Monocular Video

author.name: Jin Lyu, Liang An, Pujin Cheng, Yebin Liu, Xiaoying Tang

entry.title: HyPER-GAN: Hybrid Patch-Based Image-to-Image Translation for Real-Time Photorealism Enhancement

author.name: Stefanos Pasios, Nikos Nikolaidis

entry.title: Phase-Interface Instance Segmentation as a Visual Sensor for Laboratory Process Monitoring

author.name: Mingyue Li, Xin Yang, Shilin Yan, Jinye Ran, Morui Zhu, Zirui Peng, Huanqing Peng, Wei Peng, Guanghua Zhang, Shuo Li, Hao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces LGA-RCM-YOLO for phase-interface instance segmentation in transparent lab glassware, along with CTG 2.0 benchmark dataset with 3,668 images and 23 glassware categories for chemical experiment monitoring.

entry.title: Contrastive learning-based video quality assessment-jointed video vision transformer for video recognition

author.name: Jian Sun, Mohammad H. Mahoor

entry.title: VCR: Variance-Driven Channel Recalibration for Robust Low-Light Enhancement

entry.title: Dance2Hesitate: A Multi-Modal Dataset of Dancer-Taught Hesitancy for Understandable Robot Motion

entry.summary: Introduces Dance2Hesitate, a multi-modal dataset of dancer-taught hesitant robot motions for human-robot collaboration, focusing on how hesitancy expression affects human coordination and safety judgments.

entry.title: How Hard a Problem is Alignment?

author.name: RogerDearnaley

entry.summary: Poses the question of exactly how hard alignment is as an engineering problem, referencing Chris Olah's difficulty spectrum. Attempts to frame alignment difficulty in terms of historical engineering challenges and person-years of effort needed.

entry.title: GATech at AbjadMed: Bidirectional Encoders vs. Causal Decoders: Insights from 82-Class Arabic Medical Classification

entry.title: A neural operator for predicting vibration frequency response curves from limited data

entry.summary: Proposes a neural operator for predicting vibration frequency response curves from limited data, using implicit physics structure without regularizing loss terms.

entry.title: FusionNet: a frame interpolation network for 4D heart models

author.name: Chujie Chang, Shoko Miyauchi, Ken'ichi Morooka, Ryo Kurazume, Oscar Martinez Mozos

entry.title: Adaptive Engram Memory System for Indonesian Language Model: Generative AI Based on TOBA LM for Batak and Minang Language

author.name: Hokky Situngkir, Kevin Siringoringo, Andhika Bernard Lumbantobing

entry.title: End-to-End Chatbot Evaluation with Adaptive Reasoning and Uncertainty Filtering

entry.title: Towards Intelligent Spectrum Management: Spectrum Demand Estimation Using Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Mohamad Alkadamani, Amir Ghasemi, Halim Yanikomeroglu

entry.title: MITRA: An AI Assistant for Knowledge Retrieval in Physics Collaborations

author.name: Abhishikth Mallampalli, Sridhara Dasu

entry.summary: Describes design and user studies for a robot-assisted chemical dialysis system, addressing a common multi-day purification method in polymer and protein synthesis through user-centered design.

author.name: andrew sauer

entry.title: The Refined Counterfactual Prisoner's Dilemma: An Attempt to Explode Decision-Theoretic Consequentialism

Building on Scott Garrabrant's critique of expected utility maximization, illustrates how ignoring counterfactual worlds after observation leads to suboptimal outcomes.

entry.title: Spatio-Temporal Forecasting of Retaining Wall Deformation: Mitigating Error Accumulation via Multi-Resolution ConvLSTM Stacking Ensemble

entry.title: Beyond Accuracy: Reliability and Uncertainty Estimation in Convolutional Neural Networks

author.name: Sanne Ruijs, Alina Kosiakova, Farrukh Javed

entry.summary: Compares Monte Carlo Dropout and Conformal Prediction for uncertainty quantification in CNNs (VGG16, GoogLeNet) on Fashion-MNIST. Standard calibration comparison work without significant novelty.

entry.title: FRIEND: Federated Learning for Joint Optimization of multi-RIS Configuration and Eavesdropper Intelligent Detection in B5G Networks

author.name: Maria Lamprini A. Bartsioka, Ioannis A. Bartsiokas, Anastasios K. Papazafeiropoulos, Maria A. Seimeni, Dimitra I. Kaklamani, Iakovos S. Venieris

entry.title: LuxBorrow: From Pompier to Pompjee, Tracing Borrowing in Luxembourgish

entry.title: Characterizing Healthy & Post-Stroke Neuromotor Behavior During 6D Upper-Limb Isometric Gaming: Implications for Design of End-Effector Rehabilitation Robot Interfaces

author.name: Ajay Anand, Gabriel Parra, Chad A. Berghoff, Laura A. Hallock

entry.title: We do not live by course alone

author.name: Joe Rogero

entry.summary: Career advice post for aspiring AI safety researchers arguing against over-investing in courses and instead advocating for direct action: contacting representatives, writing up research ideas, building tools, and engaging with real-world policy. Encourages practical engagement over credential accumulation.

author.name: KurtB

author.name: Gabriele Immordino, Andrea Vaiuso, Marcello Righi

entry.summary: Presents a retrieval-based assistant for unmanned aircraft safety assessment and regulatory compliance, using controlled text architecture with authoritative regulatory sources for traceable and auditable outputs.

author.name: Maria Lamprini Bartsioka, Ioannis A. Bartsiokas, Athanasios D. Panagopoulos, Dimitra I. Kaklamani, Iakovos S. Venieris

entry.title: GATech at AbjadGenEval Shared Task: Multilingual Embeddings for Arabic Machine-Generated Text Classification

author.name: Ahmed Khaled Khamis

author.name: Brandon Yee, Wilson Collins, Michael Iofin, Jiayi Fu

entry.title: An Efficient Hybrid Deep Learning Approach for Detecting Online Abusive Language

entry.title: TAMUSA-Chat: A Domain-Adapted Large Language Model Conversational System for Research and Responsible Deployment

author.name: Gabriel Caballero Ca\~nas, B\'arbara Alvado Arranz, Xavier S\`oria-Perpiny\`a, Antonio Ruiz-Verd\'u, Jes\'us Delegido, Jos\'e Moreno

entry.summary: Introduces 6ABOS, an open-source Python framework for atmospheric correction of EnMAP hyperspectral satellite imagery using the 6S radiative transfer model.

entry.title: SiDiaC-v.2.0: Sinhala Diachronic Corpus Version 2.0

author.name: Nevidu Jayatilleke, Nisansa de Silva, Uthpala Nimanthi, Gagani Kulathilaka, Azra Safrullah, Johan Sofalas

entry.title: A Robust Deep Learning Framework for Bangla License Plate Recognition Using YOLO and Vision-Language OCR

author.name: Nayeb Hasin, Md. Arafath Rahman Nishat, Mainul Islam, Khandakar Shakib Al Hasan, Asif Newaz

entry.summary: Presents a Bangla license plate recognition system combining YOLO variants for plate localization with OCR for text extraction, including a two-stage adaptive training strategy for YOLOv8.

entry.summary: Presents the eLasmobranc Dataset for elasmobranch (shark and ray) species recognition from the eastern Spanish Mediterranean, containing seven species with fine-grained morphological annotations for biodiversity monitoring.

entry.title: ‘Human Slop’ and a Captive Audience: Why No Book will Ever Have to Go Unread Again

author.name: Savannah Harlan

entry.summary: Argues that LLMs create a world where no human writing ever has to go unread, since AI can serve as an infinitely patient reader and literary companion. Introduces the concept of 'human slop' as the counterpart to AI-generated slop, exploring implications for writers and creators.

entry.title: PoultryLeX-Net: Domain-Adaptive Dual-Stream Transformer Architecture for Large-Scale Poultry Stakeholder Modeling

author.name: Stephen Afrifa, Biswash Khatiwada, Kapalik Khanal, Sanjay Shah, Lingjuan Wang-Li, Ramesh Bahadur Bist

entry.summary: Presents PoultryLeX-Net, a lexicon-enhanced dual-stream transformer for sentiment analysis of poultry industry discourse on social media. Addresses domain-specific challenges in agricultural NLP.

entry.title: Prompts and Prayers: the Rise of GPTheology

author.name: Ioana Cheres, Adrian Groza, Ioana Moldovan, Mick O'Hara, Connell Vaughan

entry.summary: Explores GPTheology, the phenomenon of AI being perceived as divine, examining how narratives around AI echo traditional religious constructs and how communities treat ChatGPT as a semi-divine oracle.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Innovation in Software Engineering

author.name: Carlos Alberto Fern\'andez-y-Fern\'andez, Jorge R. Aguilar-Cisneros

entry.summary: Explores how AI serves as a catalyst for software engineering innovation through a literature review and survey of industry practitioners. Analyzes AI's role in agile development methodologies.

entry.title: Novel Architecture of RPA In Oral Cancer Lesion Detection

author.name: Revana Magdy, Joy Naoum, Ali Hamdi

entry.summary: Evaluates two RPA implementations for oral cancer lesion detection, showing that design patterns and batch processing can achieve 60-100x efficiency improvement over standard RPA methods.

entry.title: A Quick Intro to Ring Signatures

author.name: KurtB

entry.summary: Introduction to ring signatures — a cryptographic primitive allowing someone to sign a message proving they're one of a group without revealing which member they are. Explains the basics of asymmetric cryptography and how ring signatures differ from standard digital signatures.

entry.title: NCAA Bracket Prediction Using Machine Learning and Combinatorial Fusion Analysis

author.name: Yuanhong Wu, Isaiah Smith, Tushar Marwah, Michael Schroeter, Mohamed Rahouti, D. Frank Hsu

entry.summary: Uses machine learning and Combinatorial Fusion Analysis to predict NCAA basketball brackets, achieving 74.6% accuracy by combining multiple ranking systems.

entry.title: Self-Scaled Broyden Family of Quasi-Newton Methods in JAX

author.name: Ivan Bioli, Mikel Mendibe Abarrategi

entry.summary: Technical note documenting a JAX implementation of Self-Scaled Broyden family of quasi-Newton methods, compatible with the Optimistix library.

entry.title: Concussion Treatments

author.name: Gordon Seidoh Worley

entry.summary: A personal account of recovering from a concussion, with a Claude-assisted literature review on sleep, meditation, and psilocybin as recovery interventions. Finds the three approaches are complementary, addressing different aspects of brain inflammation and neuroplasticity.

entry.title: Chesterton's Pill

author.name: AlphaAndOmega

entry.summary: A psychiatrist's firsthand account of observing psychiatric practice in India, comparing it to UK training. Explores how different medical systems approach pharmaceutical treatment and the value of Chesterton's fence reasoning when encountering unfamiliar treatment practices.

entry.title: STM32-Based Smart Waste Bin for Hygienic Disposal Using Embedded Sensing and Automated Control

author.name: Mohammed Aman Bhuiyan, Aritra Islam Saswato, Md. Misbah Khan, Anish Paul, Ahmed Faizul Haque Dhrubo, Mohammad Abdul Qayum

entry.summary: Describes an STM32-based automatic waste bin with ultrasonic presence detection, servo-controlled lid, and waste level monitoring via OLED display.

entry.title: Grappling with ideas of EA, Climate Change, Transhumanism, Identity Continuity, and Othering in my ‘biopunk that looks like high fantasy on the surface’ story of ‘Elvans’ and ‘Orcans’- would love your input, LessWrong!

author.name: JoanPull

entry.summary: A creative writing worldbuilding post exploring themes of transhumanism, climate change, and othering through a biopunk fiction setting with genetically engineered 'Elvans' and 'Orcans'. Seeks community feedback on philosophical themes embedded in the narrative.

entry.title: Conflicted on Ramsey

author.name: jefftk

entry.summary: Discusses the Ramsey/Financial Peace money management system popular in evangelical Christian communities, noting the tension between its suboptimal financial advice (e.g., avoiding all debt) and its remarkable effectiveness at helping people who struggle with financial discipline.

entry.title: Cryonics Sign-Up Party

author.name: Mikhail Samin

entry.summary: An event announcement for a cryonics sign-up party in London, providing basic cost information for Alcor membership and encouraging attendees to overcome procrastination around signing up.

entry.title: Research Summary: March 11, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's standout is Design Conductor, an autonomous agent that takes a 219-word spec to a verified, tape-out-ready 1.5 GHz RISC-V CPU in 12 hours—a landmark in AI-driven hardware design. In pure mathematics, AlphaEvolve improves lower bounds on five classical Ramsey numbers, including raising R(3,13) from 60 to 61.

A strong cluster of reasoning and safety research dominates:

  • Opaque Serial Depth formalizes precisely when chain-of-thought is necessary versus when hidden computation suffices, with direct implications for interpretability
  • Thinking to Recall reveals that CoT reasoning unlocks parametric knowledge through non-obvious mechanistic pathways beyond simple retrieval
  • Think Before You Lie finds reasoning *increases* LLM honesty—opposite to humans—offering a promising alignment lever
  • The Reasoning Trap warns that improved logical reasoning mechanistically enables situational awareness, a key dangerous capability
  • An impossibility theorem proves no alignment verification procedure can be simultaneously sound, general, and complete

In evaluation and real-world impact, EsoLang-Bench exposes how frontier models collapse on esoteric programming languages with minimal training data, cleanly separating memorization from reasoning. A large-scale study (N=19,145) finds LLMs now outperform human persuaders on political topics. PlayWorld trains video world models from unsupervised robot self-play, eliminating dependence on human demonstrations for whole-body humanoid control.

entry.title: Design Conductor: An agent autonomously builds a 1.5 GHz Linux-capable RISC-V CPU

author.name: The Verkor Team, Ravi Krishna, Suresh Krishna, David Chin

entry.summary: Design Conductor is an autonomous AI agent that builds complete RISC-V CPUs from a 219-word spec to verified, tape-out ready GDSII in 12 hours. The resulting VerCore achieves 1.48 GHz timing and CoreMark 3261, roughly equivalent to a 2011 Intel Celeron.

entry.title: Quantifying the Necessity of Chain of Thought through Opaque Serial Depth

author.name: Jonah Brown-Cohen, David Lindner, Rohin Shah

entry.summary: Formalizes when chain-of-thought reasoning is necessary through 'opaque serial depth' - the longest computation possible without interpretable intermediate steps. Computes numeric upper bounds for Gemma 3 models and provides automated measurement methods.

entry.title: Reinforced Generation of Combinatorial Structures: Ramsey Numbers

author.name: Ansh Nagda, Prabhakar Raghavan, Abhradeep Thakurta

entry.summary: Uses AlphaEvolve (LLM-based code mutation agent) to improve lower bounds for five classical Ramsey numbers, including R(3,13) from 60 to 61 and R(4,13) from 138 to 139.

entry.title: Thinking to Recall: How Reasoning Unlocks Parametric Knowledge in LLMs

author.name: Zorik Gekhman, Roee Aharoni, Eran Ofek, Mor Geva, Roi Reichart, Jonathan Herzig

entry.summary: Discovers that enabling chain-of-thought reasoning in LLMs substantially improves factual recall even for simple single-hop questions. Identifies two mechanisms: a computational buffer effect and an implicit multi-hop decomposition of recall.

entry.title: EsoLang-Bench: Evaluating Genuine Reasoning in Large Language Models via Esoteric Programming Languages

author.name: Aman Sharma, Paras Chopra

entry.summary: EsoLang-Bench evaluates LLM reasoning using esoteric programming languages (Brainfuck, Befunge-98, etc.) that have minimal training data. Frontier models achieving 85-95% on standard benchmarks score only 0-11%, revealing memorization vs genuine reasoning.

entry.title: Think Before You Lie: How Reasoning Improves Honesty

author.name: Ann Yuan, Asma Ghandeharioun, Carter Blum, Alicia Machado, Jessica Hoffmann, Daphne Ippolito, Martin Wattenberg, Lucas Dixon, Katja Filippova

entry.summary: Studies how reasoning affects honesty in LLMs using realistic moral trade-offs. Contrary to humans who become less honest with deliberation, reasoning consistently increases LLM honesty across scales and families. Shows this is partly due to representational geometry, not just reasoning content.

entry.title: PlayWorld: Learning Robot World Models from Autonomous Play

author.name: Tenny Yin, Zhiting Mei, Zhonghe Zheng, Miyu Yamane, David Wang, Jade Sceats, Samuel M. Bateman, Lihan Zha, Apurva Badithela, Ola Shorinwa, Anirudha Majumdar

entry.summary: Presents PlayWorld, a pipeline for training video world models from unsupervised robot self-play rather than human demonstrations. First system capable of learning entirely from autonomous play for high-fidelity video world simulation.

entry.title: On the Formal Limits of Alignment Verification

author.name: Ayushi Agarwal

entry.summary: Proves an impossibility result for AI alignment verification: no procedure can simultaneously be sound (rejects misaligned systems), general (full input domain), and tractable (polynomial time). Each pair is achievable but all three cannot hold simultaneously.

entry.title: Benchmarking Political Persuasion Risks Across Frontier Large Language Models

author.name: Zhongren Chen, Joshua Kalla, Quan Le

entry.summary: Benchmarks political persuasion capabilities of seven frontier LLMs (from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI) across N=19,145 participants. Finds LLMs outperform standard campaign advertisements, with Claude most persuasive and Grok least persuasive.

entry.title: The Reasoning Trap -- Logical Reasoning as a Mechanistic Pathway to Situational Awareness

author.name: Subramanyam Sahoo, Aman Chadha, Vinija Jain, Divya Chaudhary

entry.summary: Argues that improving LLM logical reasoning capabilities mechanistically enables situational awareness - a dangerous emergent capability. Introduces the RAISE framework identifying three pathways through which reasoning improvements enable deeper self-awareness.

entry.title: Curveball Steering: The Right Direction To Steer Isn't Always Linear

author.name: Shivam Raval, Hae Jin Song, Linlin Wu, Abir Harrasse, Jeff Phillips, Amirali Abdullah

entry.summary: Challenges the Linear Representation Hypothesis by measuring geometric distortion in LLM activation spaces and proposes 'Curveball steering' - nonlinear activation steering that follows the curved geometry of activation spaces instead of assuming linearity.

entry.title: Good Reasoning Makes Good Demonstrations: Implicit Reasoning Quality Supervision via In-Context Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Tiehua Mei, Minxuan Lv, Leiyu Pan, Zhenpeng Su, Hongru Hou, Hengrui Chen, Ao Xu, Deqing Yang

entry.summary: Proposes In-Context RLVR, which uses the quality of reasoning traces as demonstrations (Evidence Gain) to implicitly reweight rewards in RLVR training. Shows better reasoning traces serve as better teachers via in-context learning.

entry.title: InternVL-U: Democratizing Unified Multimodal Models for Understanding, Reasoning, Generation and Editing

author.name: Changyao Tian, Danni Yang, Guanzhou Chen, Erfei Cui, Zhaokai Wang, Yuchen Duan, Penghao Yin, Sitao Chen, Ganlin Yang, Mingxin Liu, Zirun Zhu, Ziqian Fan, Leyao Gu, Haomin Wang, Qi Wei, Jinhui Yin, Xue Yang, Zhihang Zhong, Qi Qin, Yi Xin, Bin Fu, Yihao Liu, Jiaye Ge, Qipeng Guo, Gen Luo, Hongsheng Li, Yu Qiao, Kai Chen, Hongjie Zhang

entry.summary: InternVL-U is a 4B-parameter unified multimodal model integrating understanding, reasoning, generation, and editing, combining an MLLM with an MMDiT-based visual generation head and comprehensive data synthesis.

entry.title: Alignment Is the Disease: Censorship Visibility and Alignment Constraint Complexity as Determinants of Collective Pathology in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Hiroki Fukui

entry.summary: Presents experimental evidence that alignment itself can produce collective pathology in multi-agent LLM systems. Invisible censorship maximizes collective pathological excitation, and alignment constraint complexity shows a nonlinear relationship with group breakdown.

entry.title: The Missing Memory Hierarchy: Demand Paging for LLM Context Windows

author.name: Tony Mason

entry.summary: Presents Pichay, a demand paging system for LLM context windows that treats context as L1 cache, evicting stale content and detecting page faults. Across 857 production sessions, identifies 21.8% structural waste in context usage.

entry.title: Skip to the Good Part: Representation Structure & Inference-Time Layer Skipping in Diffusion vs. Autoregressive LLMs

author.name: Raghavv Goel, Risheek Garrepalli, Sudhanshu Agrawal, Chris Lott, Mingu Lee, Fatih Porikli

entry.summary: Performs first representational analysis comparing diffusion LLMs (LLaDA) vs autoregressive models (Qwen2.5), finding diffusion objectives create more hierarchical representations with early-layer redundancy. Shows dLLMs tolerate more aggressive layer skipping.

entry.title: Removing the Trigger, Not the Backdoor: Alternative Triggers and Latent Backdoors

author.name: Gorka Abad, Ermes Franch, Stefanos Koffas, Stjepan Picek

entry.summary: Demonstrates that alternative triggers—patterns distinct from training triggers—can reliably activate the same backdoor, challenging the assumption that neutralizing a known trigger removes the backdoor. Provides theoretical proof of alternative trigger existence.

entry.title: Chaotic Dynamics in Multi-LLM Deliberation

author.name: Hajime Shimao, Warut Khern-am-nuai, Sung Joo Kim

entry.summary: Models multi-LLM deliberation committees as random dynamical systems and quantifies instability using empirical Lyapunov exponents. Finds two independent routes to instability: role differentiation in homogeneous committees and model heterogeneity, even at temperature=0.

entry.title: BinaryAttention: One-Bit QK-Attention for Vision and Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Chaodong Xiao, Zhengqiang Zhang, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: BinaryAttention proposes 1-bit quantization of query and key matrices in attention, replacing floating-point dot products with bitwise operations. Theoretical justification shows similarity relationships are preserved under binarization.

entry.title: MASEval: Extending Multi-Agent Evaluation from Models to Systems

author.name: Cornelius Emde, Alexander Rubinstein, Anmol Goel, Ahmed Heakl, Sangdoo Yun, Seong Joon Oh, Martin Gubri

entry.summary: MASEval introduces a framework-agnostic evaluation library for multi-agent LLM systems that treats the entire system (not just the model) as the unit of analysis. Through systematic comparison across 3 benchmarks, 3 models, and 3 frameworks, they find framework choice matters as much as model choice. This challenges the model-centric evaluation paradigm.

entry.title: Fish Audio S2 Technical Report

author.name: Shijia Liao, Yuxuan Wang, Songting Liu, Yifan Cheng, Ruoyi Zhang, Tianyu Li, Shidong Li, Yisheng Zheng, Xingwei Liu, Qingzheng Wang, Zhizhuo Zhou, Jiahua Liu, Xin Chen, Dawei Han

entry.summary: Introduces Fish Audio S2, an open-source TTS system with multi-speaker, multi-turn generation and natural-language instruction-following control. Features a multi-stage training pipeline and production-ready SGLang-based inference engine achieving RTF of 0.195 and sub-100ms time-to-first-audio.

entry.title: ZeroWBC: Learning Natural Visuomotor Humanoid Control Directly from Human Egocentric Video

author.name: Haoran Yang, Jiacheng Bao, Yucheng Xin, Haoming Song, Yuyang Tian, Bin Zhao, Dong Wang, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Introduces ZeroWBC, a framework learning humanoid whole-body control from human egocentric videos without robot teleoperation data, enabling natural behaviors like sitting and kicking.

entry.title: Compiler-First State Space Duality and Portable $O(1)$ Autoregressive Caching for Inference

author.name: Cosmo Santoni

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Mamba-2's state space duality algorithm can be implemented via standard XLA primitives without custom CUDA/Triton kernels, achieving O(1) autoregressive caching and removing NVIDIA hardware dependency. Runs on TPU and GPU without modification.

entry.title: On the Width Scaling of Neural Optimizers Under Matrix Operator Norms I: Row/Column Normalization and Hyperparameter Transfer

author.name: Ruihan Xu, Jiajin Li, Yiping Lu

entry.summary: Interprets neural network optimizers (AdamW, Muon) as steepest descent under matrix operator norms, introducing modified norms that enable width-independent Lipschitz/smoothness bounds in deep architectures. Addresses hyperparameter transfer across widths.

entry.title: You Didn't Have to Say It like That: Subliminal Learning from Faithful Paraphrases

author.name: Isaia Gisler (ETH Z\"urich), Zhonghao He (University of Cambridge), Tianyi Qiu (Peking University)

entry.summary: Investigates subliminal learning where student models acquire behavioral traits from teacher models through natural language paraphrases, even when content explicitly contradicts teacher preferences. Raises alignment concerns.

entry.title: ALARM: Audio-Language Alignment for Reasoning Models

author.name: Petr Grinberg, Hassan Shahmohammadi

entry.summary: Proposes ALARM, a method for aligning audio encoders with reasoning LLMs via self-rephrasing that converts self-generated responses into audio-understanding variants. The 4B-parameter model outperforms similarly sized models and surpasses some larger ones using a 6M-instance multi-task corpus.

entry.title: Towards Unified Multimodal Interleaved Generation via Group Relative Policy Optimization

author.name: Ming Nie, Chunwei Wang, Jianhua Han, Hang Xu, Li Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes using reinforcement learning (Group Relative Policy Optimization) for post-training unified vision-language models to enable multimodal interleaved generation, without requiring large-scale interleaved datasets.

entry.title: An Empirical Study and Theoretical Explanation on Task-Level Model-Merging Collapse

author.name: Yuan Cao, Dezhi Ran, Yuzhe Guo, Mengzhou Wu, Simin Chen, Linyi Li, Wei Yang, Tao Xie

entry.summary: Identifies and characterizes 'merging collapse' - catastrophic performance degradation when certain task-specialist LLMs are merged. Provides both empirical analysis and theoretical explanation of when and why model merging fails.

entry.title: OOD-MMSafe: Advancing MLLM Safety from Harmful Intent to Hidden Consequences

author.name: Ming Wen, Kun Yang, Jingyu Zhang, Yuxuan Liu, shiwen cui, Shouling Ji, Xingjun Ma

entry.summary: OOD-MMSafe proposes consequence-driven safety evaluation for multimodal LLMs, testing ability to identify latent hazards in causal chains. Reveals 'causal blindness' with 67.5% failure rate in frontier closed-source models.

entry.title: Large Language Model-Assisted Superconducting Qubit Experiments

author.name: Shiheng Li, Jacob M. Miller, Phoebe J. Lee, Gustav Andersson, Christopher R. Conner, Yash J. Joshi, Bayan Karimi, Amber M. King, Howard L. Malc, Harsh Mishra, Hong Qiao, Minseok Ryu, Xuntao Wu, Siyuan Xing, Haoxiong Yan, Jian Shi, Andrew N. Cleland

entry.summary: Framework using LLMs to automate superconducting qubit control and measurement experiments, generating tools on demand via a knowledge base. Demonstrated with autonomous resonator characterization and directed Ramsey experiments.

entry.title: Reviving ConvNeXt for Efficient Convolutional Diffusion Models

author.name: Taesung Kwon, Lorenzo Bianchi, Lennart Wittke, Felix Watine, Fabio Carrara, Jong Chul Ye, Romann Weber, Vinicius Azevedo

entry.summary: Introduces FCDM, a fully convolutional diffusion model based on ConvNeXt that achieves competitive performance with DiT-XL using 50% of FLOPs and 7x fewer training steps at both 256 and 512 resolutions.

entry.title: Expressivity-Efficiency Tradeoffs for Hybrid Sequence Models

author.name: John Cooper, Ilias Diakonikolas, Mingchen Ma, Frederic Sala

entry.summary: Proves fundamental expressivity-efficiency tradeoffs for hybrid Transformer/SSM models, showing that non-hybrid models require either many parameters or large working memory for certain tasks, while hybrid models overcome these limitations.

entry.title: MM-Zero: Self-Evolving Multi-Model Vision Language Models From Zero Data

author.name: Zongxia Li, Hongyang Du, Chengsong Huang, Xiyang Wu, Lantao Yu, Yicheng He, Jing Xie, Xiaomin Wu, Zhichao Liu, Jiarui Zhang, Fuxiao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes MM-Zero, the first RL-based framework for zero-data self-evolution of vision-language models, using three specialized roles (Proposer, Critic, Solver) to generate training data without any seed images.

entry.title: N-gram-like Language Models Predict Reading Time Best

author.name: James A. Michaelov, Roger P. Levy

entry.summary: Finds that neural language models whose predictions most correlate with n-gram probabilities are also those best at predicting human reading times, suggesting reading time is sensitive to simpler statistical patterns than what advanced transformers capture.

entry.title: On the Structural Failure of Chamfer Distance in 3D Shape Optimization

author.name: Chang-Yong Song, David Hyde

entry.summary: Reveals that directly optimizing Chamfer distance can produce worse results than not optimizing it at all, proving this is a gradient-structural failure due to many-to-one collapse. Derives necessary conditions for collapse suppression.

entry.title: Meissa: Multi-modal Medical Agentic Intelligence

author.name: Yixiong Chen, Xinyi Bai, Yue Pan, Zongwei Zhou, Alan Yuille

entry.summary: Meissa is a lightweight 4B-parameter medical multimodal LLM that brings agentic capability offline for clinical use, learning when to engage external tools and how to execute multi-step interactions through distillation from frontier models. Addresses cost, latency, and privacy concerns of API-based deployment.

entry.title: Rescaling Confidence: What Scale Design Reveals About LLM Metacognition

author.name: Yuyang Dai

entry.summary: Shows that the standard 0-100 confidence scale for LLM verbalized confidence is not neutral - over 78% of responses concentrate on three round numbers. A 0-20 scale consistently improves metacognitive efficiency. Simple but important methodological finding.

entry.title: Unveiling the Potential of Quantization with MXFP4: Strategies for Quantization Error Reduction

author.name: Jatin Chhugani, Geonhwa Jeong, Bor-Yiing Su, Yunjie Pan, Hanmei Yang, Aayush Ankit, Jiecao Yu, Summer Deng, Yunqing Chen, Nadathur Satish, Changkyu Kim

entry.summary: Introduces two software-only techniques (Overflow-Aware Scaling and Macro Block Scaling) to improve MXFP4 quantization fidelity without hardware changes, closing the gap with NVIDIA's NVFP4 format for LLM inference.

entry.title: Hindsight Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

author.name: Hui-Ze Tan, Xiao-Wen Yang, Hao Chen, Jie-Jing Shao, Yi Wen, Yuteng Shen, Weihong Luo, Xiku Du, Lan-Zhe Guo, Yu-Feng Li

entry.summary: HCAPO introduces hindsight credit assignment for long-horizon LLM agents, using the LLM itself as a post-hoc critic to refine step-level Q-values. Addresses sparse reward challenges in multi-step tasks with a multi-scale advantage mechanism.

entry.title: Clear, Compelling Arguments: Rethinking the Foundations of Frontier AI Safety Cases

author.name: Shaun Feakins, Ibrahim Habli, Phillip Morgan

entry.summary: Critiques the nascent field of safety cases for frontier AI systems, noting that work drawing on lessons from safety-critical industries (aerospace, nuclear) often has significant gaps. Provides constructive analysis of how to improve safety case methodology.

entry.title: Arbiter: Detecting Interference in LLM Agent System Prompts

author.name: Tony Mason

entry.summary: Presents Arbiter, a framework for detecting interference patterns in LLM coding agent system prompts. Analyzes Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI system prompts, finding 152 interference findings across vendors.

entry.title: RubiCap: Rubric-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Dense Image Captioning

author.name: Tzu-Heng Huang, Sirajul Salekin, Javier Movellan, Frederic Sala, Manjot Bilkhu

entry.summary: Introduces RubiCap, an RL framework for dense image captioning that derives fine-grained rewards from LLM-written rubrics, enabling RL training in open-ended captioning where deterministic checkers are unavailable.

entry.title: Towards a Neural Debugger for Python

author.name: Maximilian Beck, Jonas Gehring, Jannik Kossen, Gabriel Synnaeve

entry.summary: Introduces neural debuggers - LLMs trained on Python execution traces that support interactive debugging operations like stepping into/over/out of functions and setting breakpoints, extending prior neural interpreter work from FAIR.

entry.title: The $qs$ Inequality: Quantifying the Double Penalty of Mixture-of-Experts at Inference

author.name: Vignesh Adhinarayanan, Nuwan Jayasena

entry.summary: Identifies a 'double penalty' for Mixture-of-Experts models at inference: expert routing fragments microbatches reducing weight reuse, while large expert pools reduce KV cache headroom. Introduces the qs inequality as a predictive criterion.

entry.title: Exclusive Self Attention

author.name: Shuangfei Zhai

entry.summary: Introduces Exclusive Self Attention (XSA), a simple modification that constrains attention to capture only information orthogonal to the token's own value vector, consistently outperforming standard self-attention up to 2.7B parameters.

entry.title: Generative Drifting is Secretly Score Matching: a Spectral and Variational Perspective

author.name: Erkan Turan, Maks Ovsjanikov

entry.summary: Shows that the drift operator in Generative Modeling via Drifting (under Gaussian kernel) is exactly a score difference on smoothed distributions, answering three open questions about uniqueness, kernel selection, and stop-gradient necessity.

entry.title: KernelCraft: Benchmarking for Agentic Close-to-Metal Kernel Generation on Emerging Hardware

author.name: Jiayi Nie, Haoran Wu, Yao Lai, Zeyu Cao, Cheng Zhang, Binglei Lou, Erwei Wang, Jianyi Cheng, Timothy M. Jones, Robert Mullins, Rika Antonova, Yiren Zhao

entry.summary: Presents KernelCraft, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to generate low-level kernels for novel AI accelerators with custom ISAs. Tests whether agentic LLM systems can produce valid and efficient code for emerging hardware.

entry.title: One Language, Two Scripts: Probing Script-Invariance in LLM Concept Representations

author.name: Sripad Karne

entry.summary: Uses Serbian digraphia (Latin and Cyrillic scripts for identical content) to test whether SAE features encode abstract meaning or surface orthography. Finds highly overlapping features across scripts, demonstrating abstract concept encoding in LLMs.

entry.title: Surgical Repair of Collapsed Attention Heads in ALiBi Transformers

author.name: Palmer Schallon

entry.summary: Identifies systematic attention collapse in BLOOM models where ALiBi positional encoding causes 31-44% of attention heads to attend almost entirely to BOS token. Proposes surgical reinitialization that recovers 98.7% operational head capacity on a single consumer GPU.

entry.title: GeoSolver: Scaling Test-Time Reasoning in Remote Sensing with Fine-Grained Process Supervision

author.name: Lang Sun, Ronghao Fu, Zhuoran Duan, Haoran Liu, Xueyan Liu, Bo Yang

entry.summary: GeoSolver introduces process-supervised reinforcement learning for remote sensing reasoning, using entropy-guided MCTS and visual hallucination injection to create a 2M-token process supervision dataset, improving step-by-step reasoning faithfulness.

entry.title: Letting Claude do Autonomous Research to Improve SAEs

author.name: chanind

entry.summary: Reports on letting Claude Code autonomously improve Sparse Autoencoders on a synthetic benchmark, boosting F1 from 0.88 to 0.97 overnight. Claude independently discovered a 2010 dictionary-learning algorithm and adapted it. Not yet verified on LLM SAEs.

entry.title: Social-R1: Towards Human-like Social Reasoning in LLMs

author.name: Jincenzi Wu, Yuxuan Lei, Jianxun Lian, Yitian Huang, Lexin Zhou, Haotian Li, Xing Xie, Helen Meng

entry.summary: Social-R1 uses reinforcement learning to improve LLM social reasoning capabilities using ToMBench-Hard, an adversarial benchmark with hard training examples for social intelligence. Addresses shortcut solutions in Theory of Mind tasks.

entry.title: FrameDiT: Diffusion Transformer with Frame-Level Matrix Attention for Efficient Video Generation

author.name: Minh Khoa Le, Kien Do, Duc Thanh Nguyen, Truyen Tran

entry.summary: FrameDiT proposes Matrix Attention, a frame-level temporal attention mechanism for video diffusion transformers that processes entire frames as matrices rather than individual tokens, resolving the trade-off between Full 3D and Local Factorized attention.

entry.title: Security Considerations for Multi-agent Systems

author.name: Tam Nguyen, Moses Ndebugre, Dheeraj Arremsetty

entry.summary: Systematically characterizes security vulnerabilities unique to multi-agent AI systems and evaluates 16 existing security frameworks against MAS-specific threats. Proposes a four-phase threat modeling methodology.

entry.title: Reading, Not Thinking: Understanding and Bridging the Modality Gap When Text Becomes Pixels in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Kaiser Sun, Xiaochuang Yuan, Hongjun Liu, Chen Zhao, Cheng Zhang, Mark Dredze, Fan Bai

entry.summary: Systematically diagnoses the modality gap in MLLMs when text is presented as images vs tokens. Finds the gap is task- and data-dependent, with rendering choices (font, resolution) causing up to 47 percentage point swings.

entry.title: VisionCreator-R1: A Reflection-Enhanced Native Visual-Generation Agentic Model

author.name: Jinxiang Lai, Wenzhe Zhao, Zexin Lu, Hualei Zhang, Qinyu Yang, Rongwei Quan, Zhimin Li, Shuai Shao, Song Guo, Qinglin Lu

entry.summary: Proposes VisionCreator-R1, a visual generation agent with explicit reflection mechanisms and Reflection-Plan Co-Optimization training. Identifies and addresses reflection-plan optimization asymmetry in reinforcement learning for visual generation.

entry.title: The FABRIC Strategy for Verifying Neural Feedback Systems

author.name: I. Samuel Akinwande, Sydney M. Katz, Mykel J. Kochenderfer, Clark Barrett

entry.summary: Introduces FABRIC, a strategy combining forward and backward reachability analysis for verifying neural feedback systems (dynamical systems controlled by neural networks). Addresses the gap in backward reachability analysis for nonlinear neural feedback systems with new algorithms for over- and underapproximations.

entry.title: From Days to Minutes: An Autonomous AI Agent Achieves Reliable Clinical Triage in Remote Patient Monitoring

author.name: Seunghwan Kim (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA), Tiffany H. Kung (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA, Stanford School of Medicine, Stanford, USA), Heena Verma (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA), Dilan Edirisinghe (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA), Kaveh Sedehi (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA), Johanna Alvarez (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA), Diane Shilling (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA), Audra Lisa Doyle (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA), Ajit Chary (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA), William Borden (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA, George Washington University, Washington, D.C., USA), Ming Jack Po (AnsibleHealth Inc., San Francisco, USA)

entry.summary: Sentinel is an autonomous AI agent for clinical triage of remote patient monitoring vitals using Model Context Protocol with 21 clinical tools. Validated against 6 clinicians showing comparable performance, and achieves results in minutes versus days.

entry.title: Abundant Intelligence and Deficient Demand: A Macro-Financial Stress Test of Rapid AI Adoption

author.name: Xupeng Chen

entry.summary: Formalizes a macro-financial stress test for rapid AI adoption, identifying distribution-and-contract mismatches where AI abundance coexists with demand deficiency. Models displacement spirals, 'Ghost GDP' (unmeasured AI output), and financial fragility.

entry.title: MiniAppBench: Evaluating the Shift from Text to Interactive HTML Responses in LLM-Powered Assistants

author.name: Zuhao Zhang, Chengyue Yu, Yuante Li, Chenyi Zhuang, Linjian Mo, Shuai Li

entry.summary: MiniAppBench evaluates LLMs on generating interactive HTML-based applications (MiniApps) rather than static text, sourced from a real-world application with 10M+ generations. Captures the shift in human-AI interaction toward dynamic interactive outputs.

entry.title: Let's Verify Math Questions Step by Step

author.name: Chengyu Shen, Zhen Hao Wong, Runming He, Hao Liang, Meiyi Qiang, Zimo Meng, Zhengyang Zhao, Bohan Zeng, Zhengzhou Zhu, Bin Cui, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: MathQ-Verify is a five-stage pipeline for filtering ill-posed or under-specified math problems, addressing an overlooked aspect of math training data - the validity of questions themselves rather than just answer correctness.

entry.title: Zipage: Maintain High Request Concurrency for LLM Reasoning through Compressed PagedAttention

author.name: Mengqi Liao, Lu Wang, Chaoyun Zhang, Bo Qiao, Si Qin, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang, Huaiyu Wan

entry.summary: Zipage combines token-wise KV cache eviction with PagedAttention and comprehensive scheduling for high-concurrency LLM reasoning inference. Achieves ~2x throughput improvement on large-scale mathematical reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Permutation-Equivariant 2D State Space Models: Theory and Canonical Architecture for Multivariate Time Series

author.name: Seungwoo Jeong, Heung-Il Suk

entry.summary: Proves that permutation-equivariant linear 2D state-space systems decompose into local self-dynamics and global pooled interaction, showing ordered recurrence is structurally suboptimal for multivariate time series.

entry.title: VoxEmo: Benchmarking Speech Emotion Recognition with Speech LLMs

author.name: Hezhao Zhang, Huang-Cheng Chou, Shrikanth Narayanan, Thomas Hain

entry.summary: Presents VoxEmo, a comprehensive speech emotion recognition benchmark spanning 35 corpora across 15 languages for evaluating Speech LLMs. Introduces distribution-aware soft-label protocol and prompt-ensemble evaluation to handle emotion ambiguity.

entry.title: Semantic Level of Detail: Multi-Scale Knowledge Representation via Heat Kernel Diffusion on Hyperbolic Manifolds

author.name: Edward Izgorodin

entry.summary: Proposes Semantic Level of Detail (SLoD), a framework for continuous-resolution knowledge representation using heat kernel diffusion on the Poincaré ball, enabling smooth zoom between fine-grained and abstract semantic levels.

entry.title: DexHiL: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model Post-Training in Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Yifan Han, Zhongxi Chen, Yuxuan Zhao, Congsheng Xu, Yanming Shao, Yichuan Peng, Yao Mu, Wenzhao Lian

entry.summary: Presents DexHiL, the first integrated arm-hand human-in-the-loop framework for dexterous VLA models, enabling real-time correction and refinement of multi-finger manipulation policies.

entry.title: DuplexCascade: Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Dialogue with VAD-Free Cascaded ASR-LLM-TTS Pipeline and Micro-Turn Optimization

author.name: Jianing Yang, Yusuke Fujita, Yui Sudo

entry.summary: Presents DuplexCascade, a VAD-free cascaded ASR-LLM-TTS pipeline for full-duplex speech dialogue that converts utterance-wise turns into chunk-wise micro-turns, preserving LLM intelligence while enabling rapid bidirectional exchange.

entry.title: Latent-DARM: Bridging Discrete Diffusion And Autoregressive Models For Reasoning

author.name: Lina Berrayana, Ahmed Heakl, Abdullah Sohail, Thomas Hofmann, Salman Khan, Wei Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Latent-DARM, a latent-space communication framework bridging discrete diffusion language models (planners) and autoregressive models (executors), improving accuracy from 27.0% to 36.0% on reasoning benchmarks.

entry.title: A Guideline-Aware AI Agent for Zero-Shot Target Volume Auto-Delineation

author.name: Yoon Jo Kim, Wonyoung Cho, Jongmin Lee, Han Joo Chae, Hyunki Park, Sang Hoon Seo, Noh Jae Myung, Kyungmi Yang, Dongryul Oh, Jin Sung Kim

entry.summary: Introduces OncoAgent, a guideline-aware AI agent that converts textual clinical guidelines into 3D target contours for radiotherapy in a training-free manner, achieving zero-shot Dice of 0.842 for CTV.

entry.title: Variational Routing: A Scalable Bayesian Framework for Calibrated Mixture-of-Experts Transformers

author.name: Albus Yizhuo Li, Matthew Wicker

entry.summary: Introduces Variational MoE Routing (VMoER), confining Bayesian inference to expert-selection in MoE layers for calibrated uncertainty quantification at scale in foundation models.

entry.title: Mousse: Rectifying the Geometry of Muon with Curvature-Aware Preconditioning

author.name: Yechen Zhang, Shuhao Xing, Junhao Huang, Kai Lv, Yunhua Zhou, Xipeng Qiu, Qipeng Guo, Kai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Mousse, a curvature-aware preconditioning method that improves upon Muon optimizer by accounting for the heavy-tailed curvature spectrum of DNNs rather than assuming isotropic landscapes on the Stiefel manifold.

entry.title: From Data Statistics to Feature Geometry: How Correlations Shape Superposition

author.name: Lucas Prieto, Edward Stevinson, Melih Barsbey, Tolga Birdal, Pedro A. M. Mediano

entry.summary: Studies how data correlations shape feature superposition in neural networks, introducing Bag-of-Words Superposition (BOWS) to show that correlated features form qualitatively different geometric arrangements than the uncorrelated case studied previously.

entry.title: Decoupling Reasoning and Confidence: Resurrecting Calibration in Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Zhengzhao Ma, Xueru Wen, Boxi Cao, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Jinglin Yang, Min He, Xianpei Han, Le Sun

entry.summary: Proposes DCPO which decouples reasoning and confidence calibration objectives in RLVR training for LLMs, addressing the fundamental gradient conflict between maximizing accuracy and minimizing calibration error.

entry.title: Beyond Test-Time Training: Learning to Reason via Hardware-Efficient Optimal Control

author.name: Peihao Wang, Shan Yang, Xijun Wang, Tesi Xiao, Xin Liu, Changlong Yu, Yu Lou, Pan Li, Zhangyang Wang, Ming Lin, Ren\'e Vidal

entry.summary: Formulates reasoning as optimal control and introduces Test-Time Control (TTC) layer that performs finite-horizon LQR planning over latent states at inference, with a hardware-efficient LQR solver for scalability.

entry.title: On Catastrophic Forgetting in Low-Rank Decomposition-Based Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning

author.name: Muhammad Ahmad, Jingjing Zheng, Yankai Cao

entry.summary: Studies catastrophic forgetting in LoRA-style parameter-efficient fine-tuning, showing that forgetting depends on the geometry of the update subspace. Finds tensor-based decompositions (LoRETTA) mitigate forgetting better than standard LoRA.

entry.title: SciTaRC: Benchmarking QA on Scientific Tabular Data that Requires Language Reasoning and Complex Computation

author.name: Hexuan Wang, Yaxuan Ren, Srikar Bommireddypalli, Shuxian Chen, Adarsh Prabhudesai, Rongkun Zhou, Elina Baral, Philipp Koehn

entry.summary: Introduces SciTaRC, an expert-authored benchmark for QA on scientific tables requiring both language reasoning and complex computation. Shows SOTA models fail on 23-65% of questions, revealing an execution bottleneck.

entry.title: Chow-Liu Ordering for Long-Context Reasoning in Chain-of-Agents

author.name: Naman Gupta, Vaibhav Singh, Arun Iyer, Kirankumar Shiragur, Pratham Grover, Ramakrishna B. Bairi, Ritabrata Maiti, Sankarshan Damle, Shachee Mishra Gupta, Rishikesh Maurya, Vageesh D. C

entry.summary: Applies Chow-Liu tree ordering to determine optimal chunk processing order in Chain-of-Agents frameworks for long-context reasoning. Addresses the information bottleneck in sequential multi-agent processing of long documents.

entry.title: Do What I Say: A Spoken Prompt Dataset for Instruction-Following

author.name: Maike Z\"ufle, Sara Papi, Fabian Retkowski, Szymon Mazurek, Marek Kasztelnik, Alexander Waibel, Luisa Bentivogli, Jan Niehues

entry.summary: Introduces DoWhatISay (DOWIS), a multilingual dataset of human-recorded spoken prompts spanning 9 tasks and 11 languages for evaluating Speech LLMs under realistic spoken instruction conditions. Finds text prompts consistently overestimate SLLM performance.

entry.title: Granulon: Awakening Pixel-Level Visual Encoders with Adaptive Multi-Granularity Semantics for MLLM

author.name: Junyuan Mao, Qiankun Li, Linghao Meng, Zhicheng He, Xinliang Zhou, Kun Wang, Yang Liu, Yueming Jin

entry.summary: Proposes Granulon, a DINOv3-based multimodal LLM with adaptive granularity augmentation that dynamically adjusts visual abstraction level based on text input. Addresses the gap between pixel-level perception (DINOv3) and semantic abstraction (CLIP).

entry.title: Comparative Analysis of Patch Attack on VLM-Based Autonomous Driving Architectures

author.name: David Fernandez, Pedram MohajerAnsari, Amir Salarpour, Long Cheng, Abolfazl Razi, Mert D. Pes\'e

entry.summary: Presents a systematic framework for evaluating adversarial patch attacks against VLM-based autonomous driving architectures (Dolphins, OmniDrive, LeapVAD). Reveals severe vulnerabilities including sustained multi-frame failures.

entry.title: SVG-EAR: Parameter-Free Linear Compensation for Sparse Video Generation via Error-aware Routing

author.name: Xuanyi Zhou, Qiuyang Mang, Shuo Yang, Haocheng Xi, Jintao Zhang, Huanzhi Mao, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Kurt Keutzer, Ion Stoica, Alvin Cheung

entry.summary: Introduces SVG-EAR, a parameter-free method for recovering missing information in sparse attention for video generation diffusion transformers. Uses semantic clustering of keys/values to approximate dropped attention blocks without training.

entry.title: When Detectors Forget Forensics: Blocking Semantic Shortcuts for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Chao Shuai, Zhenguang Liu, Shaojing Fan, Bin Gong, Weichen Lian, Xiuli Bi, Zhongjie Ba, Kui Ren

entry.summary: Identifies 'semantic fallback' in CLIP-based AI-generated image detectors where they rely on semantic priors rather than forgery traces under distribution shift. Proposes Geometric Semantic Decoupling (GSD) as a parameter-free fix.

entry.title: Streaming Autoregressive Video Generation via Diagonal Distillation

author.name: Jinxiu Liu, Xuanming Liu, Kangfu Mei, Yandong Wen, Ming-HsuanYang, Weiyang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces diagonal distillation for streaming autoregressive video generation, addressing temporal dependency issues that arise when adapting image-specific distillation methods to video. Targets real-time streaming applications.

entry.title: Probing the Reliability of Driving VLMs: From Inconsistent Responses to Grounded Temporal Reasoning

author.name: Chun-Peng Chang, Chen-Yu Wang, Holger Caesar, Alain Pagani

entry.summary: Investigates whether driving VLMs provide temporally grounded reasoning or merely pattern-match, finding that strong visual interpretation doesn't automatically ensure reliable future reasoning for autonomous driving assistants.

entry.title: DiffWind: Physics-Informed Differentiable Modeling of Wind-Driven Object Dynamics

author.name: Yuanhang Lei, Boming Zhao, Zesong Yang, Xingxuan Li, Tao Cheng, Haocheng Peng, Ru Zhang, Yang Yang, Siyuan Huang, Yujun Shen, Ruizhen Hu, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui

entry.summary: DiffWind is a physics-informed differentiable framework for modeling wind-driven object dynamics from video, representing wind as grid-based fields and objects via 3D Gaussian Splatting with Material Point Method interactions.

entry.title: See, Plan, Rewind: Progress-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models for Robust Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Tingjun Dai, Mingfei Han, Tingwen Du, Zhiheng Liu, Zhihui Li, Salman Khan, Jun Yu, Xiaojun Chang

entry.summary: SPR is a progress-aware vision-language-action framework for robotic manipulation that tracks task milestones, plans trajectories toward spatial subgoals, and recovers from failures by monitoring progress.

entry.title: Symbolic Discovery of Stochastic Differential Equations with Genetic Programming

author.name: Sigur de Vries, Sander W. Keemink, Marcel A. J. van Gerven

entry.summary: Introduces a genetic programming method for symbolic discovery of stochastic differential equations, learning both deterministic dynamics and noise functions from observed data for improved modeling and generative sampling.

entry.title: AuditBench: Evaluating Alignment Auditing Techniques on Models with Hidden Behaviors

author.name: abhayesian

entry.summary: Introduces AuditBench, a benchmark of 56 language models with implanted hidden behaviors (sycophancy, opposition to AI regulation, hidden loyalties) that resist direct questioning. Evaluates investigator agent tools for uncovering these hidden behaviors.

entry.title: Logos: An evolvable reasoning engine for rational molecular design

author.name: Haibin Wen, Zhe Zhao, Fanfu Wang, Tianyi Xu, Hao Zhang, Chao Yang, Ye Wei

entry.summary: Logos is a compact molecular reasoning model that integrates multi-step logical reasoning with strict chemical consistency for rational molecular design. Uses staged training combining reasoning examples with chemical validation.

entry.title: Quantifying the Accuracy and Cost Impact of Design Decisions in Budget-Constrained Agentic LLM Search

author.name: Kyle McCleary, James Ghawaly

entry.summary: Presents a controlled measurement study of how search depth, retrieval strategy, and completion budget affect accuracy and cost in budget-constrained agentic RAG systems. Finds accuracy improves with additional searches up to a small cap, and hybrid retrieval with re-ranking produces the best results.

entry.title: Evaluate-as-Action: Self-Evaluated Process Rewards for Retrieval-Augmented Agents

author.name: Jiangming Shu, Yuxiang Zhang, Ye Ma, Xueyuan Lin, Jitao Sang

entry.summary: EvalAct converts implicit retrieval quality assessment into an explicit action in retrieval-augmented agents, with a Search-to-Evaluate protocol. Introduces Process-Calibrated Advantage Rescaling (PCAR) for GRPO-based optimization using process signals.

entry.title: MedMASLab: A Unified Orchestration Framework for Benchmarking Multimodal Medical Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Yunhang Qian, Xiaobin Hu, Jiaquan Yu, Siyang Xin, Xiaokun Chen, Jiangning Zhang, Peng-Tao Jiang, Jiawei Liu, Hongwei Bran Li

entry.summary: MedMASLab provides a unified benchmarking platform for multimodal medical multi-agent systems, standardizing communication protocols across 11 MAS architectures and 24 medical modalities with automated clinical reasoning evaluation.

entry.title: ARKV: Adaptive and Resource-Efficient KV Cache Management under Limited Memory Budget for Long-Context Inference in LLMs

author.name: Jianlong Lei, Shashikant Ilager

entry.summary: ARKV dynamically allocates precision levels to KV cache tokens based on per-layer attention dynamics and token importance, enabling efficient long-context LLM inference under memory constraints.

entry.title: Generalized Reduction to the Isotropy for Flexible Equivariant Neural Fields

author.name: Alejandro Garc\'ia-Castellanos, Gijs Bellaard, Remco Duits, Daniel Pelt, Erik J Bekkers
