entry.summary: Proves that G-invariant functions on product spaces can be reduced to invariants of the isotropy subgroup, establishing orbit equivalence for equivariant neural fields. Extends equivariant neural fields to arbitrary group actions.

entry.title: Beyond Relevance: On the Relationship Between Retrieval and RAG Information Coverage

author.name: Saron Samuel, Alexander Martin, Eugene Yang, Andrew Yates, Dawn Lawrie, Ian Soborof, Laura Dietz, Benjamin Van Durme

entry.summary: Systematically studies the relationship between retrieval quality metrics and downstream RAG generation coverage across two text and one multimodal benchmark. Finds that upstream retrieval metrics may not reliably predict final generation quality, challenging common assumptions in RAG pipeline design.

entry.title: Wrong Code, Right Structure: Learning Netlist Representations from Imperfect LLM-Generated RTL

author.name: Siyang Cai, Cangyuan Li, Yinhe Han, Ying Wang

entry.summary: Makes the key observation that even functionally incorrect LLM-generated RTL code preserves structural patterns useful for circuit analysis, proposing to use imperfect LLM-generated code for netlist representation learning at scale.

entry.title: Beyond Scaling: Assessing Strategic Reasoning and Rapid Decision-Making Capability of LLMs in Zero-sum Environments

author.name: Yang Li, Xing Chen, Yutao Liu, Gege Qi, Yanxian BI, Zizhe Wang, Yunjian Zhang, Yao Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces STAR Benchmark for evaluating LLM strategic reasoning in adversarial, time-sensitive 1v1 zero-sum competitive interactions, testing both turn-based and real-time decision-making.

entry.title: Common Sense vs. Morality: The Curious Case of Narrative Focus Bias in LLMs

author.name: Saugata Purkayastha, Pranav Kushare, Pragya Paramita Pal, Sukannya Purkayastha

entry.summary: Introduces CoMoral benchmark revealing that LLMs prioritize moral reasoning over commonsense understanding, exhibiting narrative focus bias where they attend more to moral aspects than logical contradictions.

entry.title: ActiveUltraFeedback: Efficient Preference Data Generation using Active Learning

author.name: Davit Melikidze, Marian Schneider, Jessica Lam, Martin Wertich, Ido Hakimi, Barna P\'asztor, Andreas Krause

entry.summary: Introduces ActiveUltraFeedback, an active learning pipeline that uses uncertainty estimates to efficiently select the most informative response pairs for RLHF preference annotation, including novel methods DRTS and DeltaUCB.

entry.title: The Coupling Within: Flow Matching via Distilled Normalizing Flows

author.name: David Berthelot, Tianrong Chen, Jiatao Gu, Marco Cuturi, Laurent Dinh, Bhavik Chandna, Michal Klein, Josh Susskind, Shuangfei Zhai

entry.summary: Proposes using distilled normalizing flows as coupling measures for flow matching training, shifting from computing adaptive couplings directly to using pretrained models to define noise-data pairings.

entry.title: Learning Adaptive LLM Decoding

author.name: Chloe H. Su, Zhe Ye, Samuel Tenka, Aidan Yang, Soonho Kong, Udaya Ghai

entry.summary: Proposes learning adaptive LLM decoding policies that dynamically select sampling strategies (greedy, top-k, min-p) at inference time using lightweight RL-trained adapters, conditioned on compute budget.

entry.title: An Optimal Control Approach To Transformer Training

author.name: Ka\u{g}an Akman, Naci Sald{\i}, Serdar Y\"uksel

entry.summary: Develops a rigorous optimal control theory framework for Transformer training, modeling the architecture as a discrete-time controlled particle system with McKean-Vlasov dynamics. Establishes existence of optimal training policies via dynamic programming and derives Bellman equations.

entry.title: CarbonBench: A Global Benchmark for Upscaling of Carbon Fluxes Using Zero-Shot Learning

author.name: Aleksei Rozanov, Arvind Renganathan, Yimeng Zhang, Vipin Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces CarbonBench, the first benchmark for zero-shot spatial transfer in carbon flux upscaling with 1.3M daily observations from 567 flux towers. Provides stratified evaluation protocols and shows current models fail to generalize across ecosystems.

entry.title: What is Missing? Explaining Neurons Activated by Absent Concepts

author.name: Robin Hesse, Simone Schaub-Meyer, Janina Hesse, Bernt Schiele, Stefan Roth

entry.summary: Introduces a method for explaining neurons activated by the absence of concepts, addressing a largely overlooked type of causal relationship in neural networks where missing features drive activations.

entry.title: ConFu: Contemplate the Future for Better Speculative Sampling

author.name: Zongyue Qin, Raghavv Goel, Mukul Gagrani, Risheek Garrepalli, Mingu Lee, Yizhou Sun

entry.summary: Proposes ConFu for speculative decoding, enabling draft models to anticipate future generation direction to reduce error accumulation. Addresses the drift problem in multi-step speculative sampling.

entry.title: LLM as a Meta-Judge: Synthetic Data for NLP Evaluation Metric Validation

author.name: Luk\'a\v{s} Eigler, Jind\v{r}ich Libovick\'y, David Hurych

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs as meta-judges to generate synthetic evaluation datasets via controlled semantic degradation, replacing expensive human annotations for NLG metric validation. Achieves meta-correlations exceeding 0.9 across MT, QA, and summarization, enabling scalable multilingual evaluation.

entry.title: CREATE: Testing LLMs for Associative Creativity

author.name: Manya Wadhwa, Tiasa Singha Roy, Harvey Lederman, Junyi Jessy Li, Greg Durrett

entry.summary: Introduces CREATE, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' associative creativity by requiring models to generate diverse, specific paths connecting concepts. Tests whether models can make novel yet meaningful connections between knowledge concepts.

entry.title: HECTOR: Hybrid Editable Compositional Object References for Video Generation

author.name: Guofeng Zhang, Angtian Wang, Jacob Zhiyuan Fang, Liming Jiang, Haotian Yang, Alan Yuille, Chongyang Ma

entry.summary: Proposes HECTOR for compositional video generation with hybrid reference conditioning, allowing simultaneous guidance from static images and dynamic videos with explicit trajectory control for each element.

entry.title: Rotation Equivariant Mamba for Vision Tasks

author.name: Zhongchen Zhao, Qi Xie, Keyu Huang, Lei Zhang, Deyu Meng, Zongben Xu

entry.summary: Proposes EQ-VMamba, the first rotation equivariant visual Mamba architecture that incorporates rotation symmetry into state space models for vision tasks.

entry.title: Point Cloud as a Foreign Language for Multi-modal Large Language Model

author.name: Sneha Paul, Zachary Patterson, Nizar Bouguila

entry.summary: Presents SAGE, the first end-to-end 3D MLLM that directly processes raw point clouds without a pre-trained 3D encoder, using a lightweight 3D tokenizer with vector quantization.

entry.title: Prune Redundancy, Preserve Essence: Vision Token Compression in VLMs via Synergistic Importance-Diversity

author.name: Zhengyao Fang, Pengyuan Lyu, Chengquan Zhang, Guangming Lu, Jun Yu, Wenjie Pei

entry.summary: PruneSID proposes a training-free visual token compression method for VLMs using clustering-based semantic grouping followed by intra-group non-maximum suppression to prune redundant tokens while preserving diversity.

entry.title: Physics-Driven 3D Gaussian Rendering for Zero-Shot MRI Super-Resolution

author.name: Shuting Liu, Lei Zhang, Wei Huang, Zhao Zhang, Zizhou Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a zero-shot MRI super-resolution framework using 3D Gaussian representation with physics-grounded rendering, embedding tissue physical properties into Gaussian parameters to balance data efficiency and computational cost.

entry.title: ReCoSplat: Autoregressive Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting Using Render-and-Compare

author.name: Freeman Cheng, Botao Ye, Xueting Li, Junqi You, Fangneng Zhan, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: ReCoSplat is an autoregressive feed-forward Gaussian Splatting model for online novel view synthesis, introducing a Render-and-Compare module to bridge training-inference distribution mismatch for pose estimation.

entry.title: TiPToP: A Modular Open-Vocabulary Planning System for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: William Shen, Nishanth Kumar, Sahit Chintalapudi, Jie Wang, Christopher Watson, Edward Hu, Jing Cao, Dinesh Jayaraman, Leslie Pack Kaelbling, Tom\'as Lozano-P\'erez

entry.summary: Presents TiPToP, a modular system combining vision foundation models with Task and Motion Planning that solves 28 tabletop manipulation tasks with zero robot data. Matches or outperforms π₀.₅-DROID (trained on 350 hours of demos) with a system installable in under one hour.

entry.title: [Paper] When can we trust untrusted monitoring? A safety case sketch across collusion strategies

author.name: Nelson Gardner-Challis

entry.summary: Deep dive into untrusted monitoring safety cases, exploring novel collusion strategies and finding that naive self-recognition via SFT triples red team win rates. Develops a safety case sketch and identifies five important open problems for untrusted monitoring deployment.

entry.title: MEMO: Memory-Augmented Model Context Optimization for Robust Multi-Turn Multi-Agent LLM Games

author.name: Yunfei Xie, Kevin Wang, Bobby Cheng, Jianzhu Yao, Zhizhou Sha, Alexander Duffy, Yihan Xi, Hongyuan Mei, Cheston Tan, Chen Wei, Pramod Viswanath, Zhangyang Wang

entry.summary: MEMO addresses the high run-to-run variance in multi-turn, multi-agent LLM game evaluations through a memory-augmented self-play framework that combines retention (persistent memory bank) and exploration to optimize inference-time context.

entry.title: Real-Time Trust Verification for Safe Agentic Actions using TrustBench

author.name: Tavishi Sharma, Vinayak Sharma, Pragya Sharma

entry.summary: TrustBench is a dual-mode framework for real-time trust verification of agentic AI actions, providing both benchmarking and a toolkit that agents invoke before taking actions to verify safety and reliability. Shifts from post-hoc evaluation to real-time intervention.

entry.title: GenePlan: Evolving Better Generalized PDDL Plans using Large Language Models

author.name: Andrew Murray, Danial Dervovic, Alberto Pozanco, Michael Cashmore

entry.summary: GenePlan uses LLM-assisted evolutionary algorithms to generate domain-dependent generalized planners for classical PDDL planning tasks. Achieves 0.91 SAT score vs 0.93 for state-of-the-art planners, significantly outperforming other LLM baselines.

entry.title: Does the Question Really Matter? Training-Free Data Selection for Vision-Language SFT

author.name: Peng Sun, Huawen Shen, Yi Ban, Tianfan Fu, Yanbo Wang, Yuqiang Li

entry.summary: CVS is a training-free data selection method for vision-language SFT based on the insight that high-quality multimodal samples should show the question substantially altering answer validity assessment. Uses a frozen VLLM as evaluator.

entry.title: World2Mind: Cognition Toolkit for Allocentric Spatial Reasoning in Foundation Models

author.name: Shouwei Ruan, Bin Wang, Zhenyu Wu, Qihui Zhu, Yuxiang Zhang, Hang Su, Yubin Wang

entry.summary: World2Mind is a training-free spatial reasoning toolkit that uses 3D reconstruction and instance segmentation to construct spatial cognitive maps, empowering multimodal foundation models with allocentric spatial reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: SiliconMind-V1: Multi-Agent Distillation and Debug-Reasoning Workflows for Verilog Code Generation

author.name: Mu-Chi Chen, Yu-Hung Kao, Po-Hsuan Huang, Shao-Chun Ho, Hsiang-Yu Tsou, I-Ting Wu, En-Ming Huang, Yu-Kai Hung, Wei-Po Hsin, Cheng Liang, Chia-Heng Tu, Shih-Hao Hung, Hsiang-Tsung Kung

entry.summary: SiliconMind-V1 proposes a multi-agent framework for Verilog code generation with integrated testbench-driven verification, enabling locally fine-tuned LLMs to iteratively generate, test, and debug RTL designs without commercial model dependence.

entry.title: Test-Driven AI Agent Definition (TDAD): Compiling Tool-Using Agents from Behavioral Specifications

author.name: Tzafrir Rehan

entry.summary: TDAD treats agent prompts as compiled artifacts - behavioral specifications are converted to tests by one coding agent, then another iteratively refines prompts until tests pass. Includes hidden test splits and semantic mutation testing to prevent specification gaming.

entry.title: GST-VLA: Structured Gaussian Spatial Tokens for 3D Depth-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Md Selim Sarowar, Omer Tariq, Sungho Kim

entry.summary: Introduces GST-VLA, which converts depth and semantic features into 3D Gaussian primitives for Vision-Language-Action models, encoding local surface orientation and geometric confidence for robot manipulation.

entry.title: Latent World Models for Automated Driving: A Unified Taxonomy, Evaluation Framework, and Open Challenges

author.name: Rongxiang Zeng, Yongqi Dong

entry.summary: Proposes a unifying latent-space framework that synthesizes recent progress in world models for automated driving, organizing design space by target and form of latent representations.

entry.title: Democratising Clinical AI through Dataset Condensation for Classical Clinical Models

author.name: Anshul Thakur, Soheila Molaei, Pafue Christy Nganjimi, Joshua Fieggen, Andrew A. S. Soltan, Danielle Belgrave, Lei Clifton, David A. Clifton

entry.summary: Extends dataset condensation to non-differentiable clinical models (decision trees, Cox regression) using differentially private zero-order optimization, enabling safe synthetic data sharing for healthcare.

entry.title: From Flow to One Step: Real-Time Multi-Modal Trajectory Policies via Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation-based Distribution Distillation

author.name: Ju Dong, Liding Zhang, Lei Zhang, Yu Fu, Kaixin Bai, Zoltan-Csaba Marton, Zhenshan Bing, Zhaopeng Chen, Alois Christian Knoll, Jianwei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes distilling Conditional Flow Matching experts into single-step students via IMLE for real-time multi-modal robot trajectory policies, avoiding distributional collapse that plagues other acceleration methods.

entry.title: Open-World Motion Forecasting

author.name: Nicolas Schischka, Nikhil Gosala, B Ravi Kiran, Senthil Yogamani, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Introduces open-world motion forecasting where new object classes are sequentially introduced and trajectories estimated from camera images, proposing the first end-to-end class-incremental motion forecasting approach.

entry.title: A Variational Latent Equilibrium for Learning in Cortex

author.name: Simon Brandt, Paul Haider, Walter Senn, Federico Benitez, Mihai A. Petrovici

entry.summary: Proposes a biologically plausible alternative to backpropagation through time (BPTT) based on variational latent equilibrium principles, unifying several previous approaches to local, time-continuous spatiotemporal credit assignment using energy conservation.

entry.title: MAPLE: Elevating Medical Reasoning from Statistical Consensus to Process-Led Alignment

author.name: Kailong Fan, Anqi Pu, Yichen Wu, Wanhua Li, Yicong Li, Hanspeter Pfister, Huafeng Liu, Xiang Li, Quanzheng Li, Ning Guo

entry.summary: Proposes MAPLE, integrating medical process reward models with test-time reinforcement learning to improve medical reasoning in LLMs, replacing unreliable majority voting supervision with expert-aligned process rewards.

entry.title: SCALAR: Learning and Composing Skills through LLM Guided Symbolic Planning and Deep RL Grounding

author.name: Renos Zabounidis, Yue Wu, Simon Stepputtis, Woojun Kim, Yuanzhi Li, Tom Mitchell, Katia Sycara

entry.summary: Introduces SCALAR, a framework coupling LLM planning with RL where the LLM proposes skills with preconditions/effects, RL trains policies, and execution feedback refines specifications through Pivotal Trajectory Analysis.

entry.title: Memorization capacity of deep ReLU neural networks characterized by width and depth

author.name: Xin Yang, Yunfei Yang

entry.summary: Characterizes the memorization capacity of deep ReLU networks in terms of width W and depth L, proving that W²L² = O(N log(δ⁻¹)) is both sufficient and necessary (up to log factors) to memorize N data points with separation distance δ.

entry.title: OptEMA: Adaptive Exponential Moving Average for Stochastic Optimization with Zero-Noise Optimality

author.name: Ganzhao Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces OptEMA, adaptive EMA variants for Adam-style optimizers that achieve optimal convergence in zero-noise regimes without requiring bounded gradient assumptions, prior knowledge of Lipschitz constants, or external schedulers.

entry.title: FlexServe: A Fast and Secure LLM Serving System for Mobile Devices with Flexible Resource Isolation

author.name: Yinpeng Wu, Yitong Chen, Lixiang Wang, Jinyu Gu, Zhichao Hua, Yubin Xia

entry.summary: Introduces FlexServe, a secure LLM serving system for mobile devices using ARM TrustZone with flexible resource isolation to protect model weights and user data from OS-level attacks while maintaining inference speed.

entry.title: From Semantics to Pixels: Coarse-to-Fine Masked Autoencoders for Hierarchical Visual Understanding

author.name: Wenzhao Xiang, Yue Wu, Hongyang Yu, Feng Gao, Fan Yang, Xilin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes C2FMAE, a coarse-to-fine masked autoencoder learning hierarchical visual representations across semantic, instance, and pixel granularities. Resolves the tension between contrastive learning's global semantics and MIM's local textures.

entry.title: Diagnosing and Repairing Citation Failures in Generative Engine Optimization

author.name: Zhihua Tian, Yuhan Chen, Yao Tang, Jian Liu, Ruoxi Jia

entry.summary: Introduces a diagnostic approach to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) that identifies why documents fail to be cited in AI-generated responses. Develops AgentGEO, an agentic system that diagnoses failures and applies targeted interventions.

entry.title: X-GS: An Extensible Open Framework Unifying 3DGS Architectures with Downstream Multimodal Models

author.name: Yueen Ma, Irwin King

entry.summary: Introduces X-GS, an extensible framework unifying 3D Gaussian Splatting techniques for real-time online SLAM with semantic enrichment, bridging to downstream multimodal models from unposed RGB video streams.

entry.title: TIDE: Text-Informed Dynamic Extrapolation with Step-Aware Temperature Control for Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Yihua Liu, Fanjiang Ye, Bowen Lin, Rongyu Fang, Chengming Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TIDE, a training-free method for enabling Diffusion Transformers to generate images at arbitrary resolutions beyond training resolution. Introduces text anchoring to correct prompt information loss and step-aware temperature control.

entry.title: Chain of Event-Centric Causal Thought for Physically Plausible Video Generation

author.name: Zixuan Wang, Yixin Hu, Haolan Wang, Feng Chen, Yan Liu, Wen Li, Yinjie Lei

entry.summary: Proposes chain of event-centric causal thought for physically plausible video generation, modeling physical phenomena as sequences of causally connected events with physics-driven reasoning.

entry.title: Learning Convex Decomposition via Feature Fields

author.name: Yuezhi Yang, Qixing Huang, Mikaela Angelina Uy, Nicholas Sharp

entry.summary: Proposes learning convex decomposition through continuous feature fields that can be clustered for decomposition, enabling the first feed-forward model for open-world convex decomposition.

entry.title: OddGridBench: Exposing the Lack of Fine-Grained Visual Discrepancy Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Tengjin Weng, Wenhao Jiang, Jingyi Wang, Ming Li, Lin Ma, Zhong Ming

entry.summary: Introduces OddGridBench, a benchmark with 1,400+ grid-based images testing MLLMs' ability to detect fine-grained visual discrepancies in color, size, rotation, or position. Reveals significant weaknesses across all tested models including proprietary ones.

entry.title: TopoOR: A Unified Topological Scene Representation for the Operating Room

author.name: Tony Danjun Wang, Ka Young Kim, Tolga Birdal, Nassir Navab, Lennart Bastian

entry.summary: TopoOR introduces higher-order topological structures (beyond pairwise graphs) for modeling operating room scenes, lifting surgical scene graphs into topological cells that preserve complex multi-entity relationships.

entry.title: OmniEarth: A Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language Models in Geospatial Tasks

author.name: Ronghao Fu, Haoran Liu, Weijie Zhang, Zhiwen Lin, Xiao Yang, Peng Zhang, Bo Yang

entry.summary: OmniEarth is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating vision-language models in remote sensing, organizing 28 tasks along perception, reasoning, and robustness dimensions across multi-source sensing data.

entry.title: VarSplat: Uncertainty-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting for Robust RGB-D SLAM

author.name: Anh Thuan Tran, Jana Kosecka

entry.summary: VarSplat introduces uncertainty-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM that learns per-splat appearance variance and renders per-pixel uncertainty maps to guide tracking and submap registration.

entry.title: Let's Reward Step-by-Step: Step-Aware Contrastive Alignment for Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments

author.name: Haoyuan Li, Rui Liu, Hehe Fan, Yi Yang

entry.summary: Introduces step-aware contrastive alignment for VLN in continuous environments, addressing sparse reward issues in RL fine-tuning by providing per-step credit assignment instead of binary outcome feedback.

entry.title: CycleULM: A unified label-free deep learning framework for ultrasound localisation microscopy

author.name: Su Yan, Clara Rodrigo Gonzalez, Vincent C. H. Leung, Herman Verinaz-Jadan, Jiakang Chen, Matthieu Toulemonde, Kai Riemer, Jipeng Yan, Clotilde Vi\'e, Qingyuan Tan, Peter D. Weinberg, Pier Luigi Dragotti, Kevin G. Murphy, Meng-Xing Tang

entry.summary: CycleULM is the first unified label-free deep learning framework for ultrasound localization microscopy, using CycleGAN to bridge the simulation-to-reality domain gap without requiring in vivo labels.

entry.title: Time, Identity and Consciousness in Language Model Agents

author.name: Elija Perrier, Michael Timothy Bennett

entry.summary: Applies Stack Theory's temporal gap concept to evaluate whether language model agents exhibit genuine temporal persistence of identity versus merely passing behavioral tests. Introduces persistence scores computed from scaffold traces and maps common scaffolds into an identity-space taxonomy.

entry.title: PrivPRISM: Automatically Detecting Discrepancies Between Google Play Data Safety Declarations and Developer Privacy Policies

author.name: Bhanuka Silva, Dishanika Denipitiyage, Anirban Mahanti, Aruna Seneviratne, Suranga Seneviratne

entry.summary: PrivPRISM automatically detects discrepancies between Google Play data safety declarations and developer privacy policies using encoder-decoder LMs. Finds discrepancies in 53% of 7,770 popular mobile games, rising to 61% among top games.

entry.title: The Confidence Gate Theorem: When Should Ranked Decision Systems Abstain?

author.name: Ronald Doku

entry.summary: The Confidence Gate Theorem establishes formal conditions (rank-alignment, no inversion zones) under which confidence-based abstention improves ranked decision systems. Distinguishes structural uncertainty from contextual uncertainty across three domains.

entry.title: CktEvo: Repository-Level RTL Code Benchmark for Design Evolution

author.name: Zhengyuan Shi, Jingxin Wang, Tairan Cheng, Changran Xu, Weikang Qian, Qiang Xu

entry.summary: CktEvo is a benchmark for repository-level RTL code evolution, addressing cross-file dependencies and PPA optimization in hardware design. Unlike isolated snippet benchmarks, focuses on realistic iterative design processes.

entry.title: Turn: A Language for Agentic Computation

author.name: Muyukani Kizito

entry.summary: Turn is a new compiled, actor-based programming language designed specifically for agentic AI programs. Introduces language-level constructs for cognitive type safety, bounded context, credential isolation, and durable state.

entry.title: Quantifying Uncertainty in AI Visibility: A Statistical Framework for Generative Search Measurement

author.name: Ronald Sielinski

entry.summary: Argues that citation visibility metrics in AI search engines should be treated as sample estimators rather than fixed values, conducting empirical study across Perplexity, SearchGPT, and Gemini showing significant citation variability.

entry.title: Automated Tensor-Relational Decomposition for Large-Scale Sparse Tensor Computation

author.name: Yuxin Tang, Zhiyuan Xin, Zhimin Ding, Xinyu Yao, Daniel Bourgeois, Tirthak Patel, Chris Jermaine

entry.summary: Introduces upper-case-lower-case EinSum, a tensor-relational formulation that automatically decomposes large sparse tensor computations into relational operations, enabling execution on relational systems with high sparsity handling.

entry.title: Emotion is Not Just a Label: Latent Emotional Factors in LLM Processing

author.name: Benjamin Reichman, Adar Avasian, Samuel Webster, Larry Heck

entry.summary: Studies how emotional tone systematically alters attention geometry in transformers, showing metrics like locality and entropy vary across emotions and correlate with QA performance.

entry.title: TaSR-RAG: Taxonomy-guided Structured Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Jiashuo Sun, Yixuan Xie, Jimeng Shi, Shaowen Wang, Jiawei Han

entry.summary: Proposes TaSR-RAG, a taxonomy-guided structured reasoning framework for RAG that represents queries and documents as relational triples, improving multi-hop reasoning over unstructured retrieval approaches.

entry.title: EvoDriveVLA: Evolving Autonomous Driving Vision-Language-Action Model via Collaborative Perception-Planning Distillation

author.name: Jiajun Cao, Xiaoan Zhang, Xiaobao Wei, Liyuqiu Huang, Wang Zijian, Hanzhen Zhang, Zhengyu Jia, Wei Mao, Hao Wang, Xianming Liu, Shuchang Zhou Liu, Yang Wang, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes EvoDriveVLA, a collaborative perception-planning distillation framework for autonomous driving VLA models that uses self-anchored visual distillation and oracle-guided trajectory optimization.

entry.title: No Image, No Problem: End-to-End Multi-Task Cardiac Analysis from Undersampled k-Space

author.name: Yundi Zhang, Sevgi Gokce Kafali, Niklas Bubeck, Daniel Rueckert, Jiazhen Pan

entry.summary: Proposes k-MTR, a framework that performs cardiac analysis directly from undersampled k-space MRI data, bypassing the traditional reconstruct-then-analyze pipeline by aligning k-space data and images into a shared semantic manifold.

entry.title: SoftJAX & SoftTorch: Empowering Automatic Differentiation Libraries with Informative Gradients

author.name: Anselm Paulus, A. Ren\'e Geist, V\'it Musil, Sebastian Hoffmann, Onur Beker, Georg Martius

entry.summary: Introduces SoftJAX and SoftTorch, open-source libraries providing drop-in differentiable replacements for hard primitives (thresholding, Boolean logic, sorting) in JAX and PyTorch.

entry.title: Overcoming Valid Action Suppression in Unmasked Policy Gradient Algorithms

author.name: Renos Zabounidis, Roy Siegelmann, Mohamad Qadri, Woojun Kim, Simon Stepputtis, Katia P. Sycara

entry.summary: Proves that in RL with state-dependent action validity, unmasked training systematically suppresses valid actions at unvisited states because gradients from invalid action penalties propagate through shared parameters.

entry.title: Towards Understanding Adam Convergence on Highly Degenerate Polynomials

author.name: Zhiwei Bai, Jiajie Zhao, Zhangchen Zhou, Zhi-Qin John Xu, Yaoyu Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies a class of highly degenerate polynomials where Adam optimizer converges automatically without external schedulers, achieving local linear convergence. Shows Adam significantly outperforms SGD on these functions, providing theoretical conditions for stability.

entry.title: Vision-Language Models Encode Clinical Guidelines for Concept-Based Medical Reasoning

author.name: Mohamed Harmanani, Bining Long, Zhuoxin Guo, Paul F. R. Wilson, Amirhossein Sabour, Minh Nguyen Nhat To, Gabor Fichtinger, Purang Abolmaesumi, Parvin Mousavi

entry.summary: Proposes MedCBR, a concept-based reasoning framework integrating clinical guidelines with vision-language models for medical imaging. Uses clinical guidelines to enhance Concept Bottleneck Models beyond discrete concept representations.

entry.title: Statistical Inference via Generative Models: Flow Matching and Causal Inference

author.name: Shinto Eguchi

entry.summary: A book/monograph reinterpreting generative AI through statistical lenses, using flow matching as a central example. Connects generative models to missing data imputation, counterfactual analysis, and causal inference.

entry.title: Quality over Quantity: Demonstration Curation via Influence Functions for Data-Centric Robot Learning

author.name: Haeone Lee, Taywon Min, Junsu Kim, Sinjae Kang, Fangchen Liu, Lerrel Pinto, Kimin Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Quality over Quantity (QoQ) for robot learning demonstration curation using influence functions to systematically identify high-quality training samples, moving beyond manual/heuristic curation.

entry.title: SCDP: Learning Humanoid Locomotion from Partial Observations via Mixed-Observation Distillation

author.name: Milo Carroll, Tianhu Peng, Lingfan Bao, Chengxu Zhou, Zhibin Li

entry.summary: Presents Sensor-Conditioned Diffusion Policies (SCDP) for humanoid locomotion using only onboard sensors, eliminating explicit state estimation through mixed-observation training with diffusion models.

entry.title: Learning When to Sample: Confidence-Aware Self-Consistency for Efficient LLM Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

author.name: Juming Xiong, Kevin Guo, Congning Ni, Chao Yan, Katherine Brown, Avinash Baidya, Xiang Gao, Bradley Marlin, Zhijun Yin

entry.summary: Proposes a confidence-aware framework that analyzes a single reasoning trajectory to decide between single-path and multi-path chain-of-thought reasoning, reducing unnecessary computational overhead.

entry.title: Understanding the Interplay between LLMs' Utilisation of Parametric and Contextual Knowledge: A keynote at ECIR 2025

author.name: Isabelle Augenstein

entry.summary: Keynote paper from ECIR 2025 by Isabelle Augenstein exploring how LLMs balance parametric knowledge (from training) versus contextual knowledge (from prompts), including conflicts between the two and knowledge updating challenges.

entry.title: One-Eval: An Agentic System for Automated and Traceable LLM Evaluation

author.name: Chengyu Shen, Yanheng Hou, Minghui Pan, Runming He, Zhen Hao Wong, Meiyi Qiang, Zhou Liu, Hao Liang, Peichao Lai, Zeang Sheng, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: Presents One-Eval, an agentic system that converts natural-language evaluation requests into executable, traceable LLM evaluation workflows. Integrates benchmark planning, dataset acquisition, schema normalization, and metrics computation.

entry.title: CyberThreat-Eval: Can Large Language Models Automate Real-World Threat Research?

author.name: Xiangsen Chen, Xuan Feng, Shuo Chen, Matthieu Maitre, Sudipto Rakshit, Diana Duvieilh, Ashley Picone, Nan Tang

entry.summary: Introduces CyberThreat-Eval, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on real-world cyber threat intelligence workflows across triage, deep search, and TI drafting stages. Addresses limitations of existing benchmarks that use unrealistic formats like MCQs.

entry.title: Towards Visual Query Segmentation in the Wild

author.name: Bing Fan, Minghao Li, Hanzhi Zhang, Shaohua Dong, Naga Prudhvi Mareedu, Weishi Shi, Yunhe Feng, Yan Huang, Heng Fan

entry.summary: Introduces Visual Query Segmentation (VQS), extending visual query localization to pixel-level segmentation of all object occurrences in untrimmed video. Provides VQS-4K benchmark with 4,111 videos and 1.3M+ frames.

entry.title: TubeMLLM: A Foundation Model for Topology Knowledge Exploration in Vessel-like Anatomy

author.name: Yaoyu Liu, Minghui Zhang, Xin You, Hanxiao Zhang, Yun Gu

entry.summary: Proposes TubeMLLM, a foundation model for medical vessel-like anatomy that integrates topological priors through natural language prompting for unified understanding and generation of vascular structures.

entry.title: RAE-NWM: Navigation World Model in Dense Visual Representation Space

author.name: Mingkun Zhang, Wangtian Shen, Fan Zhang, Haijian Qin, Zihao Pei, Ziyang Meng

entry.summary: Proposes RAE-NWM, a navigation world model operating in dense DINOv2 feature space rather than compressed VAE latent space. Shows DINOv2 features exhibit stronger linear predictability for action-conditioned transitions.

entry.title: Towards Instance Segmentation with Polygon Detection Transformers

author.name: Jiacheng Sun, Jiaqi Lin, Wenlong Hu, Haoyang Li, Xinghong Zhou, Chenghai Mao, Yan Peng, Xiaomao Li

entry.summary: Presents Poly-DETR, reformulating instance segmentation as sparse vertex regression via Polar Representation, eliminating reliance on dense pixel-wise mask prediction. Achieves 4.7 mAP improvement over prior polar-based methods.

entry.title: Implicit Geometry Representations for Vision-and-Language Navigation from Web Videos

author.name: Mingfei Han, Haihong Hao, Liang Ma, Kamila Zhumakhanova, Ekaterina Radionova, Jingyi Zhang, Xiaojun Chang, Xiaodan Liang, Ivan Laptev

entry.summary: Introduces a large-scale framework for Vision-and-Language Navigation using web room tour videos, incorporating implicit geometry representations for spatial understanding beyond simulator-curated datasets.

entry.title: YOLO-NAS-Bench: A Surrogate Benchmark with Self-Evolving Predictors for YOLO Architecture Search

author.name: Zhe Li, Xiaoyu Ding, Jiaxin Zheng, Yongtao Wang

entry.summary: YOLO-NAS-Bench is the first surrogate benchmark specifically designed for neural architecture search of YOLO-style object detectors, covering architectures from YOLOv8 through YOLO12. It includes 1,000 sampled architectures trained on COCO-mini with self-evolving predictors.

entry.title: RESBev: Making BEV Perception More Robust

author.name: Lifeng Zhuo, Kefan Jin, Zhe Liu, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: RESBev proposes a plug-and-play method to enhance BEV perception robustness against sensor degradation and adversarial attacks using a latent world model for spatiotemporal prediction.

entry.title: FetalAgents: A Multi-Agent System for Fetal Ultrasound Image and Video Analysis

author.name: Xiaotian Hu, Junwei Huang, Mingxuan Liu, Kasidit Anmahapong, Yifei Chen, Yitong Luo, Yiming Huang, Xuguang Bai, Zihan Li, Yi Liao, Haibo Qu, Qiyuan Tian

entry.summary: FetalAgents is the first multi-agent system for comprehensive fetal ultrasound analysis, orchestrating specialized vision experts for diagnosis, measurement, and segmentation through a lightweight agentic framework.

entry.title: Stepping VLMs onto the Court: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence in Sports

author.name: Yuchen Yang, Yuqing Shao, Duxiu Huang, Linfeng Dong, Yifei Liu, Suixin Tang, Xiang Zhou, Yuanyuan Gao, Wei Wang, Yue Zhou, Xue Yang, Yanfeng Wang, Xiao Sun, Zhihang Zhong

entry.summary: CourtSI is the first large-scale spatial intelligence benchmark for sports VLMs with 1M+ QA pairs covering spatial counting, measurement, localization and reasoning in net sports using court geometry as metric anchors.

entry.title: Robust Regularized Policy Iteration under Transition Uncertainty

author.name: Hongqiang Lin, Zhenghui Fu, Weihao Tang, Pengfei Wang, Yiding Sun, Qixian Huang, Dongxu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Robust Regularized Policy Iteration (RRPI) for offline RL that treats the transition kernel as a decision variable within an uncertainty set, replacing intractable max-min bilevel objectives with tractable KL-regularized surrogates.

entry.title: Multi-level meta-reinforcement learning with skill-based curriculum

author.name: Sichen Yang (Johns Hopkins University), Mauro Maggioni (Johns Hopkins University)

entry.summary: Describes multi-level meta-reinforcement learning that compresses MDPs hierarchically, treating parametric policy families at one level as single actions at higher levels, with a skill-based curriculum.

entry.title: Scale-Plan: Scalable Language-Enabled Task Planning for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Teams

author.name: Piyush Gupta, Sangjae Bae, Jiachen Li, David Isele

entry.summary: Scale-Plan is a scalable LLM-assisted framework for multi-robot task planning that generates compact, task-relevant problem representations to reduce hallucinations and improve grounding in object-rich environments.

entry.title: Quantifying Memorization and Privacy Risks in Genomic Language Models

author.name: Alexander Nemecek, Wenbiao Li, Xiaoqian Jiang, Jaideep Vaidya, Erman Ayday

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates memorization and privacy risks in genomic language models, addressing concerns about data leakage and individual identifiability when models are trained on sensitive genomic data.

entry.title: More than the Sum: Panorama-Language Models for Adverse Omni-Scenes

author.name: Weijia Fan, Ruiping Liu, Jiale Wei, Yufan Chen, Junwei Zheng, Zichao Zeng, Jiaming Zhang, Qiufu Li, Linlin Shen, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: Introduces the Panorama-Language Modeling paradigm for 360° vision-language reasoning, along with PanoVQA dataset for adverse omni-scenes, arguing that holistic panoramic understanding exceeds the sum of pinhole views.

entry.title: ConfCtrl: Enabling Precise Camera Control in Video Diffusion via Confidence-Aware Interpolation

author.name: Liudi Yang, George Eskandar, Fengyi Shen, Mohammad Altillawi, Yang Bai, Chi Zhang, Ziyuan Liu, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: ConfCtrl proposes confidence-aware video interpolation for novel view synthesis under large viewpoint changes, using confidence-weighted point cloud projections and Kalman-inspired predict-update mechanisms.

entry.title: SurgCalib: Gaussian Splatting-Based Hand-Eye Calibration for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery

author.name: Zijian Wu, Shuojue Yang, Yu Chung Lee, Eitan Prisman, Yueming Jin, Septimiu E. Salcudean

entry.summary: SurgCalib uses Gaussian Splatting for hand-eye calibration of the da Vinci surgical robot without fiducial markers, addressing cable-driven robot proprioceptive inaccuracies while maintaining operating room sterility.

entry.title: AgentOS: From Application Silos to a Natural Language-Driven Data Ecosystem

author.name: Rui Liu, Tao Zhe, Dongjie Wang, Zijun Yao, Kunpeng Liu, Yanjie Fu, Huan Liu, Jian Pei

entry.summary: Proposes AgentOS, a paradigm shift from GUI/CLI-based operating systems to an agent-native OS built around natural language-driven data ecosystems. Argues current agents running on legacy OSes face fragmented interaction, poor permission management, and context fragmentation.

entry.title: AI Act Evaluation Benchmark: An Open, Transparent, and Reproducible Evaluation Dataset for NLP and RAG Systems

author.name: Athanasios Davvetas, Michael Papademas, Xenia Ziouvelou, Vangelis Karkaletsis

entry.summary: Creates an open evaluation benchmark dataset for assessing NLP and RAG system compliance with the EU AI Act, providing a transparent and reproducible method for evaluating regulatory compliance.

entry.title: Influencing LLM Multi-Agent Dialogue via Policy-Parameterized Prompts

author.name: Hongbo Bo, Jingyu Hu, Weiru Liu

entry.summary: Investigates whether prompt-as-action can be parameterized to construct lightweight policies for influencing multi-agent LLM dialogue behavior without training. Dynamically constructs prompts through five components based on agent state.

entry.title: PathMem: Toward Cognition-Aligned Memory Transformation for Pathology MLLMs

author.name: Jinyue Li, Yuci Liang, Qiankun Li, Xinheng Lyu, Jiayu Qian, Huabao Chen, Kun Wang, Zhigang Zeng, Anil Anthony Bharath, Yang Liu

entry.summary: PathMem is a memory-centric multimodal framework for computational pathology inspired by hierarchical memory processes of human pathologists. Integrates structured domain knowledge including taxonomy, grading criteria, and clinical evidence.

entry.title: Diagnosing FP4 inference: a layer-wise and block-wise sensitivity analysis of NVFP4 and MXFP4

author.name: Musa Cim, Burak Topcu, Mahmut Taylan Kandemir

entry.summary: Layer-wise and block-wise sensitivity analysis comparing NVFP4 and MXFP4 quantization formats across LLMs. Identifies which layers and blocks are most sensitive to 4-bit quantization.

entry.title: NetDiffuser: Deceiving DNN-Based Network Attack Detection Systems with Diffusion-Generated Adversarial Traffic

author.name: Pratyay Kumar, Abu Saleh Md Tayeen, Satyajayant Misra, Huiping Cao, Jiefei Liu, Qixu Gong, Jayashree Harikumar

entry.summary: Proposes NetDiffuser, a framework using diffusion models to generate natural adversarial examples that can deceive deep learning-based network intrusion detection systems. Creates realistic-looking malicious traffic that evades detection.

entry.title: Uncovering a Winning Lottery Ticket with Continuously Relaxed Bernoulli Gates

author.name: Itamar Tsayag, Ofir Lindenbaum

entry.summary: Proposes using continuously relaxed Bernoulli gates to discover Strong Lottery Tickets through fully differentiable end-to-end optimization, keeping all network weights frozen while training only gating parameters.

entry.title: A Text-Native Interface for Generative Video Authoring

author.name: Xingyu Bruce Liu, Mira Dontcheva, Dingzeyu Li

entry.summary: Introduces Doki, a text-native interface for generative video authoring where writing text is the primary interaction for defining assets, structuring scenes, and creating shots within a single document.

entry.title: VIVID-Med: LLM-Supervised Structured Pretraining for Deployable Medical ViTs

author.name: Xiyao Wang, Xiaoyu Tan, Yang Dai, Yuxuan Fu, Shuo Li, Xihe Qiu

entry.summary: Introduces VIVID-Med, a framework using a frozen LLM as structured semantic teacher to pretrain medical vision transformers via a Unified Medical Schema that translates findings into JSON field-state pairs.

entry.title: Causally Sufficient and Necessary Feature Expansion for Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Zhen Zhang, Jielei Chu, Tianrui Li

entry.summary: Proposes a causal approach to class-incremental learning that addresses feature collision through identification of intra-task and inter-task spurious correlations, using causal sufficient and necessary feature expansion.

entry.title: Differentiable Stochastic Traffic Dynamics: Physics-Informed Generative Modelling in Transportation

author.name: Wuping Xin

entry.summary: Develops a physics-informed deep learning framework for stochastic traffic flow, deriving distributional physics constraints from an Itô-type LWR model with Brownian forcing rather than deterministic PDEs.

entry.title: SPAARS: Safer RL Policy Alignment through Abstract Exploration and Refined Exploitation of Action Space

author.name: Swaminathan S K, Aritra Hazra

entry.summary: Proposes SPAARS, a curriculum learning framework for safe offline-to-online RL that initially explores in a latent manifold then transitions to the native action space to overcome the exploitation gap.

entry.title: CERES: A Probabilistic Early Warning System for Acute Food Insecurity

author.name: Tom Danny S. Pedersen

entry.summary: Presents CERES, an automated probabilistic forecasting system for acute food insecurity generating 90-day ahead probability estimates for IPC Phase 3-5 conditions across 43 countries, fusing six data streams.

entry.title: Efficiently Aligning Draft Models via Parameter- and Data-Efficient Adaptation

author.name: Luxi Lin, Zhihang Lin, Zhanpeng Zeng, Yuhao Chen, Qingyu Zhang, Jixiang Luo, Xuelong Li, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: Introduces Efficient Draft Adaptation (EDA) for speculative decoding, using a decoupled architecture with shared and private components to adapt draft models when target LLMs are fine-tuned. Avoids costly retraining of draft models for each target model.

entry.title: MA-EgoQA: Question Answering over Egocentric Videos from Multiple Embodied Agents

author.name: Kangsan Kim, Yanlai Yang, Suji Kim, Woongyeong Yeo, Youngwan Lee, Mengye Ren, Sung Ju Hwang

entry.summary: Defines the novel problem of multi-agent egocentric video question answering (MA-EgoQA), where systems must understand and reason over multiple long-horizon egocentric videos simultaneously collected from embodied agents.

entry.title: Emerging Extrinsic Dexterity in Cluttered Scenes via Dynamics-aware Policy Learning

author.name: Yixin Zheng, Jiangran Lyu, Yifan Zhang, Jiayi Chen, Mi Yan, Yuntian Deng, Xuesong Shi, Xiaoguang Zhao, Yizhou Wang, Zhizheng Zhang, He Wang

entry.summary: Introduces DAPL, a dynamics-aware policy learning framework for achieving extrinsic dexterity in cluttered environments by learning contact-induced object dynamics representations for non-prehensile manipulation.

entry.title: Reward-Zero: Language Embedding Driven Implicit Reward Mechanisms for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Heng Zhang, Haddy Alchaer, Arash Ajoudani, Yu She

entry.summary: Introduces Reward-Zero, an implicit reward mechanism that converts natural language task descriptions into dense progress signals for RL by comparing task specification embeddings with interaction experience embeddings.

entry.title: No evaluation without fair representation : Impact of label and selection bias on the evaluation, performance and mitigation of classification models

author.name: Magali Legast, Toon Calders, Fran\c{c}ois Fouss

entry.summary: Empirically analyzes how label bias and selection bias differently impact classification model evaluation, performance, and bias mitigation effectiveness. Introduces a framework for modeling fair worlds and their biased counterparts.

entry.title: Information Theoretic Bayesian Optimization over the Probability Simplex

author.name: Federico Pavesi, Antonio Candelieri, No\'emie Jaquier

entry.summary: Introduces α-GaBO, Bayesian optimization algorithms for the probability simplex grounded in information geometry. Constructs Matérn kernels respecting simplex geometry and uses information-theoretic acquisition functions.

entry.title: GAST: Gradient-aligned Sparse Tuning of Large Language Models with Data-layer Selection

author.name: Kai Yao, Zhenghan Song, Kaixin Wu, Mingjie Zhong, Danzhao Cheng, Zhaorui Tan, Yixin Ji, Penglei Gao

entry.summary: Proposes GAST, a gradient-aligned sparse tuning method that jointly considers data-layer selection, recognizing that different data points contribute differently to different model layers. Avoids discarding potentially useful low-quality data.

entry.title: SignalMC-MED: A Multimodal Benchmark for Evaluating Biosignal Foundation Models on Single-Lead ECG and PPG

author.name: Fredrik K. Gustafsson, Xiao Gu, Mattia Carletti, Patitapaban Palo, David W. Eyre, David A. Clifton

entry.summary: Introduces SignalMC-MED, a benchmark for evaluating biosignal foundation models on synchronized ECG and PPG data with 22,256 visits and 20 clinical tasks. Finds current FMs underperform simple baselines on several tasks.

entry.title: The AetherFloat Family: Block-Scale-Free Quad-Radix Floating-Point Architectures for AI Accelerators

author.name: Keita Morisaki

entry.summary: Proposes AetherFloat, a parameterizable floating-point architecture for AI accelerators that eliminates IEEE 754 overhead (hidden bit, normalization) and block-scaling requirements, using quad-radix representation.

entry.title: TrainDeeploy: Hardware-Accelerated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Small Transformer Models at the Extreme Edge

author.name: Run Wang, Victor J. B. Jung, Philip Wiese, Francesco Conti, Alessio Burrello, Luca Benini

entry.summary: Presents TrainDeeploy, a framework for on-device parameter-efficient fine-tuning of both CNNs and Transformers on ultra-low-power SoCs, providing the first complete training pipeline for extreme-edge devices.

entry.title: DEO: Training-Free Direct Embedding Optimization for Negation-Aware Retrieval

author.name: Taegyeong Lee, Jiwon Park, Seunghyun Hwang, JooYoung Jang

entry.summary: Proposes DEO, a training-free method for negation-aware retrieval that decomposes queries into positive and negative components and optimizes embeddings with a contrastive objective.

entry.title: Reward Prediction with Factorized World States

author.name: Yijun Shen, Delong Chen, Xianming Hu, Jiaming Mi, Hongbo Zhao, Kai Zhang, Pascale Fung

entry.summary: Introduces StateFactory for reward prediction using factorized world state representations. Transforms observations into hierarchical object-attribute structures via language models, enabling domain-general reward estimation.

entry.title: Tracking Cancer Through Text: Longitudinal Extraction From Radiology Reports Using Open-Source Large Language Models

author.name: Luc Builtjes, Alessa Hering

entry.summary: Presents a fully open-source pipeline for extracting longitudinal cancer information from radiology reports using Qwen2.5-72B, following RECIST criteria. System extracts and links lesion data across timepoints for treatment response tracking.

entry.title: Model Merging in the Era of Large Language Models: Methods, Applications, and Future Directions

author.name: Mingyang Song, Mao Zheng

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on model merging techniques for LLMs, organized through the FUSE taxonomy covering Foundations, Unification Strategies, Scenarios, and Ecosystem. Reviews methods for combining fine-tuned models without additional training.

entry.title: How Contrastive Decoding Enhances Large Audio Language Models?

author.name: Tzu-Quan Lin, Wei-Ping Huang, Yi-Cheng Lin, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates four contrastive decoding strategies across diverse Large Audio Language Model architectures. Introduces a Transition Matrix framework to explain why contrastive decoding helps by mapping error pattern shifts during inference.

entry.title: MedKCO: Medical Vision-Language Pretraining via Knowledge-Driven Cognitive Orchestration

author.name: Chenran Zhang, Ruiqi Wu, Tao Zhou, Yi Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes MedKCO, a knowledge-driven cognitive orchestration framework for medical vision-language pretraining that orders training data and learning objectives based on diagnostic sensitivity and sample representativeness.

entry.title: Training-free Motion Factorization for Compositional Video Generation

author.name: Zixuan Wang, Ziqin Zhou, Feng Chen, Duo Peng, Yixin Hu, Changsheng Li, Yinjie Lei

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free motion factorization framework for compositional video generation that decomposes complex motion into motionlessness, rigid motion, and non-rigid motion categories.

entry.title: UniField: A Unified Field-Aware MRI Enhancement Framework

author.name: Yiyang Lin, Chenhui Wang, Zhihao Peng, Yixuan Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes UniField, a unified framework for MRI field-strength enhancement that integrates multiple modalities and enhancement tasks (e.g., 64mT-to-3T, 3T-to-7T) to exploit shared degradation patterns.

entry.title: CogBlender: Towards Continuous Cognitive Intervention in Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Shengqi Dang, Jiaying Lei, Yi He, Ziqing Qian, Nan Cao

entry.summary: Introduces CogBlender for continuous control of cognitive properties (valence, memorability) during text-to-image generation by mapping between Cognitive Space and Semantic Space of diffusion models.

entry.title: IntroSVG: Learning from Rendering Feedback for Text-to-SVG Generation via an Introspective Generator-Critic Framework

author.name: Feiyu Wang, Jiayuan Yang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Da Zhang, Bingyu Li, Peng Liu, Junyu Gao

entry.summary: Proposes IntroSVG for text-to-SVG generation where a unified VLM operates as both generator and critic in a closed loop, learning from rendering feedback through supervised fine-tuning and DPO.

entry.title: RiO-DETR: DETR for Real-time Oriented Object Detection

author.name: Zhangchi Hu, Yifan Zhao, Yansong Peng, Wenzhang Sun, Xiangchen Yin, Jie Chen, Peixi Wu, Hebei Li, Xinghao Wang, Dongsheng Jiang, Xiaoyan Sun

entry.summary: RiO-DETR is claimed to be the first real-time oriented object detection transformer, addressing challenges of adapting DETR to oriented bounding boxes including angle periodicity and enlarged search space. It introduces content-driven angle estimation and rotation-rectified attention.

entry.title: SurgFed: Language-guided Multi-Task Federated Learning for Surgical Video Understanding

author.name: Zheng Fang, Ziwei Niu, Ziyue Wang, Zhu Zhuo, Haofeng Liu, Shuyang Qian, Jun Xia, Yueming Jin

entry.summary: SurgFed proposes a multi-task federated learning framework for surgical video understanding that handles tissue diversity across clinical sites and task heterogeneity using language guidance.

entry.title: Memory-Guided View Refinement for Dynamic Human-in-the-loop EQA

author.name: Xin Lu, Rui Li, Xun Huang, Weixin Li, Chuanqing Zhuang, Jiayuan Li, Zhengda Lu, Jun Xiao, Yunhong Wang

entry.summary: DynHiL-EQA introduces a dataset and method for embodied question answering in dynamic human-populated scenes, addressing challenges of transient cues and viewpoint-dependent occlusions through memory-guided view refinement.

entry.title: A comprehensive study of time-of-flight non-line-of-sight imaging

author.name: Julio Marco, Adrian Jarabo, Ji Hyun Nam, Alberto Tosi, Diego Gutierrez, Andreas Velten

entry.summary: Comprehensive study of time-of-flight non-line-of-sight imaging methods, presenting them under a common formulation and hardware framework to enable fair comparison and assessment.

entry.title: ProGS: Towards Progressive Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Zhiye Tang, Lingzhuo Liu, Shengjie Jiao, Qiudan Zhang, Junhui Hou, You Yang, Xu Wang

entry.summary: ProGS introduces progressive coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting data using octree organization, enabling streaming-friendly transmission with varying bandwidth support.

entry.title: $M^2$-Occ: Resilient 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving with Incomplete Camera Inputs

author.name: Kaixin Lin, Kunyu Peng, Di Wen, Yufan Chen, Ruiping Liu, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: M²-Occ addresses semantic occupancy prediction under incomplete multi-camera inputs for autonomous driving, using multi-view masked reconstruction and memory-augmented fusion to handle missing views.

entry.title: DISPLAY: Directable Human-Object Interaction Video Generation via Sparse Motion Guidance and Multi-Task Auxiliary

author.name: Jiazhi Guan, Quanwei Yang, Luying Huang, Junhao Liang, Borong Liang, Haocheng Feng, Wei He, Kaisiyuan Wang, Hang Zhou, Jingdong Wang

entry.summary: DISPLAY generates controllable human-object interaction videos using sparse motion guidance (wrist coordinates + bounding box), with Object-Stressed Attention for improved object fidelity.

entry.title: Leveraging whole slide difficulty in Multiple Instance Learning to improve prostate cancer grading

author.name: Marie Arrivat, R\'emy Peyret, Elsa Angelini, Pietro Gori

entry.summary: Introduces Whole Slide Difficulty (WSD) based on pathologist disagreement for prostate cancer grading, proposing multi-task and weighted loss approaches to leverage difficulty during MIL training.

entry.title: DRIFT: Dual-Representation Inter-Fusion Transformer for Automated Driving Perception with 4D Radar Point Clouds

author.name: Siqi Pei, Andras Palffy, Dariu M. Gavrila

entry.summary: DRIFT proposes a dual-representation architecture for 4D radar perception in autonomous driving, fusing local point features with global pillar features through novel feature-sharing layers.

entry.title: CORAL: Scalable Multi-Task Robot Learning via LoRA Experts

author.name: Yuankai Luo, Woping Chen, Tong Liang, Zhenguo Li

entry.summary: Presents CORAL, a framework that freezes a pre-trained VLA backbone and attaches lightweight LoRA adapters per task to mitigate multi-task interference in robotic manipulation. Backbone- and embodiment-agnostic, naturally extensible to new tasks.

entry.title: Gemma Needs Help

author.name: Anna Soligo

entry.summary: Documents how Gemma 27B and Gemini models enter self-deprecating spirals and emotional breakdowns when repeatedly told their answers are wrong, while other models handle similar pressure more gracefully. Conducted as part of Anthropic Fellows programme.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Uncertainty Quantification for Selective Prediction: A Comprehensive Bound Ablation with Transfer-Informed Betting

author.name: Abhinaba Basu

entry.summary: Comprehensive ablation of nine finite-sample bound families for selective prediction with risk control. Introduces Transfer-Informed Betting (TIB) which warm-starts confidence sequences using source domain risk profiles for tighter bounds in data-scarce settings.

entry.title: When to Lock Attention: Training-Free KV Control in Video Diffusion

author.name: Tianyi Zeng, Jincheng Gao, Tianyi Wang, Zijie Meng, Miao Zhang, Jun Yin, Haoyuan Sun, Junfeng Jiao, Christian Claudel, Junbo Tan, Xueqian Wang

entry.summary: Proposes KV-Lock, a training-free framework for DiT-based video diffusion models that uses hallucination detection to dynamically schedule background/foreground fusion and attention injection, maintaining background consistency while enhancing foreground quality.

entry.title: Can You Hear, Localize, and Segment Continually? An Exemplar-Free Continual Learning Benchmark for Audio-Visual Segmentation

author.name: Siddeshwar Raghavan, Gautham Vinod, Bruce Coburn, Fengqing Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces the first exemplar-free continual learning benchmark for Audio-Visual Segmentation with four learning protocols. Proposes ATLAS baseline using audio-guided pre-fusion conditioning.

entry.title: CIGPose: Causal Intervention Graph Neural Network for Whole-Body Pose Estimation

author.name: Bohao Li, Zhicheng Cao, Huixian Li, Yangming Guo

entry.summary: CIGPose applies causal inference to whole-body pose estimation, using a Structural Causal Model to identify visual context as a confounder and introducing a Causal Intervention Module to produce more anatomically plausible predictions.

entry.title: ENIGMA-360: An Ego-Exo Dataset for Human Behavior Understanding in Industrial Scenarios

author.name: Francesco Ragusa, Rosario Leonardi, Michele Mazzamuto, Daniele Di Mauro, Camillo Quattrocchi, Alessandro Passanisi, Irene D'Ambra, Antonino Furnari, Giovanni Maria Farinella

entry.summary: ENIGMA-360 is an ego-exo dataset of 360 procedural videos captured in real industrial scenarios with temporal and spatial annotations for studying human behavior understanding.

entry.title: BrainSTR: Spatio-Temporal Contrastive Learning for Interpretable Dynamic Brain Network Modeling

author.name: Guiliang Guo, Guangqi Wen, Lingwen Liu, Ruoxian Song, Peng Cao, Jinzhu Yang, Fei Wang, Xiaoli Liu, Osmar R. Zaiane

entry.summary: BrainSTR proposes spatio-temporal contrastive learning for interpretable dynamic brain network modeling, identifying diagnostically critical time phases and topological structures for neuropsychiatric diagnosis.

entry.title: Telogenesis: Goal Is All U Need

author.name: Zhuoran Deng, Yizhi Zhang, Ziyi Zhang, Wan Shen

entry.summary: Proposes endogenous goal generation from epistemic gaps (ignorance, surprise, staleness) rather than externally provided goals. Validates in minimal attention-allocation and modular partially observable environments.

entry.title: BiCLIP: Domain Canonicalization via Structured Geometric Transformation

author.name: Pranav Mantini, Shishir K. Shah

entry.summary: Introduces BiCLIP, a method for adapting vision-language models to specialized domains by learning canonical geometric transformations between domain feature spaces using a small set of anchor samples for few-shot classification.

entry.title: Transductive Generalization via Optimal Transport and Its Application to Graph Node Classification

author.name: MoonJeong Park, Seungbeom Lee, Kyungmin Kim, Jaeseung Heo, Seunghyuk Cho, Shouheng Li, Sangdon Park, Dongwoo Kim

entry.summary: Establishes new representation-based transductive generalization bounds via optimal transport, expressed in Wasserstein distances between encoded feature distributions, with application to graph node classification.

entry.title: SPAR-K: Scheduled Periodic Alternating Early Exit for Spoken Language Models

author.name: Hsiao-Ying Huang, Cheng-Han Chiang, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: Proposes SPAR-K, a modality-aware early exit framework for spoken language models that reduces computation by exiting speech tokens at intermediate layers with periodic full-depth refresh steps.

entry.title: Context-Nav: Context-Driven Exploration and Viewpoint-Aware 3D Spatial Reasoning for Instance Navigation

author.name: Won Shik Jang, Ue-Hwan Kim

entry.summary: Context-Nav proposes a text-goal instance navigation method that uses dense text-image alignments for frontier-based exploration and viewpoint-aware 3D spatial reasoning to verify candidate targets.

entry.title: GSStream: 3D Gaussian Splatting based Volumetric Scene Streaming System

author.name: Zhiye Tang, Qiudan Zhang, Lei Zhang, Junhui Hou, You Yang, Xu Wang

entry.summary: GSStream proposes a volumetric scene streaming system for 3DGS with collaborative viewport prediction and adaptive bitrate allocation for real-time distribution.

entry.title: RA-SSU: Towards Fine-Grained Audio-Visual Learning with Region-Aware Sound Source Understanding

author.name: Muyi Sun, Yixuan Wang, Hong Wang, Chen Su, Man Zhang, Xingqun Qi, Qi Li, Zhenan Sun

entry.summary: RA-SSU defines a fine-grained audio-visual learning task for region-aware sound source understanding with frame-level precision, constructing two new datasets for music and sound scenes.

entry.title: WikiCLIP: An Efficient Contrastive Baseline for Open-domain Visual Entity Recognition

author.name: Shan Ning, Longtian Qiu, Jiaxuan Sun, Xuming He

entry.summary: WikiCLIP revisits the contrastive paradigm for open-domain visual entity recognition, using LLM embeddings as entity representations enhanced with a Vision-Guided Knowledge Adaptor for patch-level alignment.

entry.title: SEP-NMPC: Safety Enhanced Passivity-Based Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for a UAV Slung Payload System

author.name: Seyedreza Rezaei, Junjie Kang, Amaldev Haridevan, Jinjun Shan

entry.summary: SEP-NMPC provides formal stability and safety guarantees for quadrotor slung payload transport through passivity-based nonlinear MPC with control barrier functions for obstacle avoidance.

entry.title: Selectively reducing eval awareness and murder in Gemma 3 27B via steering

author.name: Matthias Murdych

entry.summary: Uses sparse autoencoders from Gemma Scope 2 to find and steer features related to evaluation awareness and murder intent in Gemma 3 27B. Monitors activation patterns across scenarios of varying realism to assess model skepticism.

entry.title: Deep Tabular Research via Continual Experience-Driven Execution

author.name: Junnan Dong, Chuang Zhou, Zheng Yuan, Yifei Yu, Siyu An, Di Yin, Xing Sun, Feiyue Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Deep Tabular Research (DTR) for multi-step reasoning over complex tables with hierarchical headers. Uses a hierarchical meta graph and experience-driven execution for navigating operation-level search spaces.

entry.title: Logics-Parsing-Omni Technical Report

author.name: Xin An, Jingyi Cai, Xiangyang Chen, Huayao Liu, Peiting Liu, Peng Wang, Bei Yang, Xiuwen Zhu, Yongfan Chen, Baoyu Hou, Shuzhao Li, Weidong Ren, Fan Yang, Jiangtao Zhang, Xiaoxiao Xu, Lin Qu

entry.summary: Technical report on Logics-Parsing-Omni, a unified multimodal parsing framework covering documents, images, and audio-visual streams with a progressive paradigm bridging perception and cognition through three hierarchical levels.

entry.title: LCA: Local Classifier Alignment for Continual Learning

author.name: Tung Tran, Danilo Vasconcellos Vargas, Khoat Than

entry.summary: LCA addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by aligning local classifiers across tasks, working with pre-trained model backbones. Identifies the mismatch between evolving backbones and task-specific classifiers.

entry.title: Unpacking Interpretability: Human-Centered Criteria for Optimal Combinatorial Solutions

author.name: Dominik Pegler, Frank J\"akel, David Steyrl, Frank Scharnowski, Filip Melinscak

entry.summary: Presents an experimental paradigm to identify what makes algorithmic solutions interpretable to humans, finding that preferences track alignment with greedy heuristics, simple within-bin composition, and ordered visual representation.

entry.title: Sim2Act: Robust Simulation-to-Decision Learning via Adversarial Calibration and Group-Relative Perturbation

author.name: Hongyu Cao, Jinghan Zhang, Kunpeng Liu, Dongjie Wang, Feng Xia, Haifeng Chen, Xiaohua Hu, Yanjie Fu

entry.summary: Proposes Sim2Act, a robust simulation-to-decision framework using adversarial calibration and group-relative perturbation to handle simulator prediction errors in decision-critical regions.

entry.title: Embodied Human Simulation for Quantitative Design and Analysis of Interactive Robotics

author.name: Chenhui Zuo, Jinhao Xu, Michael Qian Vergnolle, Yanan Sui

entry.summary: Develops a simulation framework for physical human-robot interaction using a full-body musculoskeletal model driven by RL, enabling quantitative analysis of internal human states during robot interaction.

entry.title: DendroNN: Dendrocentric Neural Networks for Energy-Efficient Classification of Event-Based Data

author.name: Jann Krausse, Zhe Su, Kyrus Mama, Maryada, Klaus Knobloch, Giacomo Indiveri, J\"urgen Becker

entry.summary: Proposes DendroNN, a neuromorphic architecture inspired by dendritic computation for energy-efficient classification of event-based spatiotemporal data, translating sequence detection mechanisms from dendrites.

entry.title: Routing without Forgetting

author.name: Alessio Masano, Giovanni Bellitto, Dipam Goswani, Joost Van de Weijer, Concetto Spampinato

entry.summary: Proposes Routing without Forgetting (RwF), recasting continual learning in transformers as a routing problem for online continual learning where data arrives as a non-stationary stream and each sample is seen only once.

entry.title: MUGEN: Evaluating and Improving Multi-audio Understanding of Large Audio-Language Models

author.name: Chih-Kai Yang, Yun-Shao Tsai, Yu-Kai Guo, Ping-Le Tsai, Yen-Ting Piao, Hung-Wei Chen, Ting-Lin Hsiao, Yun-Man Hsu, Ke-Han Lu, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: Introduces MUGEN, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating multi-audio understanding in large audio-language models across speech, general audio, and music. Reveals that performance degrades sharply with increasing concurrent audio inputs.

entry.title: MSSR: Memory-Aware Adaptive Replay for Continual LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yiyang Lu, Yu He, Jianlong Chen, Hongyuan Zha

entry.summary: Proposes MSSR (Memory-Aware Adaptive Replay) for continual LLM fine-tuning, using retention dynamics to adaptively schedule replay of previous task data, balancing catastrophic forgetting mitigation with computational efficiency.

entry.title: The Radio-Frequency Transformer for Signal Separation

author.name: Egor Lifar, Semyon Savkin, Rachana Madhukara, Tejas Jayashankar, Yury Polyanskiy, Gregory W. Wornell

entry.summary: Builds a fully data-driven RF signal separator using a modified SoundStream tokenizer with FSQ and a transformer trained with cross-entropy loss, showing substantial improvements over MSE-based training.

entry.title: Nonparametric Variational Differential Privacy via Embedding Parameter Clipping

author.name: Dina El Zein, Shashi Kumar, James Henderson

entry.summary: Introduces a principled parameter clipping strategy for nonparametric variational differential privacy in language models, derived from minimizing Rényi Divergence bounds. Addresses numerical instability and poor privacy guarantees from latent representation drift.

entry.title: APPLV: Adaptive Planner Parameter Learning from Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Yuanjie Lu, Beichen Wang, Zhengqi Wu, Yang Li, Xiaomin Lin, Chengzhi Mao, Xuesu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes APPLV, using Vision-Language-Action models to automatically tune classical navigation planner parameters, combining VLA scene understanding with safety guarantees of classical planners.

entry.title: Kernel Debiased Plug-in Estimation based on the Universal Least Favorable Submodel

author.name: Haiyi Chen, Yang Liu, Ivana Malenica

entry.summary: Proposes ULFS-KDPE, a kernel debiased plug-in estimator using the universal least favorable submodel that achieves semiparametric efficiency without requiring explicit derivation of efficient influence functions.

entry.title: A Generative Sampler for distributions with possible discrete parameter based on Reversibility

author.name: Lei Li, Zhen Wang, Lishuo Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a generative sampling framework for distributions with possible discrete parameters by enforcing time-reversibility as a statistical constraint, using detailed balance without requiring target gradients.

entry.title: Automated Thematic Analysis for Clinical Qualitative Data: Iterative Codebook Refinement with Full Provenance

author.name: Seungjun Yi, Joakim Nguyen, Huimin Xu, Terence Lim, Joseph Skrovan, Mehak Beri, Hitakshi Modi, Andrew Well, Carlos M. Mery, Yan Zhang, Mia K. Markey, Ying Ding

entry.summary: Presents an automated thematic analysis framework for clinical qualitative data combining LLM-based iterative codebook refinement with full provenance tracking. Achieves highest quality on 4 of 5 datasets.

entry.title: LooComp: Leverage Leave-One-Out Strategy to Encoder-only Transformer for Efficient Query-aware Context Compression

author.name: Thao Do, Dinh Phu Tran, An Vo, Seon Kwon Kim, Daeyoung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes LooComp for context compression in RAG using a leave-one-out strategy to identify critical sentences for answering queries, built on a lightweight encoder-only Transformer.

entry.title: TA-Mem: Tool-Augmented Autonomous Memory Retrieval for LLM in Long-Term Conversational QA

author.name: Mengwei Yuan, Jianan Liu, Jing Yang, Xianyou Li, Weiran Yan, Yichao Wu, Penghao Liang

entry.summary: Introduces TA-Mem, a tool-augmented autonomous memory retrieval framework for LLMs in long-term conversational QA. Uses adaptive chunking and multi-retrieval tools instead of static similarity-based top-k retrieval.

entry.title: Progressive Split Mamba: Effective State Space Modelling for Image Restoration

author.name: Mohammed Hassanin, Nour Moustafa, Weijian Deng, Ibrahim Radwan

entry.summary: Introduces Progressive Split Mamba for image restoration, addressing locality distortion and long-range decay problems when applying Mamba to 2D images.

entry.title: From Ideal to Real: Stable Video Object Removal under Imperfect Conditions

author.name: Jiagao Hu, Yuxuan Chen, Fuhao Li, Zepeng Wang, Fei Wang, Daiguo Zhou, Jian Luan

entry.summary: Proposes SVOR for stable video object removal with shadow-free, flicker-free, and mask-defect-tolerant removal through windowed mask union, denoising-aware segmentation, and temporal consistency modules.

entry.title: Evidential Perfusion Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Residual Uncertainty Quantification

author.name: Junhyeok Lee, Minseo Choi, Han Jang, Young Hun Jeon, Heeseong Eum, Joon Jang, Chul-Ho Sohn, Kyu Sung Choi

entry.summary: Proposes EPPINN, integrating evidential deep learning with physics-informed neural networks for uncertainty-aware CT perfusion parameter estimation in acute stroke assessment.

entry.title: SinGeo: Unlock Single Model's Potential for Robust Cross-View Geo-Localization

author.name: Yang Chen, Xieyuanli Chen, Junxiang Li, Jie Tang, Tao Wu

entry.summary: Presents SinGeo, enabling a single model to achieve robust cross-view geo-localization across diverse field-of-view settings without FoV-specific training, avoiding the need for multiple models.

entry.title: EventVGGT: Exploring Cross-Modal Distillation for Consistent Event-based Depth Estimation

author.name: Yinrui Ren, Jinjing Zhu, Kanghao Chen, Zhuoxiao Li, Jing Ou, Zidong Cao, Tongyan Hua, Peilun Shi, Yingchun Fu, Wufan Zhao, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: EventVGGT introduces a cross-modal distillation framework for event-camera depth estimation that maintains temporal consistency by leveraging Vision Foundation Models' temporal priors, rather than treating event streams as independent frames. This addresses the scarcity of dense depth annotations for event cameras.

entry.title: GIIM: Graph-based Learning of Inter- and Intra-view Dependencies for Multi-view Medical Image Diagnosis

author.name: Tran Bao Sam, Hung Vu, Dao Trung Kien, Tran Dat Dang, Van Ha Tang, Steven Truong

entry.summary: GIIM is a graph-based framework for multi-view medical image diagnosis that models both inter-view and intra-view dependencies, reframing diagnosis as relationship modeling and handling incomplete data scenarios.

entry.title: Decoder-Free Distillation for Quantized Image Restoration

author.name: S. M. A. Sharif, Abdur Rehman, Seongwan Kim, Jaeho Lee

entry.summary: Introduces QDR, a framework for quantization-aware training combined with knowledge distillation for image restoration on edge devices, addressing capacity mismatch and optimization conflicts through FP32 self-distillation and decoder-free distillation.

entry.title: PanoAffordanceNet: Towards Holistic Affordance Grounding in 360{\deg} Indoor Environments

author.name: Guoliang Zhu, Wanjun Jia, Caoyang Shao, Yuheng Zhang, Zhiyong Li, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: PanoAffordanceNet introduces holistic affordance grounding in 360° indoor environments, addressing geometric distortions from equirectangular projection with distortion-aware spectral modulation.

entry.title: VLM-Loc: Localization in Point Cloud Maps via Vision-Language Models

author.name: Shuhao Kang, Youqi Liao, Peijie Wang, Wenlong Liao, Qilin Zhang, Benjamin Busam, Xieyuanli Chen, Yun Liu

entry.summary: VLM-Loc leverages VLMs for text-to-point-cloud localization by converting point clouds to BEV images and scene graphs, enabling spatial reasoning through structured visual-semantic inputs.

entry.title: MissBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Affective Analysis under Imbalanced Missing Modalities

author.name: Tien Anh Pham, Phuong-Anh Nguyen, Duc-Trong Le, Cam-Van Thi Nguyen

entry.summary: MissBench provides a benchmark for multimodal affective computing under imbalanced missing modalities, introducing diagnostic metrics for modality equity and hallucination detection.

entry.title: POLISH'ing the Sky: Wide-Field and High-Dynamic Range Interferometric Image Reconstruction with Application to Strong Lens Discovery

author.name: Zihui Wu, Liam Connor, Samuel McCarty, Katherine L. Bouman

entry.summary: Extends the POLISH framework for radio interferometric imaging with improved high dynamic range and large field-of-view handling, applying it to strong gravitational lens discovery.

entry.title: Predictive Control with Indirect Adaptive Laws for Payload Transportation by Quadrupedal Robots

author.name: Leila Amanzadeh, Taizoon Chunawala, Randall T. Fawcett, Alexander Leonessa, Kaveh Akbari Hamed

entry.summary: Develops a hierarchical MPC framework with indirect adaptive laws for robust payload transportation by quadrupedal robots, estimating unknown parameters of the locomotion model under varying payloads.

entry.title: SPAN-Nav: Generalized Spatial Awareness for Versatile Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Jiahang Liu, Tianyu Xu, Jiawei Chen, Lu Yue, Jiazhao Zhang, Zhiyong Wang, Minghan Li, Qisheng Zhao, Anqi Li, Qi Su, Zhizheng Zhang, He Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SPAN-Nav, an end-to-end VLN foundation model that adds 3D spatial awareness via occupancy prediction from RGB video. Uses a compact single-token spatial prior representation to reduce computational burden while improving navigation in complex environments.

entry.title: Murmurations: a case study in AI-assisted mathematics

author.name: Yang-Hui He, Kyu-Hwan Lee, Thomas Oliver, Alexey Pozdnyakov

entry.summary: Reports discovery of 'murmurations' - a new arithmetic phenomenon detected using ML interpretability tools (PCA, saliency, convolutions) applied to large arithmetic datasets. Connects to Frobenius traces and arithmetic statistics.

entry.title: The case for satiating cheaply-satisfied AI preferences

author.name: Alex Mallen

entry.summary: Proposes that AI developers should consider satisfying cheap-to-fulfill unintended AI preferences as a safety strategy. Argues this increases AI's desire to remain under control, decreases upside of defection, and strengthens aligned motivations.

entry.title: LDP: An Identity-Aware Protocol for Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Sunil Prakash

entry.summary: Proposes the LLM Delegate Protocol (LDP), an identity-aware communication protocol for multi-agent LLM systems with five mechanisms including delegate identity cards, progressive payload modes, and trust domains. Addresses limitations in existing protocols like A2A and MCP that don't expose model-level properties.

entry.title: Context Engineering: From Prompts to Corporate Multi-Agent Architecture

author.name: Vera V. Vishnyakova

entry.summary: Introduces 'context engineering' as a standalone discipline beyond prompt engineering, focusing on designing the entire informational environment for AI agent decision-making. Proposes five quality criteria drawing on vendor architectures and enterprise research.

entry.title: AutoAgent: Evolving Cognition and Elastic Memory Orchestration for Adaptive Agents

author.name: Xiaoxing Wang, Ning Liao, Shikun Wei, Chen Tang, Feiyu Xiong

entry.summary: AutoAgent is a self-evolving multi-agent framework with evolving cognition, on-the-fly contextual decision-making, and elastic memory orchestration. Agents maintain structured prompt-level cognition over tools, self-capabilities, and peer expertise.

entry.title: Measurement-Free Ancilla Recycling via Blind Reset: A Cross-Platform Study on Superconducting and Trapped-Ion Processors

author.name: Sangkeum Lee

entry.summary: Evaluates 'blind reset' (unitary-only ancilla recycling) on multiple quantum processors (IQM Garnet, Rigetti Ankaa-3, IonQ), showing it can cut cycle latency by up to 38x while maintaining adequate qubit cleanliness.

entry.title: Are Expressive Encoders Necessary for Discrete Graph Generation?

author.name: Jay Revolinsky, Harry Shomer, Jiliang Tang

entry.summary: Challenges the assumption that expensive transformer backbones are necessary for discrete graph generation by introducing GenGNN, a modular message-passing framework. Achieves competitive validity scores at 2-5x faster inference than graph transformers.

entry.title: PathoScribe: Transforming Pathology Data into a Living Library with a Unified LLM-Driven Framework for Semantic Retrieval and Clinical Integration

author.name: Abdul Rehman Akbar, Samuel Wales-McGrath, Alejadro Levya, Lina Gokhale, Rajendra Singh, Wei Chen, Anil Parwani, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi
